jobs.title: AI Product Manager - Consumer Products/B2C (Full-Time)
jobs.description:
Sr. AI Product Manager - Consumer Products

**Location:** Bangalore  
  **Employment Type:** Full-Time, Permanent

About Onro

Onro Rentals, backed by TVS Motor Company, is building the future of urban mobility through technology, data, and customer-centric innovation. We are creating digital experiences that simplify how customers discover, rent, manage, and interact with mobility solutions.

Role: Sr. Product Manager - Consumer AI Products

We are looking for a **Sr. AI Product Manager - Consumer Products** to drive the strategy, development, and growth of AI-powered customer-facing products. This is a highly strategic role that sits at the intersection of **Product Management, Artificial Intelligence, Customer Experience, and Business Growth**.

The ideal candidate must have prior experience as a **Product Manager for consumer-facing (B2C) products** and should have worked extensively with **AI-driven features, platforms, or customer experiences**.

Key Responsibilities

* Own the vision, roadmap, and execution of AI-powered consumer products.
* Identify customer pain points and leverage AI technologies to create intuitive and scalable solutions.
* Work closely with Engineering, AI/ML, Design, Data Science, and Business teams.
* Define product requirements, success metrics, experimentation frameworks, and go-to-market plans.
* Drive adoption, engagement, retention, and customer satisfaction metrics.
* Use customer insights, data analytics, and AI capabilities to build differentiated user experiences.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies and translate them into scalable business opportunities.

Mandatory Requirements

Consumer Product Management Experience

* Proven experience as a **Product Manager / Senior Product Manager for consumer-facing (B2C) products**.
* Experience building products used directly by customers through mobile apps, web platforms, or digital ecosystems.
* Strong understanding of customer journeys, growth metrics, user behavior analytics, engagement, and retention strategies.

AI Product Exposure (Mandatory)

Candidates must have hands-on exposure to one or more of the following:

* Generative AI applications (LLMs, AI Assistants, Chatbots, Recommendation Engines, Personalization Platforms).
* AI-powered product development and deployment.
* Working with AI/ML, Data Science, and Engineering teams to build AI-first experiences.
* Experience leveraging tools/platforms such as OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, LangChain, RAG frameworks, recommendation systems, or similar AI ecosystems.
* Strong understanding of AI product metrics, experimentation, model performance, and user adoption.

Preferred Qualifications

* 6-10 years of Product Management experience.
* Experience in consumer internet, mobility, e-commerce, travel-tech, fintech, marketplaces, SaaS, or subscription-based businesses.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a data-driven approach.
* Experience working in agile product environments.
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced startup environment with high ownership.

Who Should Apply

Consumer Product Managers who have built and scaled customer-facing products.

Product leaders who have worked on AI-enabled or AI-first customer experiences.

Candidates who can translate customer problems into innovative AI-powered solutions.

Who Is Not a Fit

Candidates with only enterprise/internal product experience.

Program Managers or Project Managers without end-to-end Product Management ownership.

Candidates without meaningful exposure to AI-powered products, AI features, or AI product development.

Why Join Onro?

* Build AI-powered products from the ground up.
* Shape the future of mobility and customer experience.
* High ownership with direct business impact.
* Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI initiatives in a fast-growing startup environment.

Apply Now

**Interested candidates can apply via the Google Form:**  
 https://forms.gle/CnYSnWSaRLqFB5CCA

**Note:** We are specifically looking for candidates who have worked as **Product Managers for consumer-facing products and possess strong exposure to AI-powered products, features, or platforms. Both Consumer Product Management experience and AI exposure are mandatory requirements.**

jobs.title: Senior Digital Engg.- Digital Mobility Products
jobs.description:
Role Overview

TVSM is looking for an experienced **Senior Digital Engineer Test Automation** to own the test automation strategy, framework architecture, and script quality across the organisation. The role will drive the transition from traditional scripted testing to intelligent, AI-augmented quality engineering, leveraging GenAI, self-healing frameworks, and agentic automation to improve test coverage, speed, reliability, and maintainability.

Key Responsibilities

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable, modular test automation frameworks.
* Establish coding standards, design patterns such as Page Object Model and Screenplay, and reusable component libraries.
* Evaluate and integrate AI-powered testing capabilities, including self-healing locators, visual AI, and autonomous test generation.
* Lead the adoption of Generative AI for AI-assisted test-case generation, synthetic test-data creation, and intelligent defect prediction.
* Implement self-healing test scripts that can adapt to UI changes with minimal manual maintenance.
* Evaluate and integrate LLM-based testing tools such as ACCELQ Autopilot, Applitools Autonomous, Testsigma Copilot, and KaneAI.
* Build and govern prompt-engineering practices for AI-augmented test generation.
* Lead and mentor automation engineers through code reviews and upskilling on modern testing tools and practices.
* Conduct thorough script reviews to ensure maintainability, readability, and adherence to framework standards.
* Define and track automation KPIs, including coverage percentage, execution time, flakiness rate, and maintenance-cost reduction.
* Establish test-strategy documentation and automation playbooks.
* Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or GitLab CI.
* Drive shift-left and continuous-testing practices.
* Partner with development, product, and DevOps teams to embed quality throughout the SDLC.
* Provide test insights and release-readiness signals to stakeholders.
* Champion an automation-first culture across the organization.

jobs.title: Senior Associate Finance
jobs.description:
**Senior Associate Finance****Who We Are?**

**We're GrowthSchool. And we built Outskill.**

GrowthSchool started with one belief: you learn a skill fastest from the person actually doing it. So we partnered with the top 1% of instructors to build high-impact, cohort-based courses in personal and professional growth for learners around the world, and used AI to make that learning personal at a scale a classroom never could.

Then AI changed what **upskilling** even means. Roles started getting rewritten faster than curriculums could keep up, and the real divide stopped being skilled versus unskilled. It became AI-ready versus not.

So, we built **Outskill**, our AI education arm, to close that gap practical, implementation-first AI training for professionals, teams and enterprises. Today, GrowthSchool and Outskill have reached **16M+ learners across 160+ countries**, with programs running everywhere from individual upskilling to enterprise AI transformation.

**Our mission: Make 100 million people AI-ready by 2028.**

**What that actually feels like day to day:** We're 300+ people, backed by Sequoia, moving at a speed that surprises most people who join us. Products ship in weeks, not quarters. There's no thick layer of process between an idea and it going live. You'll own things visibly bigger than your title. Some experiments will fail publicly, and we'll talk about them openly on Monday.

If you need a finished playbook before you start, this will be uncomfortable. If you'd rather write the playbook, you'll like it here.

**Why This Role Exists**

As GrowthSchool continues to scale, our finance function needs strong execution at the operational level to ensure that everyday accounting, payments, reconciliations and compliance activities run smoothly.

We're looking for a **Senior Associate Finance** who can independently manage day-to-day accounting and finance operations, maintain accurate financial records, support audits and ensure timely execution of recurring finance activities.

This is a hands-on role where you'll take ownership of the operational backbone of our finance function ensuring accuracy, discipline and reliability across financial transactions and administrative processes.

You'll work closely with the Finance team and internal stakeholders to build structured processes that can support the company's growing business operations.

**What You'll Do**Day-to-Day Accounting & Finance Operations

* Record and maintain daily financial transactions accurately in the accounting system.
* Manage accounts payable and receivable, including invoice processing, payment tracking and follow-ups.
* Perform regular bank, vendor and ledger reconciliations.
* Manage employee reimbursements, expense claims and related documentation.
* Support monthly and year-end book closure activities.
* Maintain organized financial records, vouchers, invoices and supporting documents.
* Identify discrepancies in financial transactions and ensure timely resolution.

Statutory Compliance & Audit Support

* Assist with GST, TDS and other applicable statutory filings and returns.
* Prepare and share financial data, reconciliations and schedules required for statutory, tax and internal audits.
* Coordinate with auditors, vendors and internal teams for audit-related requirements.
* Support the finance team in meeting regulatory and compliance deadlines.
* Maintain proper documentation and records for compliance and audit purposes.
* Ensure financial information and supporting documents are readily available whenever required.

Asset Management & Administrative Operations

* Conduct periodic physical verification of company assets.
* Maintain and update the fixed asset register.
* Track asset additions, transfers, disposals and related documentation.
* Coordinate with vendors and internal teams for day-to-day finance and operational requirements.
* Handle documentation, filing and record-keeping for the finance function.
* Support miscellaneous administrative activities required to keep finance operations running smoothly.

Process Discipline & Operational Excellence

* Follow established accounting processes and ensure accuracy in daily execution.
* Maintain timely updates across payments, receivables and reconciliations.
* Identify operational gaps and suggest improvements in existing finance workflows.
* Ensure recurring finance activities are completed within defined timelines.
* Maintain strong documentation and process discipline across all assigned responsibilities.

What Success Looks Like (First 612 Months)

* Daily accounting is accurate, timely and error-free.
* Payments, receivables and reconciliations are processed on schedule without backlogs.
* Statutory and compliance data is always ready ahead of deadlines.
* Audits are supported smoothly with well-organized documentation.
* Fixed asset records are accurate and physical verification is completed on time.
* Financial records, vouchers and supporting documents are properly maintained.
* Finance operations run reliably with strong process discipline and accountability.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for a **detail-oriented and execution-focused finance professional** who takes ownership of day-to-day accounting operations and understands the importance of accuracy, consistency and timely execution.

The ideal candidate combines **strong accounting fundamentals, hands-on experience with accounting systems, compliance knowledge and operational discipline.**

Must-Have

* **B.Com / CA Inter / CMA Inter** qualification.
* **Up to 3 years of experience** in accounting and finance operations, preferably in an industry environment.
* Hands-on experience managing daily accounting transactions and maintaining books of accounts.
* Working knowledge of accounts payable, accounts receivable, invoice processing and payment management.
* Experience in bank, vendor and ledger reconciliations.
* Hands-on experience with accounting software such as **Tally, Zoho Books or similar platforms**.
* Strong working knowledge of **MS Excel**.
* Working knowledge of GST, TDS and other applicable statutory compliance requirements.
* Experience supporting statutory, tax and internal audits.
* Experience managing employee reimbursements, expense claims and financial documentation.
* Understanding of fixed asset management and asset register maintenance.
* Strong attention to detail, accuracy and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage recurring tasks independently and meet deadlines.
* Strong ownership, accountability and follow-through.

Good-to-Have

* Experience working in **startups or high-growth organizations**.
* Exposure to **AI, EdTech, SaaS or B2B technology companies**.
* Experience managing finance operations across multiple business entities.
* Familiarity with finance automation tools and digital accounting workflows.
* Knowledge of advanced Excel functions and financial reporting.
* Experience improving accounting processes and operational workflows.
* Ability to leverage technology to improve finance operations and reporting efficiency.

What We're Evaluating

We're less interested in how many years you've worked and more interested in how much ownership you've demonstrated.

We'll be looking for evidence of:

* Ownership of day-to-day accounting and operational accuracy.
* Strong understanding of core accounting principles and processes.
* Reliability in managing recurring tasks, reconciliations and compliance data.
* High attention to detail with strong process discipline.
* Ability to identify discrepancies and resolve issues independently.
* Bias toward execution, accountability and follow-through.
* Ability to thrive in lean, fast-moving environments.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to build the finance foundations of one of India's fastest-growing learning companies.
* Direct exposure to Finance leadership and business operations.
* High ownership from Day 1 with real responsibility for finance oper

jobs.description:
**Company:** Qualcomm India Private Limited

**Job Area:** Sales, Business Development Marketing Group, Sales, Business Development Marketing Group > Marketing

**Job Summary**

The Digital Analytics Manager will support enterprise digital analytics operations by translating Business Measurement Requirements (BRDs) into Solution Design Reference (SDRs) including data-layer design, web tagging, validation, governance, and reporting solutions. The role partners with marketing, legal privacy, IT, development teams, platform owners, and external agencies to implement and sustain reliable analytics across websites and digital experiences. The position combines hands-on Adobe Analytics and Adobe Data Collection expertise with structured project follow-through, quality assurance, issue triage, documentation, and stakeholder coordination

**Key Responsibilities**

* Implement and enhance website and application analytics using Adobe Analytics, Adobe Data Collection/Launch, Adobe Data Layer patterns, events, variables, report suites, segments, and calculated metrics.
* Translate business requirements into measurement specifications, data-layer requirements, solution design references, pixel intake requirements, test plans, and acceptance criteria.
* Perform stage and production QA/UAT for page views, search interactions, downloads, login events, campaign pixels, consent signals, URL-based behaviors, and other digital interactions.
* Maintain analytics privacy and data-minimization requirements by identifying unintended user-data collection, defining remediation requirements, validating changes, and escalating unresolved risks.
* Support consent-management integrations and validation, including alignment between consent signals, Adobe Web SDK/Data Collection, analytics behavior, and regional privacy requirements.
* Conduct analytics environment governance activities, including audits and cleanup of unused segments and calculated metrics, documentation maintenance, naming standards, and configuration hygiene.
* Monitor analytics health through alerts, anomaly review, website scans, tag validation, and investigation of broken or inconsistent tracking.
* Coordinate work through Workfront, Jira, ServiceNow, email, and recurring backlog reviews; create and follow up on tickets, track dependencies, communicate blockers, and confirm production completion.
* Prepare recurring project status updates and supporting documentation for analytics operations, including in-flight work, backlog, risks, completion status, and next steps.
* Provide tool support, access administration, knowledge transfer, and technical guidance for Adobe Analytics and related MarTech platforms.
* Collaborate across time zones with internal teams, consultants, agencies, and vendors, serving as a technical point of contact for analytics implementation and validation work.
* Maintain the platform roadmap and backlog; prioritize enhancements with stakeholders
* Build and maintain operational dashboards for usage, adoption, and operational metrics

**Qualifications**

* 10+ years administering enterprise Adobe Analytics and Adobe Data Collections
* Demonstrated experience implementing and validating digital analytics for websites or web applications.
* Hands-on experience with Adobe Analytics, Adobe Data Collection/Launch, browser debugging, data layers, events, variables, segments, calculated metrics, and report-suite validation.
* Ability to read technical requirements, inspect browser behavior, test across stage and production environments, and clearly document defects and expected outcomes.
* Experience coordinating work with software developers, IT teams, product owners, analytics stakeholders, privacy partners, agencies, and vendors.
* Working knowledge of digital privacy, consent signals, data minimization, and responsible collection of user-related information.
* Experience using work-management and incident-tracking systems such as Workfront, Jira, and ServiceNow.
* Strong written communication, follow-through, documentation, prioritization, and cross-time-zone collaboration skills.
* Knowledge of analytics governance practices, naming conventions, solution design documentation, dashboard delivery, and operational reporting.
* Adobe Analytics or related digital analytics certification is beneficial.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree and 3+ years of Communications, Marketing, Public Relations, or related work experience.
* OR Associate's degree or equivalent degree and 5+ years of Communications, Marketing, Public Relations, or related work experience.
* OR High school Diploma or equivalent and 7+ years of Communications, Marketing, Public Relations, or related work experience.
* \*Completed advanced degrees in a relevant field may be substituted for up to two years (Masters = one year, Doctorate = two years) of work experience.

jobs.title: Senior Manager-Enterprise Digital Deployment Strategist
jobs.description:
**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Digital Deployment Strategy**

* Define the overall deployment and rollout strategy for enterprise digital products, platforms, and services.
* Develop deployment roadmaps covering **PoC, Pilot, MVP, Production, Phased Rollout, and Enterprise Scale**.
* Determine rollout sequencing across business units, locations, channels, customer segments, or operating environments.
* Identify deployment dependencies, constraints, risks, assumptions, and readiness requirements early in the lifecycle.
* Define repeatable deployment frameworks, playbooks, and patterns that can be used across multiple digital initiatives.
* Align deployment strategy with business priorities, technology strategy, enterprise architecture, security requirements, and operational capabilities.

**2. Solutioning & Deployment Architecture**

* Translate business and product requirements into **deployable enterprise solutions**.
* Lead solutioning discussions across application, API, integration, cloud, data, AI, security, infrastructure, and operations.
* Work with Enterprise and Solution Architects to determine the appropriate technical approach and deployment model.
* Assess **build, buy, partner, reuse, and platform-based** options.
* Identify gaps in existing enterprise capabilities that could prevent successful deployment.
* Ensure solutions are designed with production deployment, scalability, resilience, security, observability, and supportability in mind.

**3. Cross-functional Program Orchestration**

* Drive execution across multiple product, engineering, architecture, infrastructure, security, operations, business, and partner teams.
* Establish a common deployment plan with clear milestones, owners, dependencies, and decision points.
* Track cross-team dependencies and actively drive closure of blockers.
* Manage deployment risks, issues, assumptions, and escalations.
* Establish governance and operating cadence for large or strategically important rollout programs.
* Ensure all participating teams remain aligned to the deployment objective, timelines, and production outcomes.
* Facilitate executive-level reviews and decision-making where cross-functional intervention is required.

**4. Deployment Readiness**

* Define and manage **deployment readiness criteria** across technology and business dimensions.
* Ensure readiness of environments, infrastructure, integrations, data, security controls, observability, support processes, documentation, and operational teams.
* Coordinate UAT, pilot readiness, production readiness, cutover, and go-live activities.
* Identify gaps that may create operational or business risk after launch.
* Establish readiness checkpoints and ensure exceptions are explicitly assessed and managed.

**5. Product Rollout & Enterprise Scale**

* Drive successful production deployment and phased rollout of digital products and services.
* Coordinate launch activities across technology and business teams.
* Monitor deployment progress, adoption, operational issues, and business readiness during rollout.
* Lead resolution of issues that prevent or delay deployment and scale.
* Define expansion strategies for successful pilots and early deployments.
* Standardize successful deployment approaches for reuse across other products, business units, and markets.

**6. Business & Stakeholder Alignment**

* Work closely with business leaders and product teams to understand deployment objectives, constraints, and expected outcomes.
* Translate business priorities into actionable deployment strategies and execution plans.
* Communicate complex technical dependencies and risks in a clear business context.
* Build alignment across stakeholders with potentially conflicting priorities.
* Drive timely decisions on scope, sequencing, dependencies, investment, and deployment approach.
* Act as a key interface between business leadership and technology execution teams.

**7. Technology & Platform Readiness**

* Assess whether existing enterprise platforms and technology capabilities are sufficient to support large-scale deployment.
* Drive reuse of enterprise capabilities such as identity, integration, data, cloud, AI, observability, security, and common platforms.
* Identify platform capabilities that need to be enhanced to enable product rollout.
* Promote standardization of deployment and integration approaches across digital initiatives.
* Ensure new deployments do not create unnecessary technology duplication or fragmented architectures.

**8. Partner & Vendor Orchestration**

* Work with system integrators, technology vendors, cloud providers, startups, and strategic partners involved in deployment.
* Define technical and delivery boundaries between internal and external teams.
* Review partner solution approaches and deployment plans.
* Ensure partner dependencies and deliverables are aligned with enterprise rollout milestones.
* Drive resolution of cross-partner integration and deployment issues.

**9. Post-deployment Scale & Continuous Improvement**

* Ensure structured transition from implementation into stable business-as-usual operations.
* Track deployment outcomes, adoption, operational performance, and user feedback.
* Identify recurring deployment bottlenecks and opportunities for process or platform improvement.
* Capture lessons learned and convert them into reusable deployment patterns.
* Continuously improve the enterprise approach to digital rollout and scale.

**Key Deliverables**

The role will own or contribute to:

* Enterprise deployment and rollout strategies
* Deployment roadmaps and rollout plans
* Solutioning and deployment approaches
* Pilot-to-production plans
* Cross-functional execution plans
* Deployment readiness frameworks and checklists
* Dependency, risk, issue, and escalation management
* Cutover and go-live plans
* Deployment playbooks and reusable rollout patterns
* Production-readiness assessments

**Success Measures**

Success in this role will be demonstrated through:

* Successful and timely **deployment of digital products and services**
* Reduction in **time from pilot to production**
* Successful enterprise rollout and coverage
* Reduction in deployment-related blockers and delays
* Effectiveness of cross-functional execution across multiple teams

* Provide transparent communication on program status, milestones, achievements, challenges, and emerging risks.

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking capabilities.

---------------------

jobs.description:
WE'RE HIRING! | Banking Alliances & Partnerships Manager.

We are hiring a banking professional who can open, run and protect To The Moon Technologies Pvt Ltd's banking relationships: INR pay-in, payout, virtual accounts, CMS and API banking for a crypto trading platform.

* **Department:** Strategic Partnerships (Banking & Payments)
* **Reports To:** Founder & CEO
* **Location:** Lucknow
* **Travel:** Regular travel to Mumbai, Delhi NCR & Bengaluru for bank meetings
* **Experience:** 5+ years in Banking or Fintech
* **Required Expertise:** Digital Banking, API Banking, CMS & Virtual Accounts
* **Employment Type:** Full-time
* **Seniority:** Senior Executive to Manager, based on experience

**About ToTheMoon Technologies Pvt Ltd**

ToTheMoon Technologies Pvt Ltd is an FIU-IND registered Indian cryptocurrency exchange, headquartered in Jaipur and operating since 2021. We run spot and futures trading plus OTC on-ramp and off-ramp services for Indian users. INR flows, deposits, withdrawals and settlements, sit at the center of our business, and they depend on strong, compliant banking partners.

**Role purpose**

You will own ToTheMoon Technologies Pvt Ltd's banking ecosystem end to end. That means finding and onboarding banks, getting API banking, virtual accounts and CMS live, and keeping every relationship healthy. You will also build backup banking so no single bank or payment rail can stop INR deposits or withdrawals.

**Key responsibilities**

1.Bank partnerships and onboarding

a. Find, pitch and onboard private, small finance, cooperative and new-age banks for current accounts, escrow/nodal accounts, pay-in and payout.

b. Present ToTheMoon Technologies Pvt Ltd's business model, FIU-IND registration, AML/KYC framework and risk controls to bank product, risk and compliance teams.

c. Lead the bank's due diligence: documents, questionnaires, site visits and onboarding

paperwork.

2. API banking, virtual accounts and CMS

a. Set up and expand virtual account (VAN) structures for user-wise INR deposit collection

and auto-reconciliation.

b. Get API banking live for IMPS, NEFT, RTGS and UPI payouts, plus balance, statement and

status APIs.

c. Set up CMS for collections and bulk payouts, and drive integration with our tech team

through UAT and go-live.

d. Work with UPI collect, payment aggregator and PSP partners as extra deposit rails.

3. Relationship management

a. Act as the single point of contact for every banking partner, from relationship managers

up to senior leadership.

b. Handle account freezes, lien marks, LEA and cyber-cell requests, chargebacks and

transaction holds with the bank and our compliance team.

c. Run regular reviews of volumes, TAT, success rates and issues with each bank.

4. Negotiation and commercials

a. Negotiate pricing, transaction limits, float terms, MDR, payout charges and SLAs.

b. Review and close banking agreements, API terms and SLAs with our legal team.

5. Business continuity

a. Always keep at least two live banking partners for pay-in and payout, with tested

failover.

b. Spot risk early, regulatory changes, a bank's appetite for VDA business and line up

alternatives before they are needed.

6. Compliance and internal coordination

a. Work with compliance, finance, operations and tech so bank requirements under PMLA,

FIU-IND and RBI guidelines are met.

b. Keep partner dashboards, MIS and documentation current for management.

**Must-have requirements**

* 5+ years in banking or fintech, with hands-on work in digital banking, API banking, CMS and

virtual accounts.

* Has managed these products for a corporate client, a fintech platform, a stockbroker, a payment

aggregator or a crypto exchange from the bank side or the client side.

* Has taken at least 2–3 bank integrations (VAN, payout API or CMS) from first meeting to go-live.

* An active network of decision-makers in transaction banking, CMS, digital/API banking and

fintech partnership teams at Indian banks.

* Clear understanding of INR payment rails: IMPS, NEFT, RTGS, UPI, NACH, and escrow/nodal

account structures.

* Working knowledge of KYC/AML, PMLA, FIU-IND and RBI rules relevant to banks serving fintechs

and VDA businesses.

* Strong negotiation, presentation and written communication skills in English and Hindi.

* Graduate in any field; MBA in Finance, Banking or Business preferred.

**Skills and Competencies**

* **Banking Products:** Knowledge of current, escrow and nodal accounts; virtual accounts; CMS collections and payouts; API banking; UPI collect and payout.
* **Technical Fluency:** Ability to read API documentation and understand webhooks, callbacks, reconciliation files and UAT; comfortable coordinating with developers and bank technology teams.
* **Negotiation:** Ability to negotiate pricing, transaction limits, SLAs and agreements while maintaining strong banking relationships.
* **Communication:** Strong presentation and email-writing skills; confident in meetings with bank CXOs, risk and compliance heads.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Ability to align compliance, finance, technology and operations teams around bank integration timelines.
* **Problem Solving:** Ability to resolve account freezes, failed payouts, settlement delays and reconciliation gaps quickly.
* **Ownership:** Self-driven, works independently and takes complete responsibility for follow-through until go-live.
* **Integrity:** Handles confidential banking and customer data with utmost discretion.

**Good to have**

•Earlier work in a bank's transaction banking, CMS, digital banking or fintech alliances team.

•Experience at an Indian crypto exchange, stockbroker, payment gateway, PSP or NBFC.

•Has onboarded a VDA or high-risk business with a bank and understands the bank's concerns.

•Exposure to payment aggregator rules, cross-border payments or stablecoin on/off-ramp flows.

•Familiarity with reconciliation tools, MIS reporting and Excel-based analysis.

Pay: ₹444,000.00 - ₹700,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
**Building the Future of Open Finance**
Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.
  
  
**The team**
Payward Services is an enterprise infrastructure platform that enables companies to seamlessly integrate trading, payments, funding, and digital asset services through a single unified system. It provides coordinated liquidity, custody, compliance, risk management, and settlement capabilities, reducing operational complexity for fintechs, banks, brokerages, and payment providers.
  
  
Payward's Payments & Blockchain team owns the first and last mile of every dollar that moves in or out of its products. That means dozens of banking partners, PSPs and local rails powering deposits and withdrawals for millions of users.
  
  
The team is looking for a product manager to shape the future of this platform, from the architecture underneath to the API layer internal clients build on. At the center is Payward's in-house PSP: a scalable, multi-tenant payments backend with hosted pages, SDKs, embedded components and direct APIs, so any Payward business can plug in and reach pay-in and payout rails worldwide.
  
  
**The opportunity**

* Own the product vision and roadmap for the Payward payments platform, covering both the shared backend and the integration surfaces internal clients build on (hosted pages, SDKs, embedded components and direct APIs)
* Map requirements across internal clients and use them to evolve the platform's vision and capabilities so it serves a growing range of use cases
* Partner with engineering to turn the target vision into a sequenced, high-impact roadmap, with milestones every client team can plan against
* Prioritize across competing client needs, make the trade-offs visible, and say no with a clear rationale
* Shape the client experience end to end, from first conversation to go-live, so teams can adopt the platform without heavy hand-holding
* Work with the banking and partnerships teams so each new PSP or bank integration is built once on the platform and reaches every Payward business
* Bring compliance, risk and legal requirements across Payward's entities and jurisdictions into the roadmap early, before they become launch blockers
* Set and track platform success metrics, such as time to launch a rail for an existing client, time for a new client to go live, share of rails available through the platform, and payment success rates

**What You Bring**

* 5+ years of product management experience, ideally in a platform, API or infrastructure role where your customers were other internal teams or developers
* Working knowledge of payments: pay-ins and payouts, PSPs and acquirers, bank rails (ACH, SEPA, Faster Payments, SWIFT and local methods), and how money flows between them
* Strong technical fluency. You can read an RFC, challenge an architecture decision, and write an API spec that engineers respect
* Experience shipping developer-facing products such as APIs, SDKs, or embeddable UI components
* Clear, structured writing. You turn complex system designs into docs that product, compliance and business stakeholders can all act on
* Skill at managing many stakeholders with different priorities, and building alignment without direct authority
* Comfort working with data to set goals and measure platform adoption and performance

**Nice to haves**

* Experience at a PSP, payment orchestrator or payments infrastructure company, or building one in-house
* Background with multi-tenant SaaS or B2B2C platforms
* Familiarity with crypto, stablecoins or on/off-ramps
* Experience working across multiple regulated legal entities or licensing regimes

*Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.*
*Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.*

**Our commitment**
Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. **Summary**

The
**Senior Product Manager – Consumer Products**
is responsible for the end to end product development, delivery, and continuous enhancement of consumer financial products, including credit cards, loans, instalment plans, balance transfers, top ups, and related value added services.

The role will lead product strategy, market research, proposition development, product launches, portfolio management, and continuous improvement. Working closely with Risk, Technology, Operations, Finance, Marketing, Compliance, and other stakeholders, the role will ensure products are commercially viable, customer focused, digitally enabled, and aligned with Finance House’s strategic and regulatory objectives.

**Major Responsibilities**

**Product Strategy & Portfolio Management**

* Develop and execute product strategies and propositions for assigned consumer products, including cards, loans, instalment plans, balance transfers, and related services.
* Own the end to end product lifecycle from market research and business case development through launch, optimization, and product rationalization.
* Develop short, medium, and long term product roadmaps covering product features, digital journeys, underwriting, technology initiatives, and business priorities.
* Conduct customer research, segmentation, competitor analysis, and market reviews to identify new opportunities and enhance existing products.
* Define product propositions, pricing, features, eligibility criteria, and customer value propositions in line with market needs and business objectives.
* Monitor portfolio performance and identify opportunities to improve acquisition, activation, utilization, retention, revenue, profitability, and customer experience.

**Product Development & Digital Transformation**

* Lead the design and delivery of new products, product enhancements, and digital customer journeys from concept through implementation and post launch optimization.
* Define product requirements, customer journeys, business processes, and functional specifications in collaboration with Technology and Operations.
* Drive digital acquisition, onboarding, credit decisioning, fulfilment, servicing, and other initiatives to improve customer experience and operational efficiency.
* Identify opportunities to simplify processes, automate product journeys, improve turnaround times, and enhance digital capabilities.
* Partner with Technology, Data, and Analytics teams to leverage automation, AI, and advanced analytics to improve product performance and customer outcomes.

**Commercial & Financial Management**

* Establish product level financial objectives and monitor revenue, costs, profitability, portfolio growth, and key performance indicators.
* Develop business cases and financial models for new products, product enhancements, pricing changes, campaigns, and strategic initiatives.
* Recommend pricing, fees, promotions, and product economics that balance customer value, competitiveness, risk, and profitability.
* Monitor product P&L and identify opportunities to improve portfolio contribution and sustainable returns.

**Credit, Risk & Governance**

* Partner with Credit Risk to define and optimize product eligibility, underwriting, credit policy, risk appetite, and decisioning requirements.
* Monitor portfolio quality, delinquency, approval rates, utilization, attrition, and other relevant risk and performance indicators.
* Ensure products and product changes comply with approved risk appetite, credit policies, regulatory requirements, and internal governance frameworks.
* Work closely with Compliance, Legal, AML, Risk, and other control functions to ensure regulatory and operational requirements are addressed throughout the product lifecycle.
* Establish and lead product governance routines, including product performance reviews, roadmap reviews, and cross functional forums.
* Represent the function in relevant audits, regulatory reviews, governance committees, and discussions with card schemes, processors, vendors, and strategic partners.

**Product Marketing & Customer Growth**

* Partner with Marketing, Sales, and Distribution teams to develop product positioning, go to market strategies, campaigns, and customer acquisition initiatives.
* Develop strategies to improve customer acquisition, activation, engagement, utilization, retention, cross sell, and customer lifetime value.
* Use customer insights, behavioural data, and portfolio analytics to identify opportunities for targeted propositions and improved customer experiences.
* Monitor campaign and proposition performance and recommend improvements based on measurable business outcomes.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Work closely with Operations, Risk, Technology, Finance, Marketing, Compliance, Legal, AML, Data & Analytics, Collections, Sales, and other stakeholders to deliver customer centric solutions.
* Build strong relationships across the organization and influence stakeholders to achieve product objectives.
* Act as the subject matter expert for assigned products, providing guidance on product strategy, proposition, economics, customer journeys, and portfolio performance.

**Knowledge & Skill Requirements**

* Strong expertise in consumer financial product management, particularly credit cards, personal loans, instalment products, and other consumer lending solutions.
* Strong understanding of the complete product lifecycle, including proposition development, acquisition, onboarding, activation, usage, retention, and portfolio management.
* Strong understanding of consumer credit, underwriting, pricing, portfolio risk, and lending economics.
* Good knowledge of card issuing, card processing, payment schemes, digital lending, credit decisioning, and digital onboarding platforms.
* Strong commercial and financial acumen, with the ability to develop business cases, financial models, pricing strategies, and product performance analysis.
* Strong understanding of digital product development, customer experience, data analytics, AI, and automation.
* Strong analytical, project management, problem solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Good understanding of the UAE consumer finance and regulatory environment, including relevant CBUAE requirements and applicable card scheme requirements.

**Qualification**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Marketing, Technology, or a related discipline from a recognized university.
* Professional certification in Product Management, Agile, or a related discipline is preferred.
* Experience
* 10 to 12 years of progressive experience in product management within banking, consumer finance, fintech, payments, or related financial services.
* Strong experience managing consumer lending and/or card products across the complete product lifecycle.
* Proven track record of developing and launching products, enhancing existing propositions, and delivering measurable improvements in revenue, profitability, customer acquisition, or portfolio performance.
* Demonstrated experience in product strategy, roadmap development, pricing, business case development, and product performance management.
* Experience leading digital transformation initiatives involving digital acquisition, onboarding, credit decisioning, automation, or customer experience enhancement.
* Experience working cross functionally with Risk, Technology, Operations, Finance, Marketing, Compliance, and other control functions.
* Experience working within a regulated financial services environment, preferably within the UAE or GCC.
* Experience with card schemes, processors, lending platforms, digital banking ecosystems, or fintech partnerships will be an advantage.

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
  
  
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
  
  
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
  
  
**Job Description**
Visa is evolving its consumer-facing platforms to create stronger customer value propositions, enable new product solutions, and support sustainable growth across CEMEA.
  
  
The Senior Manager, Consumer Platforms CEMEA will support the strategic evolution of Visa's consumer-facing and backend platforms, helping shape the products, propositions, customer experiences, and solutions that can be built through them in the future.
  
  
The role requires a commercially minded problem solver with strong business acumen, structured thinking, and the ability to translate complex business questions into practical recommendations.
  
  
The leading indicator of a good fit will be experience within a scaled, digital-first consumer business such as e-commerce, mobility, on-demand delivery, travel, marketplaces, subscriptions, or other technology-enabled services, with direct involvement in building and evolving consumer-facing mobile applications, digital journeys, and high-frequency customer experiences.
  
  
Working across regional and global Product, Technology, Design, Data, Finance, Marketing, Risk, Compliance, market teams, issuers, and partners, the incumbent will develop strategic perspectives, assess opportunities, build business cases, and support senior leadership decisions on platform direction and investment.
  
  
**The Senior Manager Will**

* Drive the evolution of consumer-facing applications and digital experiences, applying best practices from scaled digital-first businesses to create intuitive, engaging and high-frequency customer journeys.
* Shape the CEMEA consumer platform strategy across internal and external platforms, defining how capabilities should evolve to support future products, propositions and customer experiences.
* Structure complex and ambiguous business problems, evaluate strategic options and translate insights into clear recommendations, business cases and executable solutions.
* Translate strategic priorities and new CVP propositions into platform capabilities and product roadmaps, partnering with Product, Technology, Design and Data teams across digital journeys, benefits, loyalty, personalization, servicing and engagement.
* Shape the role of AI within consumer experiences, including conversational, generative and agentic capabilities, while defining the data, governance and operating-model requirements needed to scale responsibly.
* Develop investment recommendations and performance frameworks to assess platform health, customer outcomes, adoption, commercial impact, cost and return on investment.
* Lead cross-functional and cross regional strategic discussions and develop executive-ready recommendations to align regional and global stakeholders, resolve trade-offs and support senior leadership decisions.
* Act as a strategic thought partner to Consumer Solutions leadership, bringing external perspectives from digital commerce, marketplaces, mobility, travel, fintech and emerging consumer technologies.

**Qualifications**

* 8+ years of experience across consumer products, strategy and/or payments, with a strong preference for experience building and scaling consumer-facing mobile or D2C platforms in sectors such as e-commerce, mobility, on-demand delivery and travel. Payments, strategy/consulting or financial services experience is an added advantage.
* Strong business centric and strategic acumen, with the ability to connect customer needs, product and platform capabilities, operating models and financial outcomes.
* Demonstrated experience shaping digital-first platforms and growth strategies, including market-entry assessments, proposition development, business cases and investment recommendations.
* Ability to translate strategy into execution, converting recommendations into product roadmaps, business requirements and implementation priorities.
* Strong analytical capabilities, including market sizing, financial modelling, performance analysis, scenario development and synthesis of complex data into actionable insights.
* Excellent executive communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to simplify complex topics, develop high-quality decision materials and influence senior stakeholders across matrixed, multicultural organizations.
* Experience shaping and scaling consumer digital experiences, including personalization, intelligent recommendations and other capabilities that drive engagement and customer value.
* Bachelor’s degree required
* MBA or relevant postgraduate qualification preferred.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, P2P & Local Transfers
jobs.description:
**Department:**
B2C Debit, Product
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full Time
  
  
**Location:**
UAE
  
  
**Reporting To:**
Lev Novak
  
  
**Description**
Tabby creates financial freedom in the way people shop, earn and save by reshaping their relationship with money. Over 25 million users choose Tabby to stay in control of their spending and make the most out of their money.
  
  
The company’s flagship offering allows shoppers to split their payments online and in-store with no interest or fees. Over 70,000 global brands and small businesses, including Amazon, Noon, IKEA, and SHEIN use Tabby to accelerate growth and gain loyal customers by offering easy and flexible payments online and in stores.
  
  
Tabby generates over $18 billion in annual transaction volume for its partner brands and is the highest-rated, most-reviewed, largest, and fastest-growing FinTech in the GCC region.
  
  
Tabby launched in 2019 and has since raised +$1 billion in equity and debt funding from global and regional investors, and is now valued at $6,5 billion.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager located (or ready for relocation) in the UAE to lead the development and growth of our P2P and local transfer products in Tabby Cash. Since our vision is to become a financial service for daily use, we need a passionate, driven individual to make sending money to friends and family a daily habit for millions of Tabby customers.
  
  
You will lead a dedicated team focused only on P2P and local transfers and work cross-functionally with engineering, design, data, marketing, legal, compliance and our banking partners to deliver a seamless and scalable experience in the UAE and KSA.
  
  
What you will be doing
  
  

* Own the strategy and roadmap for money moving between people inside the country: P2P between wallets, local bank transfers and instant payments.
* Launch new local payment rails and partner integrations end to end, from discovery and regulatory requirements to scale.
* Invent creative, viral social money mechanics that people love to use and share: request money, split the bill, QR, payment links and sending to people who don't have a wallet yet.
* Grow the network by turning millions of Tabby app users into active senders and recipients.
* Work closely with legal, compliance, risk and core banking teams so products meet local regulations and security standards without killing innovation, because we are about balance.
* Lead the launch of local transfers in KSA together with local partners.
* Shape how the team works together with the Team Lead: planning, rituals and a predictable delivery cadence.
* Set and track KPIs (senders, transfer frequency, recipients per user, retention) and run experiments to move them.
* Keep an ear to the ground on market trends, user behaviour and best-in-class P2P products to keep us ahead of the game.
* Plan launches with marketing and communications teams to ensure clear messaging and user adoption.

What you will need
  
  

* UAE residence or ready for relocation
* 5+ years of experience as a Product Manager with hands-on expertise in P2P payments, wallets, instant payments or mobile banking
* Proven track record of launching and growing consumer payment products with measurable results
* Experience delivering products with banks, payment rails or other regulated partners
* Resilience and ability to adapt to a rapidly changing environment
* Fluency in English

**Benefits**

* Ownership & Impact: A working environment that gives you autonomy and responsibility from day one.
* Culture: Collaborative, inclusive, and driven environment where your voice matters.
* Flexibility: Enjoy flexible working hours designed to optimize productivity and balance.
* Growth: Participate in the company’s employee stock options program and shape your career trajectory.
* Support: Comprehensive health insurance, generous PTO and a Flexible Benefits budget to meet your personal needs.

We are passionate about creating an inclusive, high-performing workplace that gives people from all backgrounds the support they need to thrive, grow, and meet their goals (whatever they may be).
  
  
If this sounds exciting to you, we’d love to hear from you!

**Client Manager Graduate Programme (UAE Nationals)**

**Join our Client Management team and help deliver the exceptional client experience that sits at the heart of Corporate & Investment Banking.**  
  
**As a Client Manager Graduate, you'll work closely with Relationship Managers, Product Partners and specialist teams to support some of the region's leading corporates and financial institutions. You'll gain exposure to client relationship management, account servicing, onboarding, credit processes and risk management, helping clients navigate their banking needs while building the foundations of a successful banking career.**  
  
**Throughout the programme, you'll develop a broad understanding of how Corporate & Investment Banking serves clients across cash management, trade finance, lending and financial markets, while working alongside experienced professionals in a dynamic, international environment.**  
**This is an opportunity to build commercial, analytical and relationship management skills while gaining first-hand exposure to how a global bank supports clients across the UAE and beyond.**

**About the Graduate Programme – how you'll learn and grow**

**Join a skills-first organisation where your potential matters more than your background.**  
  
**Over this 12-month graduate programme, you'll gain hands-on experience, build meaningful relationships and develop a deep understanding of client management within Corporate & Investment Banking. From day one, you'll contribute to real business activities while receiving structured development and support.**

**You'll benefit from:**

* **Real impact:** **Support client relationships and contribute to the delivery of banking solutions for corporate and institutional clients.**
* **Future-ready capabilities:** **Build commercial, client management, risk awareness and stakeholder management skills.**
* **Cross-functional exposure:** **Work with Relationship Managers, Product Partners, Operations, Risk, Legal and Compliance teams.**
* **Continuous growth:** **Learn through structured development, mentoring and practical experience.**

**What you'll do**

**During the programme, you may:**

* **Support Relationship Managers in delivering exceptional client service across a portfolio of corporate and institutional clients.**
* **Assist with client onboarding, account maintenance and documentation processes.**
* **Help prepare client materials, briefing notes and account reviews.**
* **Work with product specialists to support client needs across lending, cash management, trade finance and financial markets solutions.**
* **Monitor portfolio activity and contribute to maintaining strong account and risk management standards.**
* **Collaborate with teams across the bank to resolve client queries and improve the client experience.**
* **Participate in projects focused on operational excellence, process improvement and client outcomes.**
* **Build knowledge of risk, compliance and regulatory standards within Corporate & Investment Banking.**

**Bring the skills – we'll help you build your career**

**We welcome students from all degree disciplines and backgrounds, recognising that diverse perspectives drive innovation.**  
  
**We're looking for people who can:**

* **Build relationships and communicate confidently with a wide range of stakeholders.**
* **Take ownership and show initiative when tackling challenges.**
* **Think critically and solve problems using sound judgement.**
* **Learn quickly, stay curious and continuously develop.**
* **Collaborate effectively across teams and functions.**
* **Stay organised and attentive to detail in a fast-paced environment.**
* **Demonstrate commercial curiosity and an interest in clients, banking and global markets.**

**About Corporate & Investment Banking (CIB)**

**We are a super-connector for many of the world's largest companies across more than 50 markets, playing a central role in global trade, capital flows and economic growth.**  
  
**We work with governments, financial institutions and some of the world's most ambitious corporates to help them expand, invest and navigate uncertainty across increasingly complex and fast-changing markets.**  
  
**What makes us distinctive is our combination of deep local expertise with an extensive and unique global network. We support clients across risk management, financing, transaction services, advisory and sustainable finance, helping move capital to where it's needed most and supporting the real economy across our footprint.**

**Eligibility**

**To be eligible for this graduate programme, you need to be in your final year of study or be a recent graduate.**

**Key Dates**

* **Assessment Centres:** **October 2026 onwards**
* **Start Date:** **ASAP**

**About Standard Chartered**

**We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.**

**Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.**

**Together we:**

* **Do the right thing** **and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do**
* **Never settle,** **continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well**
* **Are better together,** **we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term**

**What we offer**

**In line with our Fair Pay Charter,** **we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.**

* **Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance,** **with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.**
* **Time-off** **including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.**
* **Flexible working** **options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.**
* **Proactive wellbeing support** **through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits**
* **A continuous learning culture** **to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.**
* **Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation,** **one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.**

**Recruitment Assessments**

**Some of our roles use assessments to help us understand how suitable you are for the role you've applied to. If you are invited to take an assessment, this is great news. It means your application has progressed to an important stage of our recruitment process.**

**Visit our careers website** **www.sc.com/careers**

jobs.title: Assistant Manager, Planning & Performance
jobs.description:
Dubai, Dubai, AE Permanent ID: 100809

  

### **Description**

Operating in the UAE for over 50 years, CBD manages the corpor financial requirements of some of the largestates and businesses operating in the country, driving the UAE economy. Over the years, CBD has transformed into a progressive and modern banking institution winning multiple awards for its digital initiatives, credit cards, bank accounts, mobile app features and services.
  
CBD has been recognized as the number one bank in the UAE on the Forbes list of The World’s Best Banks 2022.

  

As we continue to build upon our successes, we are looking for ambitious individuals who are passionate about the banking and finance industry and the markets in which CBD operates. Just as important to us is your ability to demonstrate a talent for dealing with people - your colleagues and our customers and delivering service that really goes the extra mile.

  

**Job Purpose:**
  
The Assistant Manager, Planning & Performance is responsible for supporting the bank-wide financial planning, forecasting, performance reporting, and management information processes. The role provides insightful financial analysis, performance monitoring, benchmarking, and modelling to support strategic decision-making, business growth, and effective cost management across the Group.

  

**Principal Accountabilities:**

* Support the strategic and operational financial planning process, including annual budgets, forecasts, business unit plans, cost centre budgets, and branch budgets.
* Prepare and deliver monthly management reporting packs, ensuring accuracy, consistency, integrity, and timely submission.
* Provide financial insights, scenario analysis, and performance recommendations across revenue, expenses, capital, return on equity, liquidity, funding, and regulatory metrics.
* Conduct detailed Net Interest Margin analysis across products and maintain models to assess margin compression impacts.
* Prepare peer benchmarking and market analysis reports, comparing performance against UAE banking peers and Tier 1 banks.
* Support the preparation of Board and Investor presentation materials, including macroeconomic and banking sector updates.
* Assist in implementing and monitoring the Group’s cost management framework, including expense analysis, cost reporting, and cost control initiatives.
* Review and validate sales incentive calculations, ensuring compliance with approved policies, accuracy of payouts, and timely processing.
* Prepare financial models and business cases to evaluate new initiatives, products, and strategic opportunities.
* Support finance transformation projects by gathering, analysing, and consolidating financial and accounting information for management reporting purposes.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders to define performance measures, reporting methodologies, and business logic.
* Identify and resolve data quality issues, reporting gaps, and inconsistencies between business requirements and source systems.
* Respond to ad-hoc business reporting and analytical requests to support business decision-making.
* Maintain comprehensive process documentation, departmental operating instructions, and standard operating procedures.

  

### **Requirements**

**Education and Experience:**

* Experience in financial planning, forecasting, management reporting, business performance analysis, or financial modelling.
* Experience within the banking or financial services sector is preferred.
* Strong analytical and quantitative skills with the ability to interpret complex financial information and generate actionable insights.
* Knowledge of financial performance metrics, budgeting, forecasting, cost management, and banking industry benchmarks.
* Outstanding written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present information effectively to senior stakeholders.
* Strong planning, organisational, and stakeholder management skills.
* Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively across departments and manage multiple priorities.
* High attention to detail, accuracy, and commitment to delivering quality outputs.
* Professional drive, continuous learning mindset, and commitment to process improvement and innovation.
* Ability to communicate effectively with senior management and support strategic decision-making through data-driven analysis.
* Education requirements: Not specified in the provided job description.

### **Description**

Operating in the UAE for over 50 years, CBD manages the financial requirements of some of the largest corporates and businesses operating in the country, driving the UAE economy. **Job Purpose:**
  
The Manager, Treasury Control (Hedge Accounting) is responsible for establishing, implementing, and managing the Bank’s IFRS 9 Hedge Accounting framework. The role will ensure robust governance, regulatory compliance, accurate financial reporting, and alignment with Treasury and Asset Liability Management strategies while supporting the Bank’s interest rate risk management objectives.

**Principal Accountabilities:**

* Lead the implementation and ongoing management of the Bank’s hedge accounting framework across banking book portfolios.
* Design hedge relationships and develop hedge documentation, designation memorandums, and governance packs.
* Perform prospective and retrospective hedge effectiveness testing and monitor hedge performance.
* Own daily, monthly, quarterly, and year-end hedge accounting processes, reporting, and disclosures.
* Prepare and review hedge accounting journals, including fair value adjustments and hedge reserve movements.
* Ensure compliance with IFRS 9 hedge accounting requirements and related regulatory expectations.
* Partner with Treasury, Risk, Financial Reporting, and Financial Control teams to support balance sheet management initiatives.
* Assess hedge accounting implications of Treasury products, ALM strategies, and business initiatives.
* Maintain strong governance, controls, audit trails, policies, procedures, and operating manuals.
* Liaise with Internal Audit, External Audit, and regulators on hedge accounting matters.
* Drive automation, process improvements, and system enhancements related to hedge accounting and treasury reporting.
* Support treasury finance activities including P&L reporting, regulatory reporting, and ad-hoc management requests.

  

### **Requirements**

**Education and Experience:**

* Qualified Accountant (ACA, ACCA, CPA, CA or equivalent).
* 15+ years of experience within Treasury Finance, Financial Control, Product Control, or a related banking finance function.
* Hands-on experience implementing and operating IFRS 9 Hedge Accounting frameworks.
* Strong knowledge of Fair Value Hedges, Cash Flow Hedges, Portfolio Hedges, and IRRBB.
* Strong understanding of treasury products, derivatives, valuation methodologies, and hedge effectiveness testing.
* Experience preparing hedge documentation, accounting assessments, and financial statement disclosures.
* Experience engaging with external auditors and regulatory stakeholders.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience within the UAE banking sector is preferred.
* Experience with treasury platforms such as Murex, Calypso, Kondor, QRM, Finastra, or equivalent systems is preferred.
* Advanced Excel skills and a strong understanding of automation and process improvement initiatives.
