jobs.description:
The Sales and Logistics Coordinator is responsible for managing incoming orders and coordinating with customers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders to ensure efficient order processing and timely delivery. The role involves monitoring shipments, providing regular order status updates, addressing customer inquiries, and facilitating seamless coordination across all relevant functions. The position requires a proactive and adaptable approach to resolving logistical challenges, responding to changes in customer demand, and managing shipment schedule adjustments to ensure smooth and effective logistics operations.

 **Requirements**

**Main Tasks (key accountabilities, deliveries, what is the role expected to do).**

* Streamlining and managing the entire order cycle for optimal efficiency.
* Engaging in effective communication and negotiation with suppliers, manufacturers, and customers.
* Overseeing and monitoring the seamless operations of the supply chain.
* Tracking and managing final product shipments, ensuring adherence to costs and timelines.
* Possessing comprehensive knowledge of documentation requirements in accordance with regional standards.
* Demonstrating quick critical thinking and adept problem-solving abilities.
* Exhibiting excellence in customer service and maintaining strong client relations.
* Coordinating with transportation providers to ensure timely and accurate shipment movements.
* Thoroughly reviewing purchase orders and shipping documents to guarantee precision.
* Handle customer invoicing.
* Facilitating all customer payment methods including Letter of Credit and managing associated documentation.
* Facilitating special shipping arrangements when required.
* Proactively identifying and resolving shipping errors.
* Skillfully preparing customs documents for international transactions.
* Upholding the quality standards of all provided services.
* Ensuring strict compliance with company policies and procedures.

**Main KPI’s / Metrics that the role has an impact on**

* Order Management
* Logistics Management
* Compliance

**Minimum Education & Experience:** (Formal education necessary and experience required to fulfil the role, e.g., examples of experiences that would be relevant in order to qualify/fit to the role)

* Degree in Supply Chain Management, or any relevant qualification.
* Candidate should have 3-5 years of experience in freight forwarding operations.
* Highly organized to manage incoming orders, track shipments, and ensure timely delivery.
* Excellent communication skills in English are necessary to liaise with customers, suppliers, and internal teams, any additional language will be an advantage.
* Familiarity with order processing systems and logistics platforms is important.
* Accuracy is critical in this position to avoid errors in order processing, shipment tracking and inventory management.

**Person Specification/Essential Criteria:** Qualifications, Experience, Skills, Competencies, Relevant Qualifications

* 3-5 Years’ Experience in Logistics/Supply Chain environment
* The ability to quickly identify and resolve problems is critical in the role.
* Should be adaptable to handle any unexpected issues or change in demand.
* Effective time management is essential in meeting order deadlines and ensuring on-time deliveries. Being able to prioritize tasks to contribute to the overall efficiency of the logistics function.
* Attention to detail is essential to prevent errors and maintain accurate records.
* Experience in ERP environment (preferable Microsoft D-365)

**Desirable Criteria:** Qualifications, Experience, Skills, Competencies

* **Performance**: Deliver the expected results, take accountability for actions, have the needed competence to do the job, strive for high quality work.
* **Teamwork**: Communicate with clarity and empathy, supportive towards others, actively ask for and give feedback, cooperate with all colleagues to achieve common goals.
* **Attitude**: Show integrity in everything you do, treat everyone with respect, have empathy towards others, being passionate about and competitive in all you do.
* **Mindset**: continuously improve by choosing superior and digital ways of working, being responsible to drive and adapt to change, develop by continuously learning, being eager and quick to adapt when it comes to new ideas.

  
**Benefits**

We offer a truly great place to work - but don’t take our word for it, our own team have said the following:

* No micromanagement, we are trusted to do a good job.
* We have a collaborative culture, with a nonhierarchical style of working.
* We are given the tools we need to do a good job.
* Your opinion is always welcome.
* We are always looking at new and innovative ways of working.
* We are a team and help each other out!

Are you passionate about sustainability, innovation, safety and collaboration? Our employees have ideas on how to build a safer and more sustainable tomorrow and the drive and passion to realize them. Our attention to societal trends, and our ability to translate these into business opportunities, alongside our dedication to customers, sustainability and digitalization have earned us a place among the leading companies in our industry. We believe that building long-term relationships and integrity are keys to success. Performance driven by a forward-thinking attitude, passionate teamwork, and the strong will to continuously learn. If that describes you, we will gladly make way for your ambitions. From day one we support you with your personal growth, through challenging positions and comprehensive learning and development opportunities, in a dynamic, international, and diverse and pro-active working environment.

At Gunnebo, we have a bigger mission, we are working For a Safer World.

**About Gunnebo Group**

The Gunnebo Group is a global leader in security offering innovative products and services to protect and control the flow of people, and to safely secure valuables. Through our businesses Gunnebo Entrance Control and Gunnebo Safe Storage we offer solutions to customers in retail, public transport, public and commercial buildings, industrial and high-risk sites and banking. We operate worldwide through our 3,400 employees, 25 country locations and 10 production facilities to serve customers in over 100 markets. Together we create a safer world.

**Gunnebo Entrance Control** specializes in access control solutions enabling customers increased efficiency, safety and end-user experience. *Our wide range of products are designed to create a safe environment without restricting freedom of movement, whether it is to enter the lobby of a company, a store, an entertainment area, an industrial area and public transport. We shape the future of people flow management.*

*Gunnebo Entrance Control proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, and other statuses protected by law.*

jobs.title: Client Consulting Analyst
jobs.description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Overview:

Visa Consulting and Analytics (VCA) is the consulting arm of Visa and drives tangible, impactful results for clients. Drawing on our expertise in consulting, data analytics, technology, payments and economics, VCA solves the most strategic problems for our clients. The core client segments of VCA include issuers, acquirers, merchants, fintechs, payment enablers and governments.

Role Summary:

The Analyst for Digital, Strategy and AI supports the delivery of digital transformation, strategy and artificial intelligence (AI) engagements across the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) region.

  

The Digital, Strategy and AI Consulting practice is a team of experts specializing in strategy and digital transformation topics, including but not limited to:

Strategy:

* Defining business, segment, channel and functional strategies, such as digital banking, affluent banking, loyalty, open finance, stablecoins and artificial intelligence.

Ideation:

* Supporting the innovation agenda of clients through foresight, strategic trends research and co-creation activities.

Value proposition design:

* Developing holistic offerings, including products, services and customer experience, for strategic consumer, business and corporate customer segments.

Customer experience and engagement:

* Developing best-in-class digital customer journeys and engagement strategies, including digital onboarding, end-to-end digital journey transformation, digital channel benchmarking and user interface and user experience enhancement.

Performance analytics:

* Improving client performance and process efficiency by deploying data, digital and AI tools.

Digital delivery:

* Supporting clients with the implementation of digital strategies, including the design and development of digital channels, generative AI (GenAI) use cases and proofs of concept.

Key Responsibilities:

* As an Analyst, you will work within project teams under the guidance of senior consultants and managers, contributing to research, analysis and the development of client deliverables.
* Support the delivery of digital, strategy and AI projects across the GCC, from scoping through to final recommendations.
* Conduct market, competitor and customer research, including benchmarking and trends analysis, to inform client recommendations.
* Gather, clean and analyze data from Visa and industry sources to generate insights that support client recommendations.
* Contribute to the problem-solving process, including structuring analytical frameworks and developing insight-driven recommendations.
* Build business cases and financial models that measure business performance and quantify return on investment (ROI).
* Prepare clear and compelling client presentations and reports that communicate findings and recommendations.
* Support the preparation and running of client workshops and stakeholder sessions, and document findings, decisions and next steps.
* Track project workplans and deliverables, and keep the project leadership informed of progress, risks and issues.
* Collaborate with Visa Account Executives and the Product, Value-Added Services (VAS), Marketing and other internal teams to deliver integrated solutions as One Visa.
* Contribute to proposals and responses to requests for proposal (RFPs), as well as practice thought leadership, points of view and case studies.
* Help build reusable toolkits, templates and best practice documents that can be applied across the VCA practice.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**

Basic Qualifications:

* At least 2 years of work experience in management consulting, preferably on financial services, payments, digital or AI projects.
* Degree from a leading university, preferably in business, economics, engineering, computer science or a related field.
* Professional proficiency in English.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel, including building clear and compelling presentations, financial models and data analyses.
* Strong curiosity about AI, including GenAI and agentic AI, with hands-on experience using AI tools for research, analysis or content creation and an understanding of how to use them responsibly.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Experience working on projects in the GCC region.
* Exposure to digital transformation, strategy or digital banking projects.
* Knowledge of banking products, services, operations; payment schemes, services, card issuing and marketing initiatives.
* Strong interest in fintech and payments.
* Proficiency in Arabic is a plus.

What You Will Need to Be Successful:

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure complex problems and work with large data sets.
* Strong storytelling skills, with the ability to turn analysis into clear and compelling presentations.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills.
* Commercial awareness and an understanding of the financial indicators used to measure business performance.
* A collaborative, diplomatic and flexible working style, with the ability to work effectively in a matrixed organization.
* High attention to detail and a commitment to deliverables quality.
* Self-motivated and results-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines at the same time.
* Curiosity and a willingness to learn, take on feedback and develop new skills quickly.
* Ability to build strong working relationships with clients and colleagues.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

We are looking for an experienced **Business Analyst – Cards Agile** to join our Cards Agile Team within the Digital Transformation / Card Services function.

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience in **Card Issuing (Credit, Debit & Prepaid), Card Acquiring (POS and E-commerce), Payment Gateways, and Digital Payment Solutions**.

The successful candidate will work closely with Product Owners, business stakeholders, development teams, QA, and external vendors to translate business requirements into actionable user stories and deliver card-related solutions within an Agile environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Gather, analyze, and document business requirements for card issuing, acquiring, payment processing, and card management systems.
* Translate business requirements into user stories, BRDs, functional specifications, and process flows.
* Lead requirement-gathering workshops and prioritize product backlogs based on business value and technical feasibility.
* Participate actively in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Coordinate with Product Owners, Scrum Masters, developers, QA teams, and business stakeholders.
* Maintain and refine product backlogs to ensure alignment with evolving business priorities.
* Work on card payment technologies, including POS, e-commerce acquiring, payment gateways, 3D Secure, fraud management, contactless payments, and tokenization.
* Support system integration testing (SIT), user acceptance testing (UAT), test scenario preparation, and functional validation.
* Ensure compliance with payment scheme mandates, PCI DSS, Central Bank regulations, and internal banking policies.
* Coordinate with vendors, review technical proposals, validate solution requirements, and support vendor negotiations.
* Identify opportunities for process optimization across card issuing and acquiring operations.
* Prepare and maintain business documentation, SOPs, and post-implementation reviews.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Minimum **3 years of Business Analysis experience**, including at least 3 years of relevant experience in Cards and Payments projects.
* Banking, financial services, or Payment Service Provider (PSP) experience is highly preferred.
* Strong knowledge of:
* Credit, Debit, and Prepaid Card Systems.
* Card Issuing and Acquiring.
* POS and E-commerce Acquiring.
* Payment Gateways and Payment Processing.
* 3D Secure, Fraud Management, Contactless Payments, and Tokenization.
* Digital Banking and Card Services.
* Practical experience working in Agile / Scrum / Kanban environments.
* Hands-on experience with Jira and product backlog management.
* Knowledge of integration technologies and protocols such as APIs, ISO 8583, and XML.
* Strong BRD, FRD, functional specification, user story, and process documentation skills.
* Understanding of PCI DSS, payment scheme mandates, and banking regulatory requirements.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

* Omani Nationals are strongly preferred.
* Candidates with 3+ years of hands-on experience working with Card Management Systems and payment solutions are encouraged to apply.
* Candidates with experience in banking or payment processing environments will be given preference.

Work Location: In person

req39473

IFC

Relevant local language required (French, Spanish, German, Cantonese/Mandarin, Japanese, Portuguese, Hindi)

  

**Closing Date:**

11/30/2026 (MM/DD/YYYY) at 11:59pm UTC

**Description**

At the **International Finance Corporation (IFC)**, a member of the **World Bank Group (WBG)**, you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. In fiscal year 2026, IFC committed a record $105.6 billion to private companies and financial institutions in developing countries. For more information, visit www.ifc.org.

The CFO and Capital Mobilization Vice Presidency, led by IFC’s Vice President and CFO, mobilizes private capital at scale to support clients that create jobs and drive growth in emerging markets. It brings together debt and equity mobilization, investor engagement, blended finance, and partnerships functions to expand the pool of capital available for development, while also overseeing the Corporation’s financial strategy and reporting, balance sheet management, and treasury functions. This prudent financial stewardship safeguards IFC’s AAA credit rating and ensures discipline, transparency, and alignment with institutional priorities.

Looking ahead, the VPU’s vision is to channel private capital into the sectors with the greatest potential to create jobs by embedding Originate-to-Distribute (OtD) approaches into IFC’s operating model, deepening and diversifying engagement with investors, donors, and development partners, and delivering innovative financial solutions that attract institutional capital to emerging markets. It will leverage data, technology, and market expertise to scale impact and improve efficiency.

As IFC continues to scale its impact and mobilize private capital at scale, in support of the WBG goal of creating jobs that lift people out of poverty, its ability to attract long term institutional investors to invest in IFC-originated emerging market assets has become increasingly central to its operating and financial model. In the context of heightened global uncertainty, constrained public resources, and rising development needs, effective engagement with institutional investors is critical to creating jobs, and sustaining and expanding development impact across emerging markets.

IFC’s originate-to-distribute and capital mobilization initiatives—including securitization, the Managed Co Lending Portfolio Program (MCPP), B Loan syndications, parallel loans, private equity funds and anchor bond investing, thematic bond issuances, blended finance facilities, and other structured mobilization vehicles—have expanded substantially in recent years, reflecting IFC’s strong focus on originating assets that both meet World Bank Group’s development mandate and are consistent with the investment preferences of institutional investors.

To support this strategically critical agenda, IFC is seeking Principal Investor Relations Officers in IFC’s Global Investor Relations function to work in collaboration with IFC’s originate-to-distribute (OtD) initiative and to help embed OtD into the operating model of IFC, by leading and strengthening IFC’s global investor engagement approach. The role will be to lead IFC’s critical institutional investor relationships, positioning IFC as a partner of choice for institutional investors while embedding scalable, best-in-class investor relationship management practices across the organization.

The Principal Investor Relations Officer will be responsible for deepening long-term investor relationships, expanding and diversifying IFC’s investor base, aligning investor mandates with IFC’s mobilization priorities, strengthening IFC’s visibility and credibility in global capital markets, integrating investor intelligence into institutional decision-making, and institutionalizing robust systems, governance, and standards for investor relationship management.

This vacancy announcement is for nine (9) positions posted across multiple duty stations. The selected candidates’ duty stations will be determined based on organizational requirements and business needs.

**Duties and Accountabilities:**

The selected candidate is responsible for performing activities in the following areas:

Own day-to-day IFC relationships with assigned Tier 1 and Tier 2 investors, under the Director’s executive sponsorship for the most significant relationships and expand participation in IFC-originated assets by connecting investor demand with IFC opportunities and the Originate-to-Distribute agenda.

**Relationship ownership & growth responsibilities:**

* Serve as accountable owner and primary point of contact for assigned investors. Where designated as geography Team Lead, lead and coordinate the other officers in the regional hub.
* Map investor interests and identify opportunities across IFC products, platforms and programs.
* Build trusted senior relationships and coordinate integrated engagement with product, regional, industry, transaction and country teams.
* Sponsor priority platforms, roadshows, investor education and external engagements for assigned relationships

**Planning, reviews & execution responsibilities:**

* Develop customized engagement plans, including strategic dialogues, co-investment discussions, site visits, reporting, events and investor education.
* Lead MOUs, frameworks, and commercial terms, subject to Legal clearance and authorized approval/signature.
* Lead onboarding and coordinate KYC and due diligence logistics.
* Conduct quarterly business and annual strategic reviews and maintain accurate Salesforce records and relationship updates.
* Support syndication and structuring teams while engaging with investors.

**Demand, risk & coordination responsibilities:**

* Capture risk appetite, pricing, tenor, sector interests and other actionable demand signals.
* Consolidate and propose relationship risk limits for funds, subsidiaries and insurers and assess financial sustainability.
* Communicate structured investor feedback to Syndications, with the OTD Analytical Team supporting consolidation and analysis.
* Advise underwriting and structuring on investor demand; designated authorities retain decisions. Participate occasionally in OtD or strategy meetings when relevant.
* Ensure that investor engagement activities are conducted in accordance with IFC policies, World Bank Group ethical standards, and applicable legal and regulatory requirements.
* Partner with Legal and Compliance teams on investor agreements, side letters, and co-investment arrangements.

**Selection Criteria**

* Master’s degree or MBA, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* A minimum of 12 years of relevant professional experience of increasing complexity and responsibility in institutional investor relations, capital markets, private markets, asset management, investment banking, or related areas.
* Extensive experience developing and managing senior-level relationships with institutiona

Dubai, Dubai, AE Management Permanent ID: 102331

  

### **Description**

Operating in the UAE for over 50 years, CBD manages the financial requirements of some of the largest corporates and businesses operating in the country, driving the UAE economy. Over the years, CBD has transformed into a progressive and modern banking institution winning multiple awards for its digital initiatives, credit cards, bank accounts, mobile app features and services.

CBD has been recognized as the number one bank in the UAE on the Forbes list of The World’s Best Banks 2022.

As we continue to build upon our successes, we are looking for ambitious individuals who are passionate about the banking and finance industry and the markets in which CBD operates. Just as important to us is your ability to demonstrate a talent for dealing with people - your colleagues and our customers and delivering service that really goes the extra mile.

  
  

**Job Purpose:**

The Credit Card Portfolio Manager will be responsible for managing the performance, growth, and profitability of the bank’s credit card portfolio, with a strategic focus on developing and driving instalment plan products. This includes lifecycle management, customer engagement, pricing strategies, and cross-functional collaboration to enhance product uptake and usage

**Principal Accountabilities:**

**Instalment Plan Development**

Design and launch new instalment products tailored to customer segments and merchant partnerships.

Collaborate with product, risk, and technology teams to ensure seamless customer experience and operational efficiency.

Analytical mindset with proficiency in data tools (Excel, SQL, SAS, etc.).

Excellent communication and project management skills.

jobs.description:
**About Bright Money**

Bright Money is a Consumer FinTech for middle-income consumers. It brings together SaaS products to help consumers build credit, manage their debt, and get access to suitable loans and credit cards. These are the major financial needs of middle-income consumers living paycheck-to-paycheck.

Bright is a profitable, India-built, U.S.-market Consumer FinTech, with revenue trajectory to $100M in the coming 6 months. The business model combines subscription revenue with a financial service marketplace revenues, for loans, credit cards, and credit building tools.

Bright has launched an AI money assistant and AI agentic UX flows for access to credit. It will be the first AI-driven Consumer FinTech for middle-income consumers.

The Bright product suite has potential for global markets beyond the US. The market size is 100M global middle-income consumers, with a revenue pool opportunity of $15B.

Bright is backed by 3 top global venture capital firms, and leading tech angel investors in the USA, Europe, and Asia.

Bright was founded in 2019 by a founding team from McKinsey’s Banking Practice (Petko Plachkov and Avi Patchava) and InMobi Data Scientists (Varun Modi and Avi Patchava). The core team is ex-InMobi Engineering and Data Sciences, recently joined by senior leaders from McKinsey. Bright is a data-driven, fast-paced execution culture that will build a Global Consumer FinTech, all functions operating from India.'

**What is the team & role about?**

We are hiring a Platform Product Manager - Banking Platform to own and scale core banking and money-movement platform capabilities that power multiple financial products. This role focuses on bank account lifecycles, payment rails, partner integrations, and regulatory-ready infrastructure, enabling product teams to build reliably and at scale.

This is a senior product leadership role combining deep platform ownership, people management, executive-level communication, and structured problem-solving. You will operate as a trusted partner to Engineering leadership and CXOs, translating complex technical and regulatory challenges into clear decisions and execution plans.

**What will you do?**

**Product Ownership & Strategy**

* Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for one or more Banking Services platform domains (e.g., account onboarding, verification, bank transfers, settlements).
* Define clear product goals, success metrics, and trade-offs across reliability, compliance, and feature delivery.
* Manage the full product lifecycle—from discovery and requirements to launch, adoption, and optimization.

**Banking Infrastructure & Money Movement**

* Drive platform capabilities supporting bank account lifecycles and money movement (e.g., ACH equivalents, local bank transfers, instant payments, reconciliation workflows).
* Lead integrations with banking partners, payment processors, and financial infrastructure providers.
* Ensure strong handling of edge cases such as failures, retries, reversals, exceptions, and settlements.

**Compliance, Risk & Resilience**

* Translate regulatory, scheme, and partner constraints into clear platform requirements (e.g., auditability, controls, data retention, reporting).
* Partner with Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Operations to ensure controls are embedded into platform design.
* Drive platform resilience designing for partner outages, degraded modes, and recovery scenarios.

**Execution & Delivery**

* Write high-quality PRDs and platform requirements that engineers can execute against with clarity.
* Prioritize across run-the-business work, platform improvements, and new enablement initiatives.
* Lead cross-functional execution across multiple engineering teams.

**Stakeholder & Internal Customer Experience**

* Act as the product owner for internal consumers of the platform (Product, Engineering, Ops).
* Improve developer and internal product team experience through clear APIs, documentation, and self-serve capabilities.
* Communicate progress, risks, and decisions clearly to senior leadership.

**Ideal candidate profile looks like?**

**Experience & Background:**

* 5 - 12 years of Product Management experience, with strong exposure to backend, platform, or infrastructure products.
* Prior people management experience, including mentoring or managing Product Managers
* Exposure to high-scale, high-availability systems with strict SLAs.
* Strong understanding of APIs, distributed systems, data platforms, and cloud architectures.
* Strong systems thinking and technical fluency, comfortable working deeply with engineers on architecture and trade-offs.

**Mindset & Operating DNA:**

* Experience defining and using KPIs/OKRs to drive prioritization and outcomes.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Proven ability to manage complex dependencies and cross-functional stakeholders.

**Non-Fit Profiles:**

* Domain experts without Platform Ownership experience.
* PMs from Low-Scale or Low-Reliability Environments.
* Product Managers without deep technical depth.
* Pure UI/ UX-First Product Managers.
* Program Manager or Project Managers.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Experience building internal platforms or developer-facing products.
* Exposure to global-scale, high-availability systems.
* Experience in fintech, banking, payments, or other regulated systems.

**What Bright Offers?**

* A profitable sub-unicorn with U.S. market scale – liquidity potential at $1–3B valuations.
* Real ownership: You run your own BU with an independent P&L.
* Wealth creation: Equity at an inflection stage of scale.
* A data-driven, high-cadence culture that combines consulting rigor with FinTech speed.
* Location flexibility: 5 days from the Bangalore office in a week

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.description:
**The CoinDCX Journey: Building the Future of Finance:**
At CoinDCX, our mission is clear - to make crypto and blockchain accessible to every Indian and enable them to participate in the future of finance.
  
  
As India’s first crypto unicorn valued at $2.45B, we are reshaping the financial ecosystem by building safe, transparent, and scalable products that power adoption at scale.
  
  
We believe that change starts together. It begins with bold ideas, relentless execution and people who want to build what’s next.
  
  
If you’re driven by purpose and thrive in environments where your work defines the next chapter of an industry, you’ll feel right at home here.
  
  
**About the Role:**
This isn’t a typical Head of Product role. The expectation is not just to optimize flows, but to fundamentally redefine how trading works for millions of users. You’ll step in at a critical inflection point, owning the next phase of growth for a platform already operating at scale. This role is about expanding into new product frontiers, unlocking new opportunities, and building category-defining trading experiences. It’s a high-impact mandate to drive innovation and shape the future of trading at scale.
  
  
**What You’ll Do:**

* Lead a Product Management team focused on conceiving, building, and launching user-focused, high-quality products that connect and grow the crypto economy.
* Work closely with fellow engineering, design, and business leadership to define our product vision and strategy across your product areas, and deliver tangible business outcomes.
* Identifying and defining KPIs and metrics for the team to set targets and drive overall team performance.
* Hire, manage, and grow a team of Product Managers and help them to reach their potential.
* Execute efficiently in a fast-paced, fluid start-up environment where change is constant and creativity is a must.
* Driving a cross-functional team with engineering, design, support, and marketing to resolve end to end customer issues.

**You’ll Excel in This Role If You:**

* Trading experience in the past, with a strong understanding of financial markets—especially Indian markets—and a genuine passion to build and scale products in this space
* 14+ years of Product Management experience with 4+ years in scaling digital B2C products with customer first focus
* A deep understanding and appreciation for good design and user experience
* A track record of building exceptional products that delight your users and produce clear business impact
* Demonstrated ability to lead projects affecting many functions, including product, engineering, finance, compliance, and support.
* Ability to direct major cross-functional initiatives with effective prioritization and influence
* Experience collecting both internal and external customer feedback and requests, empathizing with their challenges and opportunities, and prioritizing roadmaps to optimize results
* Experience in A/B testing and in working with data analytics/data science teams to get metric driven analysis
* Worked in an agile environment or on the scrum methodology
* Passion for cryptocurrency, financial markets, and the CoinDCX mission
* Worked in an agile environment or on the scrum methodology
* Passion for cryptocurrency, financial markets, and the CoinDCX mission

**Good to have :**

* Experience working in regulated industries collaborating with legal, compliance, and customer support teams
* Experience in software development or a sound understanding of technical architecture

**Hiring Process:**
Here’s what your journey with us looks like:
  
  

* Application Review – We assess for skills, alignment, and intent
* Recruiter Connect – A short conversation to understand you better
* Functional Round(s) – Deep dive into your approach, craft, and problem-solving
* Assignment / Simulation Round – A take-home task or live problem-solving exercise to understand how you think and execute in real scenarios
* Culture & Values Discussion – A conversation to understand our ways of working and how you thrive best
* Founder Conversation (Optional) – For certain roles and senior levels, you may meet our founders to explore strategic alignment and long-term fit

**Where We Work:**
We believe the best ideas emerge when people build together. Collaboration, speed and trust come alive when teams share the same space.
  
  
With this belief, we operate as a work-from-office organisation. This role is based out of our
**Bengaluru**
office, where energy, alignment and innovation move in real time.
  
  
**Perks That Empower You:**
We believe great people deserve great experiences.
  
  

* Design Your Own Benefits: Flexible perks to match your lifestyle
* Unlimited Wellness Leaves: Rest and recharge as you need
* Mental Wellness Support: Access to therapy and wellness resources
* Learning Sessions: Bi-weekly learning and growth opportunities

**Ready to Build What’s Next?**
If you’re looking for a role that gives you direct access to high-stakes decisions, deep impact and a chance to build the future of finance, this is it.
  
  
Join CoinDCX and help us make crypto accessible to every Indian, together.

jobs.title: Project Finance Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

**Key responsibilities**

**Bid-stage financial support**

* Build bid cost models, project cash-flow projections and margin analysis. Challenge tendering and estimation teams on assumptions and problem solve with solution orientation.
* Evaluate payment terms, BG/LC requirements, taxes (GST, customs), LD exposure and working-capital impact before bid submission.

**Project budgeting and cost control**

* Set up WBS-based project budgets in the ERP at award and baseline them against the approved bid.
* Track Budget vs Actual monthly; flag cost overruns early and agree corrective actions with Heads of Projects (HoPs) and Central PMO.
* Lead quarterly Cost-to-Complete (CTC) and Estimate-at-Completion (EAC) reviews and obtain sign-offs.
* Track procurement savings, change orders, variations and claims against the budget.

**Revenue recognition and reporting**

* Own the project-level P&L for each project: budget vs actual, margin tracking, variance explanations and forecast to completion. Stay connected field teams to ensure facts and numbers are real while constructing project level P&Ls.
* Manage percentage-of-completion (POCM) revenue recognition and unbilled revenue under Ind AS 115.
* Prepare project P&L, cash-flow statements, MIS and flash reports for leadership and management during weekly, monthly & quarterly reviews.
* Support the Annual Operating Plan (AOP) and rolling forecasts for the project portfolio.

**Billing, collections and working capital**

* Track gross working capital (GWC) by project and prepare management review packs covering AR, AP, Unbilled Revenue (UBR), customer advances, supplier advances and inventory.
* Drive milestone billing, invoice accuracy and collection targets in line with contract payment terms.
* Run customer and vendor reconciliations; resolve billing disputes with clients and site teams along with central PMO and HoPs.
* Manage the lifecycle of bank guarantees (EMD, ABG, PBG, retention) and LCs, including timely release and reduction.
* Monitor receivables ageing, retention money, advance recovery and vendor payment cycles to optimise the cash conversion cycle.

**Risk monitoring and mitigation**

* Monitor contractual obligations, LDs, price-variation clauses, EOT claims and insurance across projects.
* Review the scope and adequacy of project insurance, including Erection All Risk (EAR) cover, and manage claims.
* Check statutory compliances at project sites, including BOCW registration and cess, labour licences and contractor compliances. Flag gaps with project and compliance teams for remedial measures.
* Support PMO and Contracts team in preparation of escalation and variation claims and the financial closure of completed projects.

**Controls and audit**

* Ensure project accounting is audit-ready; support statutory and internal audits.
* Conduct site stock reconciliations, inventory ageing reviews and provisioning.
* Strengthen SOPs and internal controls across procurement, site expenses and payments. Review and revise once in 6 months based on risk and on-the-ground execution.

**Value added projects**

* Build and maintain project finance dashboards (Power BI or similar) and automate recurring reports, including use of AI tools.

  

**Qualifications and experience**

**Must have**

* Chartered Accountant (CA) or Cost & Management Accountant (CMA / ICWA).
* 3 to 10 years of total post-qualification experience.
* At least 3 years in project accounting / project finance at a Tier-1 EPC or project-execution company such as L&T, Tata Power, Tata Projects, Sterlite Power, Jakson or Sterling & Wilson.
* Hands-on POCM revenue recognition, CTC/EAC reviews and project MIS on multi-crore EPC projects.
* Working experience of SAP (FICO and PS preferred) or an equivalent ERP with WBS-based project budgeting.
* Owner mindset. Taking charge and driving end to end closures.
* Independence: Being thorough and confident to challenge business teams based on facts & reason.

**Good to have**

* Exposure to solar, BESS, T&D or other power-sector EPC projects.
* Experience handling BGs, LCs and customer billing disputes directly with clients.
* Site-level exposure to project finance and stock reconciliation.
* MBA (Finance) in addition to CA / CMA.

jobs.title: Senior .Net Developer
jobs.description:
Tieto Banktech powers some of the Nordics most trusted banking systems with secure, reliable, and scalable solutions. Using automation, data, AI, and cloud, supported by hands-on guidance, we help banks modernize their core, strengthen trust, and deliver greater impact across the banking experience.

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer who is both hands-on and strategic, to play a pivotal role in modernizing and leading the development of our Equity post-trade platform. Working closely with the Product Manager, you will spend the majority of your time coding while shaping the architecture, mentoring the team, and driving the transition from legacy monolithic systems to modular, maintainable, and scalable solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Hands-on Development: Architect, design, and implement robust solutions, with a focus on RESTful APIs, microservices, and domain-driven design.
* Legacy Modernization: Lead the refactoring of monolithic, DB-driven systems, lifting business logic out of stored procedures into modular and maintainable components.
* Technical Leadership: Mentor and guide a distributed engineering team (Stockholm & Pune), promoting best practices, clean code, and technical excellence.
* Architecture Strategy: Collaborate with Product Manager to define and implement a technical roadmap aligned with business goals.
* Quality & Resilience: Drive initiatives to improve code quality, reliability, and maintainability in complex systems.
* Business Collaboration: Translate complex business workflows into technical solutions while balancing speed, scalability, and risk.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Strong programming experience in SQL, C#, and .NET, with a track record of hands-on coding in production systems.
* Proven experience in API design, microservices architecture, and domain-driven design.
* Track record of driving technical transformation in legacy systems.
* Demonstrated ability to modernize legacy, DB-heavy systems, refactor monolithic codebases, and implement modular architectures.
* Experience leading and mentoring distributed teams, fostering knowledge sharing and technical growth.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, cloud platforms (Azure), Git, and DevOps practices.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.
* Experience in Equity post-trade or Capital Markets systems.
* Understanding of equity trading workflows and complex business scenarios.
* Minimum 7 years of experience working on enterprise-level solutions.
* Hands-on experience with containerization technologies (Docker/Kubernetes) and cloud-native architectures.
* Experience working in a product organization with strong collaboration between tech and business.

**We Offer**

We offer a unique opportunity to shape the architecture of a critical banking platform, work on meaningful projects, and influence a growing, distributed team. You will have the freedom to be hands-on while also driving modernization, supported by an open culture, flexible hybrid work model, and a focus on continuous learning.

Interested?

We look forward to receiving your application! Interviews will be held continuously, so we encourage you to apply today. For more information or questions, please contact Krishna.kumari@tieto.com

We perform background checks on all final candidates.

**Job Title:** **Senior AI Platform Engineer**

  

**Overview**

We are looking for a Senior AI Platform Engineer to help design, develop, and expand our internal AI platform, supporting cybersecurity analysts through intelligent workflows, automation, integrations, and AI-assisted capabilities.

The role involves building scalable AI-driven services, integrating with enterprise security technologies, and contributing to the evolution of a modern platform that combines software engineering, cloud services, artificial intelligence, and cybersecurity.

The ideal candidate enjoys solving complex technical problems, can work across multiple technologies, and is comfortable learning new tools and frameworks as the platform evolves.

**Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain AI-driven platform capabilities.
* Build scalable backend services and APIs.
* Develop workflow orchestration and automation capabilities.
* Design integrations with enterprise security and operational platforms.
* Build connectors to third-party products and cloud services.
* Develop reusable components and SDKs that can be shared across multiple applications.
* Contribute to platform architecture, design discussions, and technical direction.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies and determine how they can be incorporated into the platform.
* Work closely with security analysts to understand operational challenges and translate them into technical solutions.
* Produce maintainable, well-tested, and well-documented code.
* Participate in technical reviews and architectural discussions.

**Required Skills**

**Software Engineering**

* Strong software engineering fundamentals.
* Experience designing modular, maintainable systems.
* Experience building REST APIs and backend services.
* Experience developing reusable libraries or frameworks.
* Experience working with asynchronous and event-driven systems.
* Strong debugging and problem-solving skills.

**Development**

Strong experience in one or more modern software development technologies, such as:

* Python
* TypeScript
* Go

Experience learning new languages, frameworks, and technologies quickly is considered equally valuable.

**Artificial Intelligence**

Experience working with modern AI technologies, including some of the following:

* Large Language Models (LLMs)
* AI agents
* Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG)
* Prompt engineering
* Structured outputs
* AI workflow orchestration
* Model evaluation
* AI governance and safety

Experience with multiple AI providers is desirable.

**Cloud & Platform Engineering**

Experience with cloud-native development, such as Azure or AWS, including:

* Storage services
* Authentication and identity
* Queues or messaging
* Serverless or container-based workloads
* Monitoring and observability
* Secure application development

**API & Integration Development**

Experience integrating with third-party platforms using REST APIs, SDKs, or webhooks.

**Security**

* SIEM
* SOAR
* Identity and Access Management
* Threat Detection
* Incident Response

**Desirable Experience**

* Experience designing workflow engines or orchestration systems.
* Experience developing SDKs or internal developer platforms.
* Experience with vector search or semantic search.
* Experience working with structured data pipelines.
* Experience designing scalable cloud architectures.
* Experience contributing to technical strategy and architecture.

* Is naturally curious and enjoys learning new technologies.
* Can work independently while collaborating effectively with others.
* Takes ownership of technical problems from concept through implementation.
* Thinks beyond individual features and considers long-term platform design.
* Is pragmatic and balances innovation with maintainability.
* Communicates technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**What Success Looks Like**

The successful candidate will help evolve the platform by:

* Designing robust, reusable platform capabilities.
* Building high-quality integrations with enterprise technologies.
* Delivering AI-enabled workflows that solve real operational problems.
* Contributing to the long-term architecture and technical direction of the platform.
* Helping establish engineering standards and best practices as the platform grows.

**Who We Are Looking For**
We are looking for an experienced leader with a strong track record in AML/KYC operations and transformation to provide senior leadership within the Global AML Center (GAC) in Hyderabad.
  
  
As part of the GAC leadership team, you will own delivery & transformation across AML/KYC portfolios - onboarding, event-driven reviews, periodic reviews, screening and quality assurance. You will also help shape and drive GAC’s strategic agenda. That means leading technology-enabled change, automation and AI adoption to build a scalable, standardized and data-led operating model. You will also take on Chief Administrative Officer (CAO) responsibilities for GAC: overseeing business management, budget and headcount planning, governance, and the site and people agenda in Hyderabad. You will balance strong day-to-day delivery with a clear view of where the function needs to be in the future.
  
  
**Why this role is important to us**
The Global AML Center carries out AML/KYC activities as part of State Street’s global AML operating model. This includes Customer Identification Program (CIP), Customer Due Diligence (CDD), Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD), customer verification and customer risk rating across all business areas. Hyderabad is a key part of GAC’s global footprint.
  
  
Volumes, regulatory expectations and methodology changes keep growing, and adding capacity alone is not a sustainable answer. This role is central to changing how GAC operates: cutting manual effort, strengthening controls through technology and data, and positioning GAC as a strategic partner to the business rather than a purely operational function. As GAC grows, it also needs strong business management discipline: clear financial and headcount oversight, consistent governance, and a well-run site and people agenda.
  
  
**What You Will Be Responsible For**
As Vice President you will:
  
  
***Operational Leadership***

* Provide senior leadership for GAC operations in Hyderabad and act as a key point of contact for local India management and global stakeholders
* Own end-to-end delivery across assigned AML/KYC portfolios against agreed service, quality, risk and productivity standards
* Keep active oversight of volumes, pipeline, ageing and capacity, and raise emerging pressure before it affects delivery or compliance
* Set clear priorities across BAU, new business, remediation and regulatory commitments, and move resources as demand changes

***Strategy & Technology Change***

* Help shape GAC’s strategic direction and multi-year transformation roadmap, in line with business growth, regulatory change and the target operating model
* Lead strategic change initiatives from idea through to delivery and adoption, with clear business cases, measurable outcomes and benefits tracking
* Act as the business lead for technology change, working with Technology, product and change teams on enhancements to KYC platforms, workflow tools and data capability
* Identify and drive opportunities for automation, AI, digitization and workflow integration that reduce manual effort, improve turnaround times and strengthen controls
* Champion data-led decision making through better MI, dashboards and real-time visibility of pipeline, risk and performance
* Make sure process, policy and methodology changes are turned into sustainable system and operational changes, reducing reliance on manual workarounds
* Prioritize the change portfolio and balance investment, capacity and risk to deliver the greatest business value
* Build a culture of innovation and continuous improvement, and grow change and digital capability within the team

***Business Management & CAO***

* Act as CAO for GAC, partnering with the GAC Head on business management, planning and execution of the leadership agenda
* Lead annual budget, headcount and workforce planning, including capacity models, run-rate tracking, attrition and backfill planning
* Track expenses, productivity and cost efficiency, and support business cases for investment and location strategy
* Run the GAC management operating rhythm, including leadership meetings, governance forums, management reporting and executive or board materials
* Coordinate senior stakeholder and regulatory reporting, ensuring information is accurate, consistent and on time
* Track key initiatives, decisions and actions across the leadership team, making sure commitments are followed through
* Oversee administrative controls, including policies and procedures, entitlements and access, business continuity and resilience planning
* Partner with HR, Finance, Procurement, Real Estate and Technology on hiring, onboarding, workforce management, space and infrastructure
* Lead the Hyderabad site and culture agenda, including employee engagement, communications, town halls, recognition and talent programs

***Risk, Control & Governance***

* Maintain a strong control environment in line with AML/KYC policies, procedures and regulatory requirements
* Identify and address emerging operational and regulatory risks before they affect the business, and escalate where needed
* Ensure new technology, automation and AI solutions are put in place with appropriate controls, governance and risk oversight
* Support audit, regulatory and governance requirements

***Stakeholder Leadership***

* Work with Business Units, Compliance, Technology and Risk teams to resolve dependencies, close control gaps and drive accountability
* Represent GAC in senior forums with clear, fact-based views on delivery, strategy, risk, capacity and the decisions required
* Influence senior stakeholders to secure support and investment for strategic and technology initiatives

***People Leadership***

* Attract, develop and retain strong talent, and build leadership depth and succession across the Hyderabad organization
* Hold managers and teams accountable for outcomes while empowering them to make decisions, and create opportunities for them to realize their full potential
* Lead teams through change, building adoption and new ways of working

**What We Value**
These skills will help you succeed in this role
  
  

* Strong understanding of KYC/CDD/EDD, client onboarding, periodic reviews, screening and financial crime controls
* Strategic thinking: the ability to set direction and turn a long-term vision into executable plans
* A proven track record of leading technology-enabled transformation, automation or digital change in a regulated environment
* An understanding of how workflow platforms, data, automation and AI can redesign operating models
* Proven ability to lead large, complex teams, including managing other managers
* A forward-looking approach to risk, with the ability to anticipate issues rather than react to them
* Strong analytical skills, with experience using MI, KPIs and capacity data to drive decisions
* Excellent interpersonal, communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to challenge constructively
* Strong business management and financial acumen, including budgeting, headcount and workforce planning
* Ability to run a disciplined management rhythm and produce clear executive and board-level materials
* A collaborative leadership style that balances empowerment with accountability

**Education & Preferred Qualifications**

* 15+ years of relevant experience in AML/KYC, financial crime or operations within a large global financial institution
* Demonstrated experience leading strategic transformation and technology change programs, from business case to adoption
* Significant senior people leadership experience, including leading leaders
* Experience in business management role, including budget, headcount and governance ownership, is strongly preferred
* Bachelor’s degree required
* Strong knowledge of global AML/KYC regulatory requirements
* Experience with KYC workflow platforms (e.g., Fenergo/FenX), automation tools or AI solutions is an advantage

jobs.title: Manager, IT Delivery
jobs.description:
**About Vanguard**
Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.
  
  
**Vanguard India**
Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world-class experience for our clients.
  
  
**Role Summary**
The Manager, IT Delivery is responsible for leading high-performing data and technology teams and delivering strategic data initiatives that generate measurable business value.
  
  
This role combines people leadership, product delivery, stakeholder management, and operational oversight. The manager will lead teams operating across data engineering, data platforms, data warehousing, data lakes, data governance, data quality, and analytics.
  
  
The manager will have end-to-end accountability for the development, delivery, maintenance, production support, reliability, and continuous improvement of data products. The successful candidate will bring strong leadership and communication capabilities, experience managing product-oriented teams, and a sound understanding of modern data ecosystems. The role requires the ability to translate business priorities into executable delivery plans, develop engineering talent, manage delivery commitments, and ensure the scalability, quality, security, and reliability of data solutions.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead, coach, and develop high-performing data and technology teams, including hiring, performance management, workforce planning, and talent development.
* Drive delivery of strategic initiatives across data engineering, data warehousing, data lakes / lakehouses, data integration, data governance, data quality, analytics, and business intelligence.
* Partner with business, product, architecture, and engineering stakeholders to translate priorities into product roadmaps, delivery plans, and measurable outcomes.
* Lead product-oriented teams with end-to-end accountability for the development, delivery, maintenance, production support, reliability, and continuous improvement of data products.
* Drive Agile practices, including intake management, backlog prioritization, estimation, sprint and release planning, and delivery governance.
* Manage capacity planning, resource forecasting, delivery commitments, risks, issues, and cross-team dependencies to enable predictable execution.
* Ensure data solutions are scalable, secure, reliable, reusable, and compliant with applicable technology, risk, privacy, and information security standards.
* Promote effective data governance, data quality, metadata management, lineage, ownership, and stewardship practices.
* Monitor delivery, quality, and operational health through relevant metrics, and provide clear, concise updates to stakeholders and leadership.
* Foster strong stakeholder relationships and communicate complex data and technology topics effectively to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Promote automation, standardization, engineering excellence, cost optimization, and modern data practices, including cloud and AI-enabled capabilities.
* Drive a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, continuous learning, and business-outcome ownership.
* Provide leadership during major incidents and critical production events, partnering with support and engineering teams to drive timely resolution, stakeholder communication, and service recovery while ensuring operational continuity.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* Minimum 10+ years of experience in technology delivery, software engineering, data platforms, or IT services, including people leadership experience.
* Proven experience leading teams in a product-based environment with responsibility for delivery execution and stakeholder management.
* Strong understanding of Agile delivery practices, backlog management, sprint planning, and Jira.
* Experience leading data-focused technology initiatives, including data engineering, analytics, data quality, governance, or modern data platforms.
* Strong people leadership, coaching, and talent development skills.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and influencing abilities.
* Demonstrated ability to drive execution, manage ambiguity, solve complex problems, and lead organisational change.
* Ability to understand technical concepts and effectively partner with engineering teams to deliver business outcomes.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in financial services or other highly regulated industries.
* Exposure to cloud-based data platforms and AI-enabled technology initiatives.
* Agile, Scrum, PMP, SAFe, or related certifications preferred.
* Experience leading cloud data platform, data modernization, or platform transformation initiatives.
* Experience managing geographically distributed or cross-functional teams.
* Familiarity with industry-standard cloud, data engineering, analytics, governance, and data quality technologies.

**Key Success Factors**

* Experience in data-centric technology environments.
* Ability to build, scale, and lead high-performing teams.
* Sound understanding of data engineering, data platforms, governance, quality, and analytics.
* Strong product and Agile delivery leadership.
* Effective capacity planning, forecasting, and execution management.
* Ownership and accountability for delivery and operational outcomes.
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication.
* Ability to connect data and technology investments to business outcomes.
* Ability to operate effectively in a complex, cross-functional environment.
* Commitment to engineering quality, operational excellence, risk management, and continuous improvement.

**Location**
This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered.
  
  
**Our mission**
Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.
  
  
**Our commitment to you**
**Benefits**
Vanguard takes the same long-term view of your success—at work and in life—with Benefits and Rewards packages that reflect what you care about, throughout all the phases and stages of your life. Our Total Rewards programs provide you and your loved ones with wellness support for key areas in your life:
  
  
**Financial wellness**
We're committed to enabling your financial success and provide competitive offers and programs.
  
  
**Physical wellness**
We're committed to providing benefits that support your physical health and wellness.
  
  
**Personal wellness**
We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life.
  
  
**How We Work**
Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for most of our employees (crew members), designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

**Description**
Amazon built world-class finance and accounting machinery to run its own business at scale. Finance as a Service (FaaS) is turning that machinery into a product: end-to-end back-office finance and accounting, delivered to sellers and partners as a service. Customers get Amazon-grade accuracy, controllership, and compliance without building it themselves. We run accounts payable, accounts receivable, record-to-report, and tax operations for a growing roster customers today.
  
  
The systems that power FaaS today are highly specialized, built to run Amazon's own books and in many ways add odds what other businesses really want and need. FaaS as a product will benefit from an operations stack built with multi-tenancy, data isolation, multi-auditor control support built into its foundation from the start. FaaS must scale from large multinationals down to small local business, and its technology must be similarly geared. Scaling FaaS into a durable business requires a deliberate long-term strategy, and this includes the technology that powers it.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Work collaboratively, shape the vision and strategy in building the product and solving business problems.
* Design scalable and secure systems that handle sensitive financial data.
* Mentor and grow the team while delivering with quality.
* Deep dive, develop and deliver systems that are highly maintainable. Technical leader for the team with the ability to deliver against all odds.
* Data driven approach for making right architecture decisions while managing business priorities.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of engineering team management experience
* 7+ years of engineering experience
* 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
* Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
* Experience partnering with product or program management teams
* Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
