jobs.title: Director, Product Management, Context Engine
jobs.description:
**Our Company:**
At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
As Director of Product Management, you will own the strategy, roadmap, and measurable outcomes for the capabilities that let Teradata's Enterprise Context Engine understand customer data on its own: schema and ontology discovery, natural language processing, and AI driven workflow and policy extraction. The Context Engine extracts, curates, and continuously improves metadata and business context, grounded in Teradata's industry knowledge models, so that human analysts move faster and AI agents are grounded in trusted enterprise meaning.
  
  
You will serve as the Context Engine's senior product leader in the region and partner closely with local engineering, data science, and architecture teams along with product and engineering leaders across the US. You will set direction, make prioritization decisions, and hold your team accountable for customer outcomes, from discovery and design through launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Product Strategy, Roadmap & Outcomes**

* Own the roadmap knowledge graph completion / Ontology Learning, Reflexion-based memory extraction, and reinforcement learning-focused feature sets within the Context Engine portfolio. Translate customer needs and business priorities into clear requirements, prioritization decisions, and success criteria.
* Act as the primary touchpoint and evangelist for Context Engine to customers, executives, and field teams in the APJ region.
* Define how these capabilities are reusable by and drive value across Teradata products, personas, and business domains, and across hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
* Shape the competitive position and differentiation of the Context Engine against competitors such as Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft, Google, and emerging AI data platform and semantic layer vendors.

**Automated Workflow Assembly**

* Define the product vision for automatically assembling workflows from discovered schemas and semantics, including data preparation, mapping, validation, enrichment, and publication of context, without hand-built pipelines for each customer.
* Specify how agents plan, compose, and execute these workflows, including reusable workflow templates, orchestration, approval checkpoints, and rollback.
* Set requirements for observability, explainability, and auditability so that customers can see why a workflow was assembled the way it was and trust what it produced.
* Define how workflows and discovered context are exposed to external agents and frameworks through Model Context Protocol (MCP) and other open agent interfaces.

**How Success Is Measured**

* Customer adoption and production deployments of semantic extraction and automated workflow capabilities, including successful agent and application consumption of the context they produce.
* Discovery and mapping quality: accuracy, coverage, and confidence calibration of discovered schemas, relationships, and semantic mappings, and the share accepted by stewards without correction.
* Automation outcomes: reduction in time and manual effort to onboard a new customer data estate and reach usable context, and the share of workflows assembled and run without hand-built pipelines.
* Platform usability as measured by targeted KPIs and customer sentiment.
* Pipeline influence, win-rate contribution, and analyst and customer perception of Teradata's context and trusted-AI position.

**What Makes You a Qualified Candidate**

* Bachelor's degree and 12+ years of experience, including 6+ years in product management or equivalent technical product leadership, with 4+ years on enterprise NLP, search, or metadata and data discovery platforms.
* Hands-on experience with NLP and LLM-based applications such as entity and concept extraction, semantic matching, embeddings, and natural language grounding to structured data, including how to evaluate them.
* Experience with BPMN 2. 0 structured workflows, and a demonstrable record of bringing agentic AI solutions from concept to production.
* Working familiarity with ontology and knowledge graph concepts, and with how graph-based context is consumed by retrieval and agent systems.
* Experience with utilizing agent self-learning approaches such as Reflexion, Reflective learning (ERL), or similar approaches to verbal reinforcement learning to improve agents in response to events and encounters in production systems.

**Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata**
We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are an anti-racist company because our dedication to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is more than a statement. It is a deep commitment to doing the work to foster an equitable environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.
  
  
Teradata invites all identities and backgrounds in the workplace. We work with deliberation and intent to ensure we are cultivating collaboration and inclusivity across our global organization. ​ We are proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, ancestry, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related conditions), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, gender identity or expression, military and veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: VP Client Relationship Servicing
jobs.description:
**Some Careers Shine Brighter Than Others.**
If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
**VP Client Relationship Servicing(CRS)**
CIB COO delivers strategic execution for the CIB businesses across the globe. Through transformative data and digital solutions, customer servicing throughout the customer lifecycle, and delivering safe growth supported by non-financial risk expertise, we collaborate across the global businesses and global functions to get it done. Client Authorities & Confirmation Services (CACS) is part of the CIB CRS supporting CIB business by handling customer servicing requests across two journeys – Client Authorities and Audit Confirmation Services. Beyond day-to-day operations leadership, the role holder is the Service Delivery Lead for the end-to-end transformation of CACS team journeys - a critical, dual-mandate accountability that combines run-the-bank operations leadership with change-the-bank delivery ownership. This includes supporting the deployment of global technology solutions, working hand-in-hand with the Transformation function on requirements definition and testing, and directly shaping the future-state operating and technology architecture for CACS.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Own the end-to-end client experience for Audit Confirmations and Mandates/Authorities journeys, acting as the single point of accountability across the full process rather than for individual process steps. Redesign and simplify the CACS operating model to minimise handoffs and touchpoints between teams, reducing cycle time, rework and risk of error at each handover. Use client feedback, complaints and journey/turnaround-time analytics to identify friction points in the end-to-end process and prioritise fixes accordingly.
* Own and drive delivery of Client Authorities & Confirmation Services, objectives and key results (OKRs) aligned to CIB CRS priorities. Act as a primary point of contact and coordinator for relevant CIB Servicing Business Stakeholders and partner teams supporting CIB customers. Partner with business stakeholders to shape and agree the service proposition, including management information, service performance, and service level agreements (SLAs).
* Act as the Service Delivery Lead for the end-to-end transformation of CACS team journeys, owning the CACS-side accountability for translating business and client needs into deliverable, adopted technology outcomes. Drive the digital change agenda to improve customer experience, reduce operational effort across the end-to-end customer journey, and support and/or lead delivery of strategic tooling and automation initiatives (e.g., digital workflow and AI-enabled solutions) to enable the future-state servicing architecture and its adoption.
* Partner closely with the global Transformation function throughout the delivery lifecycle — defining and prioritising business requirements, validating solution design against operational reality, and sequencing releases against CACS servicing priorities.
* Own User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for CACS-impacting releases: design test scenarios, coordinate subject-matter-expert testers from the operations team, triage and track defects, and provide formal sign-off ahead of go-live. Track and report transformation milestones, risks, dependencies and benefits realisation to CIB CRS leadership, ensuring the CACS journey transformation stays aligned to global programme timelines. Champion change adoption within the CACS team — ensuring readiness, training, communication and embedding of new tools and ways of working through go-live and hypercare.
* Provide leadership across a diverse, multi-location and/or virtual team environment, driving performance to global standards in a matrix structure. Act as the primary representative for Client Authorities & Confirmation Services for the relevant value stream and stakeholders. Build a culture of continuous improvement, collaboration, pace and accountability, ensuring teams understand priorities, processes and expected outcomes. Lead, coach, and develop a large team of specialists, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and professional growth.

**To Be Successful You Will**

* Proven ability to run a large, multi-market teams across geographies and operating effectively across cultures and diverse working environments. Comfortable partnering with technology/ transformation teams to shape and adopt new tools – doesn’t need to run the transformation just needs to engage credibly and hold the CACS team accountable for adoption.
* Track record of client-centric decision-making prioritising client outcome over internal convenience. Demonstrable communication and presentation skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts and drive alignment between operations, technology and client-facing audiences.
* Strong commercial mindset, including financial management capability and business acumen. Proven leadership and team management skills, with a focus on developing and motivating team members and experience in managing large, virtual teams. A natural go getter who moves things forward rather than escalating and waiting.
* Energised by ambiguity and comfortable running BAU, people, transformation agendas in parallel. Dedicated to being an early adopter of new technology and nurturing and environment where teams are excited to pilot new ways of working and technologies in the pursuit of sustainable improvements. Comfortable operating at the intersection of operations and technology, translating business needs into clear, testable requirements. Client-first mindset — instinctively thinks in terms of the client's end-to-end experience rather than individual internal process steps.
* Resilient under competing priorities and reprioritises on their own rather than needing structure imposed direction. CIB CRS / Servicing Operations leadership and regional/country teams. CIB CRS – Global and Regional Leads. Product partners and product teams (Trade, GPS, Credit) supporting CIB clients. Global Transformation and Technology delivery teams (product owners, business analysts, engineering) supporting servicing transformation and tooling. Control functions and key partners as required to support safe, compliant servicing delivery

We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. **Description**
**Who is USP?**
The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high-quality medicines worldwide.
  
  
At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.
  
  
USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.
  
  
**Brief Job Overview**
The Director of Product Management is a managerial position that supports the global growth of USP’s material products including Reference Standards, Analytical Reference Materials, Pharmaceutical Analytical Impurities, Certified Reference Materials and the Materials Strategy Program across the USP Novel Medicines, Generics, and Consumer Health business units.
  
  
**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**
As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence-based decision-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.
  
  
Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results-driven work environments.
  
  
**The Director, Product Management Has The Following Responsibilities**
Product Strategy, Portfolio, and Business Leadership
  
  

* Define and lead the long-term product, portfolio, and pipeline strategy, ensuring alignment with corporate growth objectives, market opportunities, and financial targets.
* Own portfolio performance and financial outcomes, providing executive leadership with strategic insights, scenario analyses, and recommendations to inform investment, resource allocation, and growth decisions.
* Champion the development and approval of business cases for strategic investments, new product platforms, portfolio expansions, and lifecycle initiatives, balancing market opportunity, risk, and return.
* Direct portfolio prioritization and optimization activities, ensuring resources are focused on the highest-value opportunities while balancing customer needs, operational capabilities, and profitability objectives.
* Establish governance frameworks for product selection, portfolio rationalization, and lifecycle decisions to maximize portfolio health, competitive positioning, and margin performance.
* Lead the development and execution of product roadmaps that drive sustainable growth, innovation, and organizational priorities across short-, medium-, and long-term planning horizons.
* Define portfolio performance metrics and operating mechanisms to monitor business results, forecast accuracy, customer adoption, and strategic goal attainment.
* Ensure organizational readiness and business continuity through proactive identification and mitigation of supply, demand, operational, and market risks.
* Serve as a strategic advisor to senior leadership by bringing a deep understanding of customer needs, market dynamics, and organizational priorities into decision-making.
* Sponsor customer and market insight initiatives to strengthen strategic planning, innovation, and commercial decision-making.

Market, Customer & Competitive Intelligence

**Job Summary**  
The Project Manager (PM) is responsible for managing and delivering consulting projects to Fortune 1000 Customers. He/ She will be owing client engagements and executing these projects parallel till closure. The PM is also responsible for creating project plans, executing those and delivering on time with high quality, value and with customer delight. This is a highly visible and complex role since the candidate will be the point of contact and work with executives and users across the entire organization working on multiple accounts. The successful candidate must be extremely well organized, focusses on details, process-oriented, quality- minded and has the ability to articulate in written/verbal form. He/ she will not only use the existing methodologies/ templates for effective project execution, but also have the opportunity to recommend process improvements.   
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Handle a portfolio of projects and clients in parallel from Fortune 1000 companies and across geographies.
* Own end-to-end delivery accountability, including project initiation, planning, execution, governance, customer adoption, value realization, and successful project closure.  Establish and maintain strong relationships with product delivery, the sales team, client and account managers.
* Build and maintain strategic relationships with customers, account executives, solution consultants, and delivery leadership.
* Manage stakeholder expectations, resolve escalations, and drive alignment across diverse business and technical teams.

* Bachelor or Master’s Degree (preferably from a top reputed university), with Project Management certification.

**What You’ll Get**

* Competitive salary.
* Fun-filled work culture (https://www.highradius.com/culture/)

* Influence strategic decisions through technology insights, data-driven recommendations, and strong business partnerships.

jobs.description:
Designation: Chief Manager

Location: India Tamil Nadu Adyar - Chennai

Organization: Financial Services

**Job Description:**
--------------------

**Job Title**
=============

**Zonal Sales Manager (South) - IndusInd Bank Affluent & NRI Channel**

**Location**
------------

South India (Chennai) handles all four states of South.

**Reporting To**
----------------

National Sales Head - IndusInd Bank Relationship

**Role Purpose**
================

Lead the South India region for ABSLI's strategic partnership with IndusInd Bank's Affluent, HNI, and NRI Banking segments. The incumbent will be responsible for driving life insurance penetration across the bank's affluent customer base by building strong engagement with banking leadership, enhancing frontline capability, driving sales productivity, and ensuring sustainable business growth.

The role requires deep expertise in bancassurance, wealth management, relationship selling, and team leadership to establish ABSLI as the preferred insurance partner within IndusInd's affluent banking ecosystem.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

### **Business Development & Revenue Growth**

* Drive insurance sales across Affluent, Imperia, HNI, and NRI customer segments.
* Deliver annualized premium targets (APE/FYP) for South India.
* Increase wallet share within the affluent customer base.
* Build a robust opportunity pipeline from wealth, investment, and protection-led discussions.
* Drive high-ticket and protection-focused product penetration.

### **Relationship Management**

* Manage relationships with Zonal Heads, Regional Heads, Cluster Heads, and Wealth Leaders of IndusInd Bank.
* Position ABSLI as a strategic partner within the bank's affluent business model.
* Conduct regular business reviews with banking stakeholders.
* Ensure alignment of branch priorities with insurance business objectives.

### **Team Leadership**

* Lead a team of Regional Managers and Relationship Managers across South India.
* Drive productivity and capability building.
* Coach teams on HNI sales conversations and financial planning discussions.
* Build a high-performance sales culture.

### **Capability Development**

* Upskill bank relationship managers on:
  + Financial protection planning
  + Estate planning solutions
  + Retirement planning
  + Wealth transfer concepts
  + NRI insurance solutions
  Tax-efficient insurance products

### **Sales Governance**

* Ensure compliance with IRDAI regulations.
* Monitor suitability and quality parameters.
* Drive persistency and customer retention.
* Maintain healthy business mix and reduce concentration risks.

### **Customer Engagement**

* Conduct HNI customer meets, wealth seminars, and investment forums.
* Participate in client acquisition and portfolio review events.
* Engage with key customers for large-ticket closures.

**Key Result Areas (KRAs)**
===========================

**KRA**

  
  

New Business Premium (APE/FYP) Achievement

  
  

Affluent & HNI Customer Acquisition

  
  

Product Mix & Protection Penetration

  
  

Active Branch Productivity

  
  

Banker Activation & Engagement

  
  

Team Productivity & Retention

  
  

Persistency & Quality Metrics

  
  

Stakeholder Relationship

  
  

**Critical Challenges of the Role**
===================================

### **1. New Partnership Establishment**

* Building mindshare and trust for ABSLI within an existing banking ecosystem.
Competing with legacy bancassurance relationships and established insurers.  

### **2. Affluent Customer Expectations**

* HNI and NRI customers demand advisory-led conversations rather than transactional selling.
Higher scrutiny on product suitability and value proposition.  

### **3. Banker Engagement**

* Securing mindshare from affluent bankers already focused on liabilities, investments, and AUM acquisition.
Maintaining insurance visibility amidst competing priorities.  

### **4. Geographic Complexity**

* Managing multiple states, languages, and diverse customer demographics across South India.

### **5. High Ticket Closure Cycles**

Longer sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders, family members, and financial advisors.  



### **6. Wealth vs Protection Balance**

* Driving sustainable protection business while meeting premium targets.
Avoiding overdependence on single-premium or investment-oriented sales.  

### **7. NRI Business Development**

Navigating regulatory processes, documentation requirements, and customer accessibility challenges.  



### **8. Talent & Capability Building**

* Developing teams capable of engaging affluent customers on sophisticated financial planning topics.

**Desired Candidate Profile**
=============================

### **Experience**

* 10-15+ years in Wealth Bancassurance.
* Minimum 5 years in a leadership role.
* Strong experience with HNI, Emerging Affluent, Wealth, or NRI segments.
Proven track record of managing large geographies and partnerships.  

### **Preferred Background**

* Bancassurance leadership.
* Insurance distribution leadership.

### **Key Skills**

* Strategic Sales Leadership
* Wealth & Protection Planning
* Stakeholder Management
* Relationship Management
* Team Development
* Negotiation & Influence
* Business Planning
* Data-Driven Sales Management

**Success Profile (First 12 Months)**
=====================================

The ZSM should be able to:

* Establish ABSLI as a preferred insurance partner within IndusInd's Affluent Banking ecosystem.
* Activate 80-90% of targeted affluent banking locations in South India.
* Build a strong pipeline of HNI/NRI business.
* Deliver target APE/FYP with healthy protection mix.
* Develop a high-performing regional sales team.
* Create sustainable banker engagement and referral generation mechanisms.

jobs.title: Vice President - Business Management, Design Strategy & Operations
jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Our Business Management team acts as a trusted advisor to senior leaders and optimizes business performance by helping to drive key initiatives. We act as a counterweight to business and group heads and are responsible for identifying, escalating, and mitigating business risks. The role is dynamic and can vary from business to business, in line with the priorities of different lines of business. This is a time-pressured and high-profile position, instrumental in assisting and advising senior management. You will help coordinate the deployment of corporate resources to address strategic and tactical objectives.

Job summary

As a **Business Management** professional within the **Business Management team**, you will help drive strategic and tactical objectives by coordinating corporate resources and advising senior management. You will implement new business strategy, strategic initiatives, or platforms by aligning partners across Finance, Technology, Operations, Legal, and Compliance. You will optimize bottom-line performance by driving key initiatives related to fees, cost base, risk-weighted assets, and capital utilization. You will identify, escalate, and mitigate business risks that could impair the ability to do business, including legal, tax, regulatory, capacity issues, and extraordinary transaction costs. You will partner across functions to define future workflows and implement related technology and infrastructure projects to support an evolving market structure.

Job responsibilities

* **Implement** new business strategy, strategic initiatives, or platforms, including aligning department and support groups (Finance, Technology, Operations, Legal, Compliance)
* **Optimize** bottom-line business performance by driving key initiatives (fees, cost base, risk-weighted assets, and capital utilization)
* **Identify** business risks that could impair the ability to do business and **escalate and mitigate** those risks (e.g., legal, tax, regulatory, capacity issues, extraordinary transaction costs)
* **Analyze** financial performance, including expenses; **identify** productivity initiatives and **drive** implementation
* **Partner** with the business, Operations, and Technology to define future workflows and **implement** related technology and infrastructure projects to prepare for evolving market structure requirements
* **Partner** with relevant external service and infrastructure providers
* **Represent** the business in internal and external working groups

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or other related area
* Previous product knowledge and/or prior Business Management or Chief Operating Officer experience
* Energetic and dynamic style
* Highly motivated self-starter with excellent time management and prioritization skills
* Ability to present well to senior and global business heads
* Ability to forge strong internal relationships across a broad range of functions
* Self-motivated, tenacious, and able to work with a high degree of independence
* Excellent written and oral communication skills
* Ability to define and deliver a strategic agenda across multiple groups
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including ability to analyze large data sets and present conclusions concisely
* Excellent project management and organizational skills, with strong attention to detail and a logical thought process

**ABOUT US**  
  
  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  
  
**ABOUT THE TEAM**  
  
  

Our Consumer & Community Banking division serves our Chase customers through a range of financial services, including personal banking, credit cards, mortgages, auto financing, investment advice, small business loans and payment processing. We're proud to lead the U.S. in credit card sales and deposit growth and have the most-used digital solutions – all while ranking first in customer satisfaction.

  

Global Finance & Business Management works to strategically manage capital, drive growth and efficiencies, maintain financial reporting and proactively manage risk. By providing information, analysis and recommendations to improve results and drive decisions, teams ensure the company can navigate all types of market conditions while protecting our fortress balance sheet.

**Company** | Hybon Technologies Private Limited  
**Location** | The Executive Centre, 7th Floor, Worldmark 4, Aerocity, New Delhi  
**Employment Type** | Full-time  
**Reporting To** | Chief Financial Officer

Role Overview

Hybon Technologies is looking for a **Head of Accounts** to lead the accounting function for its domestic trading and export business in mobile phones, electronics and IT products. The role owns the books of accounts, financial close, statutory compliance, audit coordination and internal controls. The successful candidate will lead the accounts team and work closely with sales, procurement, logistics and banking teams to keep financial records accurate and resolve discrepancies promptly.

Key Responsibilities

* **Accounting and financial close** — Oversee the general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, bank reconciliations, fixed assets and intercompany balances. Lead monthly and year-end closing and prepare financial statements and supporting schedules.
* **GST and tax compliance** — Oversee GST returns, GSTR-2B reconciliations, input tax credit, e-invoicing and e-way bills. Manage TDS deductions, deposits and returns, and coordinate with tax advisors on statutory filings and notices.
* **Import and export accounting** — Review invoices, bills of entry, shipping bills, customs duties, freight and landed costs. Monitor foreign currency receivables and payables, exchange differences and export realisations. Coordinate with banks and internal teams on remittance documentation and support GST refund claims where applicable.
* **Inventory and cost controls** — Reconcile inventory records with the books and physical stock counts. Investigate stock discrepancies, review valuation and landed costs, and oversee IMEI or serial-number reconciliation where applicable.
* **Receivables, payables and cash flow** — Monitor customer and vendor ageing, advances and credit balances. Drive account confirmations and dispute resolution, review payment schedules and prepare cash flow forecasts for management.
* **Management reporting** — Prepare monthly reports on profitability, gross margins, inventory, overdue receivables and working capital. Explain material variances and flag issues that require management action.
* **Audits and internal controls** — Coordinate statutory, tax and internal audits. Maintain supporting documentation, close audit observations and strengthen review controls for invoicing, payments, credit notes and journal entries.
* **Team leadership** — Supervise and develop the accounts team, set clear responsibilities and review deadlines, and improve accounting processes and ERP workflows.

Qualifications and Experience

* CA preferred. CMA, M.Com or B.Com candidates with relevant senior accounting experience may also be considered.
* 8–12 years of accounting experience, including at least 3 years leading an accounts team.
* Experience in trading, distribution or import/export is preferred. Exposure to mobile phones, electronics or IT hardware is an advantage.
* Hands-on experience in financial closing, GST, TDS, inventory accounting, reconciliations and audit coordination.
* Proficiency in Tally Prime or a comparable ERP, along with strong Excel skills for reconciliations and management reporting.
* Ability to lead a team, meet statutory and reporting deadlines, and communicate clearly with management, auditors, banks and business teams.

Pay: ₹60,000.00 - ₹1,200,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Manager, Payments & Treasury
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**  
NEXT Ventures is where ambition takes shape and momentum becomes movement. As a global platform, revolutionising access to performance-based capital, we empower the world’s most driven individuals to rise. Through our flagship brand, FundedNext, we empower dreamers to become doers and potential to turn into performance. FNmarkets is our international brokerage arm, serving clients across global markets*.*

With 500+ driven minds across five countries, we power a global rhythm—220,000+ daily users, from 170+ nations, each chasing greatness in their own way.

**Your Role in Our Mission**  
As a Manager, Payments & Treasury (FNmarkets Brokerage), you own the end-to-end movement, safeguarding, and optimization of client and corporate funds across FNmarkets’ international brokerage operations. You will run the PSP and banking portfolio that powers client deposits and withdrawals, manage multi-currency liquidity and FX exposure, and keep settlement, reconciliation, and treasury controls tight as the brokerage scales across markets. Sitting at the intersection of payment operations, treasury, and bank/PSP relationship management, you partner closely with Compliance, Finance, Risk, and trading-platform teams to keep funds flowing reliably, cost-efficiently, and within regulatory requirements.

This role reports to the group Head of Payments & Treasury.

**How You’ll Make an Impact**

* **Payment Operations & PSP Portfolio:**

* **Portfolio Ownership:** Own the PSP and payment-method portfolio (cards, local bank rails, e-wallets, crypto) across the brokerage’s active markets, from onboarding and integration through performance monitoring and offboarding.
* **Payment Routing Optimization:** Optimize payment routing in the orchestrator to lift approval rates, reduce decline and failure rates, and lower blended cost per transaction.
* **SLA & Performance Tracking:** Track and improve deposit/withdrawal success rates, processing times, and chargeback/dispute ratios against agreed SLAs.

**2. Client Funds & Payout Operations:**

* **End-to-End Flow Oversight:** Oversee client deposit and withdrawal flows end to end, ensuring funds are processed accurately, on time, and in line with client-money safeguarding rules.
* **Payout Management:** Manage brokerage client withdrawals and wallet transfers, including volume forecasting, queue management, and exception handling.
* **Fund Segregation & Reporting:** Maintain segregation of client funds from corporate funds and support audit and regulatory reporting on balances.

**3. Treasury, FX & Cash Management:**

* **Multi-Currency Liquidity:** Manage multi-currency liquidity across entities and accounts, ensuring sufficient funding for client withdrawals, settlements, and operating needs.
* **FX & Hedging Execution:** Run FX operations and conversions, monitor currency exposure, and execute hedging or rebalancing as directed by policy.
* **Cash Forecasting & Yield:** Forecast cash positions, optimize working capital, and manage the placement of eligible corporate cash within approved investment and counterparty limits—with client funds held separately and safeguarded at all times.

**4. Banking & Relationship Management:**

* **Partner Management:** Own relationships with banks, PSPs, and acquiring partners—covering commercials, fee and settlement-term negotiation, issue escalation, and periodic performance reviews.
* **Cost Reduction:** Drive down processing, settlement, and FX costs through negotiation and transfer-pricing/routing optimization.
* **Infrastructure Redundancy:** Build banking and PSP redundancy to protect the continuity of client deposits and withdrawals.

**5. Reconciliation, Compliance & Risk:**

* **Multi-Ledger Reconciliation:** Own daily and periodic reconciliation across PSPs, banks, crypto wallets, and the ledger, resolving breaks and ensuring settlement accuracy.
* **Regulatory & Compliance Alignment:** Partner with Compliance on KYC/AML, licensing, and regulatory requirements affecting payment flows and client funds.
* **Risk Mitigation:** Identify and mitigate operational, settlement, counterparty, and fraud risk across the payment and treasury stack.

**6. Projects & Optimization:**

* **Expansion & Automation Initiatives:** Lead payments and treasury projects, including new-market and new-method launches, orchestrator and system integrations, and process automation.
* **Executive Reporting:** Build reporting and dashboards on approval rates, cost, settlement cycles, liquidity, and payout performance for leadership.
* **Cross-Functional Scaling:** Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Finance, and Risk to scale payment and treasury capability as the brokerage grows.

**7. Build & Scale, Team Leadership & Innovation:**

* **Build & Scale:** Define and build out the FNmarkets payments and treasury operating model - people, processes, and systems - to support the brokerage’s growth across new markets and product lines.
* **Team Leadership:** Lead, develop, and grow a high-performing payments & treasury wing for FNmarkets business line, setting clear priorities, fostering accountability, and building capability at every level.
* **Innovation & Knowledge Sharing:** Champion continuous improvement by staying current on industry developments, introducing best practices, and ensuring knowledge flows across the team and key stakeholders.

**What You Bring**

* **Industry Experience:** Minimum 5 years in payments, funds management, and treasury functions at an international brokerage (CFD/FX/securities); strong candidates from payments firms serving brokerage clients also considered.
* **High-Volume Payment Operations:** Hands-on experience managing client deposit and withdrawal flows, PSP relationships, and payment routing in a high-volume, multi-currency environment.
* **Treasury & FX Mastery:** Treasury experience across multi-currency liquidity and cash management, FX operations, and working-capital or settlement optimization.
* **Payment Ecosystem Knowledge:** Strong grasp of digital payment methods and ecosystems—card networks, local/alternative payment rails, e-wallets, and crypto/stablecoin settlement.
* **Commercial Negotiation:** Demonstrated bank and PSP negotiation experience, with a track record of reducing fees and improving settlement terms and approval performance.
* **Reconciliation & Breaks Resolution:** Solid command of reconciliation and settlement across multiple payment partners and ledgers, including breaks investigation.
* **Compliance & Safeguarding:** Working knowledge of KYC/AML, client-money safeguarding, and the compliance/licensing considerations affecting cross-border payment flows.
* **Data & Analytics:** Strong analytical skills; comfortable working with transaction data, dashboards, and spreadsheets to drive decisions.
* **Education & Communication:** A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field; paired with fluent written and spoken English for coordinating across international partners and internal stakeholders.

**Preferred (Nice-to-Haves)**

* **Payment Orchestration:** Experience with payment orchestration platforms and routing logic (e.g., cascading, smart routing, retry optimization).
* **Multi-Jurisdiction Setup:** Familiarity with regulated-entity treasury across multiple jurisdictions, including banking setups and licensing considerations.
* **Market Launches:** Prior experience launching payment methods or banking relationships in new markets.
* **Certifications & SQL:** Relevant certifications (e.g., CTP, payments or treasury qualifications) and SQL or data-analysis skills for working with transaction-level data are good to have.
* **Crypto Settlement:** Exposure to crypto settlement and reconciliation (USDT, TRC-20/ERC-20) and crypto–fiat on/off-ramp flows.

**JOB SUMMARY / INTRODUCTION**

The role is responsible for working with IB Coverage UAE in structuring GTx solutions, managing and growing of GTx Business of the Bank for both NBFI segment and reporting to MD & Head of International Development GTx.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Candidate should have a strong drive for GTx Client Solutions, understanding of the GTx Products and GTx clients for the NBFI Segments.
* Delivery of specific revenue targets, returns on risk adjusted assets and equity consistent and commensurate with the Bank’s acceptable risk parameters.
* Work closely with coverage teams and make the management aware of performance gaps with suggestions to rectify and improve performance and deepen client relationship.
* Actively engage with client together with NBFI Coverage to build GTx business for the Bank in the origination, structuring and implementation of Payments,
* Liquifity and Trade Finance trade finance deals for Clients & Execute Client Calling Plans.
* Responsible for structuring GTx deals (including Payments, Liquidity & Trade Finance) and providing technical expertise to relationship managers and facilitate client discussions. Lead structuring of bespoke GTx Solutions and ensure a high quality customer experience through consultative approach.
* Use of consultative approach along with the GTx Trade knowledge and experience to design and implement suitable innovative solutions for customer’s needs.
* Responsible for structuring complex Payments & LMS deals and responding to RFPs.
* Actively engage with client in articulating the benefits of the ADGM platform and pitching & structuring Regional Treasury and Liquidity solution for the Middle East & Africa region.
* Structure and Commercialize Next Gen Propositions including Client Money Account & Tokenization.
* Establish strong stakeholder relationships and work with colleagues and partners across the network to build a strong GTx pipeline.
* Ensure GTx transactions and facilities are being executed on timely manner.
* Partner with coverage teams in order to develop quality credit proposals supporting structuring of existing and new GTx facilities including Complex Trade Transactions.
* Identify and manage fraud, regulatory and compliance risks in the transactions when developing solutions for clients.
* Identify opportunities for continuous improvement of products, systems, processes, and practices while taking into account client needs, market developments and trends.
* Actively participate in opportunities to update product skills, understand market trends and competitor behaviours.
* Work closely with Coverage teams across the region and network to develop new markets, clients, and products.
* Work with Coverage team on creating detailed Client Account Plan for growing GTx business and maximize market share with focus on clients from NBFI Segment.
* Closely monitoring utilization of GTx facilities and cross sell non-credit GTx products / services to deepen client wallet.
* Understand and comply with regulations and internal policies i.e. Credit / Compliance / Operational Risks.
* Handle transactions on end to end basis.
* Work closely with Compliance, Finance, Operations for client on-boarding and smooth execution of transactions.
* Work closely with GTx Product Manager (Payments, Liquidity, Trade & Nex Gen), UAE to finalize GTx to structure solutions for NBFI Clients.
Provide regular pipeline update to grow GTx business in NBFI Segment.  

**REQUIREMENTS / QUALIFICATIONS**

* Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Commerce or equivalent discipline.
* Min 15-20 years of Transaction Banking Sales experience with specialized knowledge instructured solutions across Payments, Liquidity & Trade.
* Candidate should have an experience of Origination, Developing Client Relationship and experience of managing NBFI clients.
* Strong Client network with focus to grow GTx business for the bank in the NBFI Segment.
* Strong technical knowledge in GTx products including Payments, Liquidity & Trade.
* Self-starter who is able to handle all enquiries relating to GTX independently.
* Strong interpersonal skills as well as a team player with strong influential skill that can motivate other team members to achieve the business objective.
* Strong origination capability coupled with excellent customer service & negotiation skills.
* Self-confident and performance driven. Ability to work under pressure and with a strong delivery focus.
* Ability to articulate, formulate and deliver high quality client presentation.
* Understanding of operations processes and procedures, and related risk in GTX transactions.
FamiliarIty with the regulatory environment concerning financial industry in Middle East.  

**Preferred / Beneficial**

* Experience in managing clients from NBFI Segment and exposure in Insurance, AMCs, Payment Service Providers etc. would be preferred.

Responsibilities

  

Qualifications

  

About Us

**About Us:**

  

First Abu Dhabi Bank (FAB) is the largest bank in the UAE and one of the world's largest and safest financial institutions. We offer a comprehensive range of personal and private banking services, including credit cards, Islamic banking, investments, loans, and mortgages. Our commitment to excellence and innovation drives us to provide top-tier financial solutions to our clients.

jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager 3
jobs.description:
#### **About Behavox**

Behavox is shaping the future for how businesses harness their most important raw material - data. Our mission is bold: Organize enterprise data into actionable information that protects and promotes the business growth of multinational companies around the world.

From managing enterprise risk and compliance to maximizing revenue and value, our data operating platform presents a widespread opportunity to build multilingual, AI/ML-based solutions that activate data for every function within a global enterprise.

Our approach is unique, and it's validated by our customers who tell us to keep forging ahead because no one else is aggregating, analyzing, and acting on data to uncover opportunities or solve problems quite the way we are.

We are looking for fearless innovators who have an insatiable appetite for building what no one has built before.

**About the Role**

Behavox's Strategic Account Managers own the full commercial relationship with some of the world's most complex and highly regulated financial institutions. This includes delivery outcomes, commercial performance, executive relationships, and long-term strategic growth across a portfolio of global banks, hedge funds, asset managers, and energy firms operating under the world's most demanding regulatory frameworks.

Clients in this portfolio are building or strengthening unified controls frameworks that bring together communications surveillance, trade surveillance, compliant archiving, and policy management into a single, defensible control system. The Strategic Account Manager's role is to understand where each client sits on that journey, ensure Behavox is delivering against their current needs, and position the platform to serve the full scope of their controls framework over time. This requires full end-to-end ownership of the relationship, delivery, health, satisfaction, retention, and growth for every account in the portfolio, operating with a high degree of autonomy on account strategy, renewals, escalations, and executive relationships.

The role requires the ability to think strategically and execute operationally, often in the same day. The Strategic Account Manager will own all renewals across the portfolio, build retention strategy, lead negotiations, and close; accurately forecast ARR churn risk and develop mitigation plans; drive inbound expansion deals independently in collaboration with Account Executives; and lead executive business reviews that are genuinely strategic: conversations about compliance posture, regulatory risk, control maturity, and platform value.

This is a hybrid position based out of our London office.

**What You'll Bring**

* **Enterprise compliance technology and unified controls frameworks.** Deep working knowledge of how communications surveillance, trade surveillance, compliant archiving, and policy management converge into a single control system at regulated financial institutions; understands how clients evaluate and mature their compliance posture over time.
* **Financial services regulatory environment.** Understands the regulatory obligations driving client demand, from communications monitoring requirements to trade reconstruction and archiving mandates, across global banking, hedge fund, asset management, and energy sectors.
* **Multi-stakeholder account management across regulated financial institutions.** Navigates complex organizational structures involving Heads of Surveillance, compliance analysts, technology teams, and operations teams; manages both executive-level strategic relationships and working-level practitioner relationships simultaneously.
* **Commercial lifecycle management for enterprise SaaS.** Owns the full renewal and expansion cycle: retention strategy, churn forecasting, negotiation, close, and pipeline development in partnership with Account Executives; understands how delivery health directly impacts commercial outcomes.
* **Escalation management and operational accountability**. Owns ticket triage, escalation, and resolution end to end for the full portfolio; manages complex, multi-workstream escalations with minimal manager involvement; builds relationships with Product, Engineering, and Support counterparts to accelerate resolution.

**What You'll Do**

* **Account health monitoring and risk identification.** Independently assesses account health and risk across commercial, operational, and relationship dimensions; surfaces risk early by reading ticket patterns, stakeholder signals, and adoption data as intelligence; builds intervention plans without manager direction.
* **Executive business review design and delivery.** Designs and executes QBRs and EBRs for all accounts including executive-level engagement; leads conversations about compliance posture, regulatory risk, control maturity, and platform value rather than product update calls.
* **Renewal ownership and churn forecasting.** Owns all renewals across the portfolio: builds retention strategy, leads negotiations, closes; accurately forecasts ARR churn risk and develops mitigation plans using account health data, stakeholder intelligence, and delivery performance indicators.
* **Expansion identification and commercial execution.** Drives inbound expansion deals independently; collaborates with Account Executives per Unit of One model for strategic accounts; leads with value, not discount-first positioning; builds commercial plays grounded in customer intelligence.
* **Delivery follow-through and client communication ownership.** Owns the client-facing narrative when delivery issues arise, ensuring commitments made to the client are tracked and fulfilled; translates technical or operational updates into language the client can act on; holds internal teams accountable through to confirmed resolution so the client has everything they need without chasing.

**What We Offer**

* A truly global mission with a passionate community in locations all over the world
* Huge impact and learning potential as our aspirations require bold innovation
* Highly competitive compensation
* Benefits include fully covered health coverage for employee and family
* Generous time-off policy and flexible work schedule

**About Our Process**

  

We take Talent very seriously and we are building a community of extraordinary individuals working together in very high performing teams. We also know that the best Talent always has options so we believe that the process has to be a two way assessment - the company AND the candidate assessing the business needs alignment, the career next step alignment, and the cultural alignment.  
  
During the process we will begin by exploring the core factors regarding salary and location along with core experience and skills and values alignment. We will then deep dive explore the critical technical competencies we have identified for the role, and then we will deep dive in behavioral competencies.  
  
The most aligned candidate will then be asked to do a practical work task simulation activity so we can make sure that you will enjoy the kind of work the role requires, and this task will typically be presented and discussed with a group of colleagues and managers. Finally we will ask you to meet with a number of our senior leaders to make sure that you are making the most informed call possible.

**Please note that:**

* We want to get to know you and have a genuine conversation, so the use of AI tools or assistance during live interviews is strictly prohibited and will result in immediate disqualification from the process
* Interviews may be recorded for internal review purposes to ensure fairness and enable collaborative hiring discussions within the team.

**Company Description**

CNS (Computer Network Systems) is a technology company in the middle-east & has over 30 years of successful achievements and long-term partnerships with distinct customers across the region.

We are an IT distributor & our expertise are in Banking & Financial Service Insurance, Technology Enablement, IT Outsourcing, Cyber security, Digital Infrastructure, Hybrid Cloud, Digital Workplace, Customer Experience, Digital Transformation, and Block Chain.

We are a Part of the Ghobash Group of Companies, CNS spread across the region with offices in Abu Dhabi, Dubai, Oman, and Kuwait providing a holistic approach that covers all aspects of information communication technology system integration, consultancy, operation, managed services, and IT outsourcing.

CNS also has state-of-the-art network operation centers in Abu Dhabi and Dubai that develop in-house software and applications providing end-to-end solutions to our customers and partners.

 **Job Description**

Lead new-business development and profitable revenue growth for CNS cybersecurity services in the Abu Dhabi- UAE. The role requires an established cybersecurity services salesperson with existing CISO/CIO relationships in the assigned Emirate, a proven record of originating and closing managed SOC/MDR, offensive-security and advisory engagements, and the ability to build a qualified pipeline from their network. This is a hands-on hunter role, not a general IT product or license sales position.

**DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Own territory-based new business, customer acquisition, account development and cybersecurity services sales in Dubai or Abu Dhabi.
* Leverage existing relationships with CISOs, CIOs, Heads of Security, IT leaders and procurement decision-makers to secure senior customer meetings and qualify demand.
* Develop and close managed SOC, MDR, managed SIEM/SOAR, EDR/XDR, threat monitoring, incident response retainers, vulnerability management and threat-hunting contracts.
* Sell offensive and technical assurance services: VAPT, infrastructure/web/API/cloud penetration testing, red/purple teaming, breach-and-attack simulation, EASM and digital risk protection.
* Position advisory services including NIST CSF/ISO 27001 assessments, SOC maturity reviews, cyber risk and regulatory readiness, cloud security, Zero Trust, GRC and cyber resilience.
* Identify security technology transformation opportunities involving SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, identity/PAM, cloud and hybrid security; engage presales for detailed solution design.
* Own the full opportunity lifecycle: prospecting, discovery, qualification, solution shaping, RFP/SOW coordination, proposal, pricing, negotiation, award and delivery handover.
* Collaborate with technical presales, cybersecurity delivery teams and account managers to scope commercially viable services and identify cross-sell opportunities.
* Maintain account plans, accurate CRM opportunities, close plans, forecasts and margin discipline; manage pipeline and sales performance reviews.
* Build strategic relationships with UAE government, semi-government, financial services, energy, healthcare, aviation and enterprise customers as appropriate to territory.
* Grow recurring multiyear services revenue and identify follow-on engagements through workshops, assessments and existing customer relationships.

 **Qualifications**

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience in business, IT, cybersecurity or related discipline.
* Degree in IT/cybersecurity/business; relevant sales or cybersecurity training/certifications. (Preferred)

**Experience**

* 8–10+ years in B2B technology/cybersecurity sales, including 5+ years selling cybersecurity services; demonstrable UAE new-business wins and active senior customer relationships in Dubai or Abu Dhabi.
* Prior MSSP, cybersecurity consultancy or systems integrator experience; multiple SOC/MDR and offensive-security services wins; government, critical infrastructure or BFSI networks; multiyear contract sales.(Preferred)

  
**Additional Information**

**Skills & Abilities**

* Proven hunter; cybersecurity services discovery and qualification; CISO/CIO stakeholder access; SOC/MDR and VAPT sales fluency; full-cycle complex sales, negotiation, RFPs, account planning, CRM and forecasting; strong written/spoken English.
* Understanding of NIST CSF, ISO 27001, UAE IA/NESA, DESC ISR; EASM/DRP, cloud and AI-enabled security; Arabic communication skills where useful; strategic vendor/partner ecosystem.

*Compliance with policies and procedures based on the ISO standards adopted by CNS.*

jobs.description:
**Key** **Account Manager** – **Payments**

OxyX | SME Growth · Accounting Practice Partnerships · Payments & Business Technology  
Position: Key Account Manager – Payments

**Business: OxyX - Kanzpay**  
***www.KanzPay.com***  
***www.OxyTech.ae***

Reports to: Sales / Business Head  
Location: UAE – field and office-based

***Role purpose***

The Key Account Manager – Payments will drive the adoption and growth of OxyX among UAE small and medium-sized businesses (SMEs). The role combines two complementary routes to market: building productive referral relationships with accounting firms and acquiring, onboarding and managing SMEs directly.

The successful candidate will help business owners understand how OxyX can improve collections, payment journeys, customer engagement and day-to-day business decisions. The role is focused on consultative selling, trusted relationships, activation and sustained usage—not simply signing up accounts.

***Key responsibilities***

*1. Accounting firm partnership development*

* Identify, map and approach accounting, bookkeeping and tax advisory practices serving UAE SMEs. **Build relationships with practice owners, partners, directors and client-facing teams; explain the OxyX partner proposition clearly.** Position accounting firms as trusted referral partners who can introduce OxyX to suitable SME clients while retaining their own client relationships. **Arrange partner meetings, briefings, demonstrations and follow-ups; maintain a structured pipeline of prospective and active firms.** Equip partners with approved presentations, product information, referral processes and client onboarding support. **Identify client needs with partner firms and coordinate introductions with the SME's consent.** Maintain partner engagement, track referred opportunities and support partner activation and retention.

*2. Direct SME acquisition and sales*

* Identify and approach SMEs across relevant sectors, including retail, trading, professional services, hospitality and other suitable business categories. **Understand each prospect's business model, current ERP/accounting setup, payment and collection processes, operational pain points and growth priorities.** Conduct needs-based discussions and demonstrate relevant OxyX capabilities rather than delivering generic product presentations. **Explain how OxyX works as an intelligence and action layer alongside the SME's existing systems, subject to connector availability, permissions and supported data.** Develop proposals, manage objections, follow up opportunities and progress prospects through evaluation, decision and onboarding. **Build relationships with business owners, finance managers, operations managers and other decision-makers.**

*3. SME onboarding, activation and account management*

* Coordinate onboarding with the SME, accounting firm and internal implementation/support teams. **Ensure the SME understands agreed use cases, onboarding requirements, connector prerequisites and each party's responsibilities.** Support initial setup, user orientation and first-use milestones; escalate technical or integration issues promptly. **Monitor engagement, identify underused capabilities and recommend relevant steps to improve adoption and business value.** Maintain regular account reviews, resolve relationship issues and identify opportunities for expansion, renewal and referral. **Capture customer feedback and share product, integration and service improvement suggestions internally.**

*4. Product and market understanding*

* Develop working knowledge of OxyX's SME cockpit, business controls, AI-assisted insights, collections and payment-related workflows, rewards, expense-related capabilities and e-invoicing integrations where available. **Understand the distinction between OxyX technology/workflows and services delivered by banks, payment service providers, acquirers and accredited e-invoicing service providers.** Keep up to date with SME operating challenges, accounting practice needs, market developments and competitor propositions. **Translate customer feedback and market observations into clear inputs for product, marketing, operations and management.**

*Performance expectations*

Performance will be assessed on the quality and consistency of partner development, SME acquisition, successful onboarding, active usage, customer retention and value created for SMEs and accounting partners.

* Qualified accounting firms engaged and converted into active referral partners. **Qualified SME opportunities generated through partner referrals and direct acquisition.** SMEs successfully onboarded and activated, with agreed first-use milestones achieved. **Ongoing product adoption, account engagement, retention and expansion.** Quality of customer relationships, partner feedback and resolution of escalations. **Accurate CRM records, pipeline forecasts, meeting notes and sales reporting.**

*Skills, experience and attributes*

* Experience in B2B sales, key account management, merchant services, payments, fintech, banking, SaaS or SME business solutions. **Ability to sell through relationship-based channels, referral partners, professional firms or business ecosystems.** Confidence engaging business owners, accounting practice partners, finance leaders and operational decision-makers. **Strong consultative selling, presentation, negotiation, follow-up and account-management skills.** Ability to understand business workflows and explain technology in clear, practical, non-technical language. **Comfortable conducting field visits, meetings, product demonstrations and structured follow-ups.** Organised, self-driven and capable of managing a pipeline and multiple partner/customer relationships. **Good written and spoken English; additional languages commonly used in the UAE SME market are an advantage.** Working knowledge of UAE SME business practices and the payments/accounting ecosystem is preferred.

*Working relationships*

The role will work closely with the Sales / Business Head, accounting practice partners, SME owners and finance teams, product and implementation teams, customer support, and relevant external payment or technology partners.

*Professional conduct and role boundaries*

* Represent OxyX accurately and use only current, approved product descriptions, pricing, proposals and marketing materials. **Do not promise product features, integrations, settlement timelines, rewards, savings or business outcomes that have not been confirmed.** Do not present OxyX as a bank, payment service provider, acquirer or accredited e-invoicing service provider. Regulated payment and e-invoicing services are provided by relevant authorised partners. **Follow company policies for customer consent, data confidentiality, information security, onboarding and record keeping.** Do not collect, store or share customer credentials, banking passwords, OTPs or sensitive payment credentials. **Escalate complaints, suspected fraud, data incidents, compliance concerns and requests outside approved authority promptly.**

*What success looks like*

A successful Key Account Manager builds a dependable network of accounting practice referral partners while independently developing SME relationships. SMEs understand the practical value of OxyX, complete onboarding, use the capabilities relevant to their business and continue to engage. Accounting firms see OxyX as a way to strengthen their client service and create additional value—not as a threat to their role. This role is a senior role qualifying for the ESOPS as well. You may choose to apply at: **reach@OxyTech.ae**

Pay: AED3,900.00 - AED17,000.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* Have you sold credit cards, POS machines, ERP systems, Accounting systems, other Payment instruments.

Education:

* Master's (Preferred)

Experience:

* ERP systems: 3 years (Preferred)
* POS: 3 years (Preferred)
* Key Account Management: 3 years (Required)

jobs.title: Head of APAC
jobs.description:
**Join Zepz: Breaking Down Borders, Together**

**Our Meaningful Mission**  
At Zepz, we're all about breaking down barriers for our customers and our teammates. Our purpose is deeply personal, we provide a lifeline and deliver opportunities to cross-border communities that need it most through cutting edge finance and tech. Zepz is the power behind WorldRemit and Sendwave , driven by the mission to celebrate the incredible impact migrants have, both at home and abroad. We're not just moving money; we're building a world that truly recognises and supports global connections.
  
  
**Who You'll Be Joining**

We look for mission-driven builders who thrive in a fast-paced environment connected to a true purpose. We’re an always developing team of experts that enjoy problem solving and bring clarity to tough challenges. At Zepz, we are Relentless Learners , always seeking feedback, and Responsible Owners , treating company resources like your own. We depend on Transparent Communicators who keep the team aligned through open, honest talk.

**Our Core Commitments — What We Live By**  
Our vibrant and truly diverse culture is built on three core commitments, that guide how we work and interact:

* Integrity: We always do the right thing. It’s simple, but it’s the foundation of everything we build for our customers and each other.
* Outcomes: We work for our customers. Their success and prosperity are the results we focus on delivering.
* Velocity: We are fast! We maintain high energy levels and make smart decisions quickly, keeping us nimble and ahead of the curve.

**Perks of Joining Our Team**

We believe in empowering colleagues because we genuinely trust our team. Our culture is founded on this high trust, which naturally encourages the high ownership that drives us to meet our shared high expectations and deliver high performance. While we have all the tools to work remotely, we value the purpose and benefits of in-person connections so expect regular team off-sites. We also offer unlimited annual leave , great healthcare benefits, and employee discounts. We want you to thrive and focus entirely on making your biggest impact! In turn, we expect you to bring high ownership and commitment to your work. This is a place where we value trust and high performance, and we'll provide the environment and support needed for you to excel

**About the Role**  
As the Head of APAC, you will be the ultimate executive responsible for driving the commercial expansion, strategic growth, product launches, and operational optimization of the Company across the Asia-Pacific region. You will hold full accountability and responsibility for APAC growth targets, taking end-to-end ownership of Volume, Revenue, and regional PnL. You will build the partner network, commercial deals, and local operational engines needed to launch, scale, and optimize them rapidly. This role requires an ambitious commercial mindset, exceptional matrix leadership capabilities, and a deep understanding of cross-border financial markets.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**  
Regional Expansion & Growth Strategy

* Commercial PnL & Target Ownership: Meet and exceed all targets set across Volume, Revenue, and regional PnL. Take full accountability for scaling the region’s market share and bottom-line growth.
* Corridor & Network Expansion: Identify, negotiate, and execute strategic partnership and banking network expansion opportunities across emerging and developed APAC markets.
* Launch & Market Optimization: Lead end-to-end market entry and expansion strategies, integrating local real-time payment rails and partner networks to maximize transaction speed, cost efficiency, and customer experience.
* Commercial FX & Margin Strategy: Partner closely with internal Pricing, FX Trading, and Treasury teams to continuously optimize corridor pricing models. Drive regional FX spread margins, ensure competitive liquidity across high-volume APAC currency pairs, and maximize overall revenue margins.

**Off-Cycle Internship Overview**
  
Join us on an Off-Cycle Internship for 3-6 months. Immerse yourself in our work and culture and gain invaluable insights into life as a Full-time Analyst with this longer internship.

  
  

**Why the Sales, Trading and Structuring Off-Cycle Intern Programme?**
  
Our Sales and Trading team works in a fast-paced, dynamic and exciting environment, quickly processing information and anticipating market trends to help clients make their next move. Sound like the place for you? Find out when you join us as an Off-Cycle Analyst.

  
  

**The chance to make an impact**

As an Off-Cycle Analyst, you’ll be surprised by what you can achieve. Your internship starts with intensive training that gives you an essential platform for gaining skills and knowledge. Then you’ll head to your desk, where you’ll get to grips with the intricacies of the global markets and follow a structured programme that includes project-based work. Through our off-cycle programme, you will have the chance to have more in-depth exposure to projects, compared to our summer internships; thus, expanding your overall knowledge and skill in this role.

  
  

Through your desk assignments, you’ll develop a solid understanding of the global markets, building your communication, quantitative and analytical skills. You may:

* Research industries or products, reporting summary information to your team.
* Monitor markets and help formulate trade ideas.
* Perform various analyses on fundamental and technical data.
* Attend client meetings or calls with traders, salespeople and research colleagues.
  

  

**Markets at Barclays**
  
Markets is the financial barometer of world events at Barclays. So every day is different and it’s a challenging, fascinating place to build a career.

  
  

We help institutional investors to identify market opportunities, manage risk and generate returns for their portfolios.

  
  

Our teams provide market insights, execution services and tailored risk management and financing solutions to our clients; we help them protect their capital and make the most of their assets.

  
  

As one of the largest investment banks in the world, we offer a full range of products and services across every type of investment market.

  
  

**Who we're looking for**
  
To be considered for this programme, you must be in your penultimate or final year of your degree, in any discipline.

  
  

Language requirements: fluent in English and Arabic desirable.

  
  

Ideally you’ll have a keen interest in business or finance with a curiosity to learn. We value resourcefulness, teamwork, enthusiasm and an entrepreneurial spirit, all of which might be showcased through your involvement in extracurricular activities.

  
  

**Working in Dubai**
  
For more than 150 years, Barclays has been a member of the Middle East business community. From our Dubai office you’ll work on corporate banking solutions, to financial institutions and multinationals, supporting them to fulfil their financing needs, risk management, cash and liquidity management, as well as trade and working capital requirements.

**Purpose of the role**

To participate in the day-to-day activities of the markets division providing insights and expertise that help senior colleagues make informed decisions, develop new products and services, and identify new market opportunities.

**Accountabilities**

* Execution of small research projects, research to support strategic decision making, preparation of presentations and reports to communicate research findings, collaboration with senior management to implement research findings for the global markets division.
* Collaboration with cross-functional teams to support business initiatives.
* Participation in training and development programs to enhance skills and knowledge.

* Management of the development and implementation of financial models and strategies that support in decision making in the global markets division.

**Analyst Expectations**
