jobs.title: Director of Product, Platform
jobs.description:
**Organization Overview**
**Company Description**
**QAD**
is a leading provider of ERP solutions purpose-built for manufacturing industries — automotive, life sciences, food & beverage, high tech, and industrial. Serving thousands of global manufacturers, QAD's Adaptive Manufacturing Cloud helps companies operate with greater precision, agility, and intelligence.
  
  
Enterprise software is entering a third era. The first gave manufacturers a System of Record — ERP that answered 'what do we have and what did we commit to?' The second gave them Data Infrastructure — the ability to move, analyse, and query that data at scale. The third era is domain-specific intelligence: AI agents that can act autonomously on manufacturing data, but only if that data has been given the context, relationships, and governed rules that allow an agent to reason correctly.
  
  
**ERA — QAD's Enterprise Resource Allocation platform —**
is the domain intelligence layer that sits between any ERP and any AI agent. It encodes what manufacturing data means, governs what agents are permitted to do, and makes every autonomous decision traceable and accountable.
  
  
**Job Description**
This role owns a key pillar of ERA — the Manufacturing Data Fabric & Intelligence layer. This is the foundational intelligence core: the semantic layer that encodes what manufacturing data means, the metric registry that governs how business outcomes are measured, and the AI Insights and conversational analytics capabilities that surface intelligence to users and agents alike. Without this layer, the rest of ERA cannot function. It is the prerequisite for every downstream agent action, every governed decision, and every autonomous workflow ERA enables.
  
  
As Director of Product for Data, AI, Reporting & Analytics, you will report directly to the Head of Platform Product and lead a team of Product Managers and Technical Product Owners. Your scope is the intelligence core — not the integration layer, not the governance engine, not the developer API. You will partner closely with the Directors leading those pillars, but your mandate is singular: make manufacturing data meaningful, queryable, and AI-ready at enterprise scale.
  
  
This is a high-visibility, high-leverage role. The semantic layer is ERA's primary moat — the hardest layer to build and the one no horizontal AI platform will invest in replicating. Your roadmap decisions will compound over years and directly determine QAD's competitive positioning in the era of autonomous manufacturing.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
The Foundation Exists — The Mandate Now Is To Build ERA's Intelligence Core Into The Definitive Manufacturing Ontology Platform. You Will Have The Scope To
  
  

* Define and own the manufacturing semantic layer — encoding supplier criticality, lead time patterns, quality thresholds, and operational constraints in a form AI agents can reason from
* Build the contextual intelligence layer that passes metric definitions, data distributions, and business rules to LLMs for accurate, anomaly-aware narrative generation
* Drive QAD's conversational analytics strategy — enabling non-technical manufacturing users to query operations in natural language without SQL or BI expertise
* Establish the AI evaluation framework that governs quality, accuracy, and latency of every AI-generated insight shipped to enterprise customers
* Evolve the platform from reactive reporting to proactive, agentic intelligence — where the system surfaces recommended actions, not just data

**Key Responsibilities**
**Platform Strategy & Roadmap**

* Own the multi-year product roadmap for ERA's Manufacturing Data Fabric & Intelligence layer — from raw data pipeline to user-facing AI insights
* Define the manufacturing semantic layer: encoding metric definitions, operational constraints, supplier relationships, and business rules into a governed ontology that AI agents can reason from
* Translate QAD's ERA vision into concrete, sequenced product bets for the intelligence core — partnering with Directors leading the Integration, Governance, and API pillars to ensure the full platform coheres
* Lead the evolution of AI Insights capabilities: contextual anomaly detection, plain-language narrative generation, and agentic root cause analysis

**AI & Conversational Analytics**

* Drive the conversational analytics product — ontology design, knowledge graph, context graph, and intent detection for natural language querying
* Establish and own the AI evaluation framework: latency, accuracy, relevancy gates, LLM-as-judge, and human-in-the-loop oversight
* Architect the contextual layer that passes metadata, data distributions, and business rules to LLMs for accurate, enterprise-grade output
* Define QAD's approach to agentic AI — moving from reactive Q&A to proactive, action-triggering intelligence within ERP workflows

**Enterprise Self-Service Reporting**

* Own the product strategy for self-service report building — enabling business users across manufacturing, finance, supply chain, and operations to create, customise, and share reports without engineering dependency
* Define the RBAC model for reporting: row-level and column-level access controls, report sharing permissions, data scoping by plant, region, and business unit — ensuring enterprise customers can safely deploy self-service capabilities across large, complex org structures
* Lead the go-to-market and rollout strategy for self-service reporting across B2B industry verticals — working with Customer Success and Solutions Engineering to drive adoption, define onboarding playbooks, and reduce time-to-value for enterprise deployments
* Set the product bar for enterprise-grade report authoring: scheduling, export, embedding, white-labelling, and audit trails that meet the compliance and operational needs of regulated industries
* Establish feedback loops with enterprise customers to continuously refine the self-service experience — tracking adoption metrics, identifying capability gaps, and prioritising the roadmap against real user workflows

**Data Infrastructure & Intelligence**

* Partner with Engineering to define the data lake, pipeline, and event architecture that underpins ERA's intelligence layer — optimising for AI-readiness, scale, and cost efficiency
* Own the metric registry and semantic data model — ensuring consistent, governed definitions of manufacturing KPIs across all ERA consumers
* Collaborate with the Governance & Compliance pillar to ensure intelligence outputs meet enterprise compliance requirements; own the data quality and freshness standards within your layer
* Define monetization strategy for intelligence platform capabilities including governed data exports, delta sharing, and partner integrations

**GTM, Sales & Market Enablement**

* Act as the product authority for Sales and Marketing on ERA's Data, AI, and Analytics capabilities — providing positioning, messaging, and competitive differentiation across the full intelligence layer, not just reporting

jobs.description:
**What You'll Do**

* Own the vision and the roadmap :
* Turn the company vision into a product strategy and a roadmap the whole company can plan against.
* Help us prioritize opportunities as we expand the product, go up-market, and explore new possibilities.
* Own product metrics end to end : turnaround time, accuracy, coverage, adoption and revenue per product line.
* Develop and execute the product strategy and roadmap to move the needle on ARR, Retention, and ACV, in collaboration with the GTM teams.
* Stay close to customers and regulators :
* Spend time every week with credit, risk, legal and operations teams at banks, NBFCs and HFCs. Know their workflows better than they do.
* Track RBI, NHB and CERSAI direction and public infrastructure such as ULI, and build ahead of it instead of reacting to it.
* Sit in on key enterprise deals and renewals, and bring back what the product needs to win the next one.
* Ship, hands-on :
* Write specs, prototype with AI tools and review output quality yourself. This is a player-coach role.
* Partner with Engineering, Data Acquisition and Data Science to balance speed with platform reliability and compliance-grade accuracy.
* Make AI a product advantage : document understanding in 14 languages, title reasoning and automated risk signals that a credit officer can trust and audit.
* Drive adoption and ARR with GTM and Sales :
* Co-own adoption and ARR targets with the Sales and GTM leads. A product is not shipped until customers are using it and paying for it.
* Work on positioning, messaging and launch content, so the market understands what each product does and why it matters to a lender.
* Equip Sales and Customer Success with demos, proof points, ROI cases and competitive answers, and join key pitches, renewals and expansion conversations.
* Run a tight loop on win/loss reasons, usage data and customer feedback, and use it to grow usage and revenue within existing accounts.
* Own pricing and monetization :
* Leverage experience in B2B SaaS to make informed decisions around monetization, pricing, and product enhancements that help grow ARR and ACV.
* Lead and grow the team :
* Hire, coach and raise the bar for product managers and designers.
* Set a lightweight operating rhythm for discovery, prioritization, releases and feedback loops with Sales and Delivery.
* Represent product to the board, investors, customers and ecosystem partners.
* Foster a culture of low ego, high impact, and continuous learning.

**What We're Looking For**

* 10+ years in product management, including 3+ years leading product managers.
* You have owned a B2B platform, API or data product end to end and scaled it from early traction to a large customer base.
* Experience selling into or building for regulated enterprises, ideally banks, NBFCs or insurers, with long sales cycles and compliance reviews.
* First-principles thinking : you can break an ambiguous problem into bets, and show the data behind your calls.
* High agency and low ego. You do whatever part of the PM job the week demands.
* AI-native in how you work and what you build. You have shipped products where ML or LLM output quality was the product.
* Experience with data products where coverage, freshness and accuracy are the core metrics.
* Comfort with pricing and packaging for enterprise and usage-based API models.
* A track record of hiring and growing strong PMs.

**Nice-to-haves**

* Experience taking a B2B data asset into a consumer or partner-led product.
* Background in lending, mortgage, credit risk, collateral or fintech infrastructure.
* You have been a founder or an early leader at a company through Series A to C.

**Why You'll Love Working Here**

* Impact : property is India's largest asset class and its least liquid. Your work decides how fast credit reaches homeowners, small businesses and farmers.
* A real moat to build on : a property dataset and identity layer that took years to assemble, with live banking customers already using it.
* Ownership : a leadership seat, direct access to founders, board and customers, and meaningful equity.
* Compensation and benefits : Competitive salary, ESOPs, health cover, leave policy and other benefits.

jobs.title: Head of Technology / VP Engineering
jobs.description:
**Hiring: Head of Technology / VP Engineering**

**Company:**
KGIL Fintech Solutions Pvt. Ltd. (SwipeLoan)

**Location:**
Hinjawadi, Pune | Work from Office

**Experience:**
10–15+ years in Technology, Software Engineering, Architecture and Engineering Leadership

**CTC:**
₹18–24 LPA, depending on experience and technical expertise

**Reporting to:**
Founder & CEO

**About KGIL**

KGIL is building a diversified technology ecosystem with products spanning fintech, digital lending, credit solutions and emerging consumer internet businesses.

Through SwipeLoan and our expanding portfolio of digital platforms, we aim to develop and scale technology-driven businesses across multiple industries.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a highly experienced, hands-on technology leader with
**CTO-level capabilities**
who can take complete ownership of technology strategy, architecture, engineering, infrastructure, cybersecurity and product development across our growing ecosystem.

This is not a conventional IT management role.

The selected candidate must be capable of independently evaluating new business concepts, selecting appropriate technology stacks, designing scalable systems, building engineering teams and delivering end-to-end technology solutions.

We are looking for a technology generalist with deep engineering expertise who is comfortable working across different programming languages, frameworks, architectures and business domains.

The candidate should have the technical judgment and leadership ability to build products using both existing and emerging technologies, without being restricted to any single programming language or framework.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. End-to-End Technology Ownership**

* Own the complete technology function across existing and future KGIL platforms.
* Define long-term technology strategy, architecture standards and engineering roadmaps.
* Independently translate business ideas into technical requirements, architecture and execution plans.
* Take responsibility for technology decisions from product conceptualisation to development, deployment, scaling and maintenance.
* Act as the primary technology advisor to the Founder & CEO.
* Evaluate technical feasibility, development timelines, resource requirements and infrastructure costs for new businesses.
* Ensure all platforms are secure, scalable, reliable and commercially efficient.

**2. Multi-Technology & Full-Stack Engineering Leadership**

Lead engineering across multiple technology stacks, including but not limited to:

* **Backend:**
  PHP, Laravel, Node.js, Python, Django, FastAPI, Java, Spring Boot, Go and other relevant technologies.
* **Frontend:**
  React.js, Next.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, Angular and modern frontend frameworks.
* **Mobile Applications:**
  Flutter, React Native, native Android and iOS development.
* **Databases:**
  MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis and other SQL/NoSQL technologies.
* **Cloud & Infrastructure:**
  AWS, cloud-native architecture, Docker, Kubernetes, serverless systems and CI/CD.
* **Integrations:**
  REST APIs, GraphQL, webhooks, third-party APIs, payment gateways and external services.
* **AI & Automation:**
  AI/ML integrations, LLM-based applications, intelligent automation and data-driven product capabilities.

The candidate is not expected to write production code in every language personally but must possess sufficient architectural and technical depth to evaluate, guide and manage engineering teams working across different technology stacks.

**3. New Product Development & Technology Expansion**

* Lead technology development for new businesses across fintech and non-fintech industries.
* Evaluate new product ideas and recommend the most suitable technology stack for each business.
* Design and deliver MVPs, scalable applications and enterprise-grade platforms.
* Lead development of consumer applications, marketplaces, subscription platforms, SaaS products, social networking applications and e-commerce solutions.
* Build reusable technology components, shared services and APIs wherever commercially appropriate.
* Evaluate build-versus-buy decisions, third-party platforms and outsourcing opportunities.
* Ensure new product launches meet defined timelines, budgets and quality standards.
* Support rapid experimentation, prototyping and product-market validation.

**4. Technology Architecture & Scalability**

* Design scalable, secure and high-performance application architectures.
* Make informed decisions between monolithic, modular and microservices architectures.
* Establish standards for API design, database architecture, system integrations and data management.
* Implement performance optimisation, caching, monitoring and system observability.
* Plan infrastructure capacity for high-volume applications and rapid user growth.

As a Product Manager II, you will establish and guide product strategy for products of low to medium complexity, working closely with senior product managers and directors to align solutions with broader business and enterprise objectives. * Proven critical thinking, collaboration, and decision-making skills.

jobs.title: MRGR Review Lead - Executive Director
jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Are you looking for an exciting opportunity to join a dynamic and growing team in a fast paced and challenging area? This is a unique opportunity for you to work in our team to partner with the business to provide a comprehensive view.

As an Executive Director in model risk governance and review within International Consumer Banking, you will serve as the review lead and be accountable for independent model reviews and model governance. You will be accountable to the International Consumer Banking Model Risk Officer for these independent reviews and governance activities. You will also serve as the Consumer and Community Banking and International Consumer Banking India lead, accountable to the line of business head. You will work with senior business, model development, and risk partners.

**Job responsibilities**

* Lead as review lead for International Consumer Banking and be accountable for the quality, consistency, and timeliness of independent model reviews.
* Set review priorities, allocate reviews, and approve review findings and conclusions covering conceptual soundness, assumptions, inputs, testing, and implementation; personally lead the most complex or high-risk reviews.
* Discuss findings and required actions with model owners and senior stakeholders, and resolve differences on review conclusions.
* Oversee the review of proposed enhancements to existing models and extensions of model scope, and provide approvals as required.
* Oversee the assessment of risks from advanced artificial intelligence and machine learning models, including generative artificial intelligence and agentic artificial intelligence, and ensure required model review and governance processes are followed.
* Oversee model risk lifecycle activities, including model inventory accuracy, ongoing performance monitoring, annual status assessments, and model change control; ensure these activities are completed accurately and on time.
* Maintain robust model risk controls for International Consumer Banking models and serve as the primary point of contact; proactively identify and escalate issues to ensure resolutions are sound and timely.
* Serve as the Consumer and Community Banking and International Consumer Banking India lead, accountable to the line of business head.
* Prioritize training and career development for team members; coach and mentor staff at all levels, set clear expectations, and give regular feedback.

**Location:** Andheri East, Mumbai, Maharashtra  
**Job Type:** Full-Time  
**Experience Required:** 7–12 Years  
**Department:** Accounts & Finance

Job Summary

We are hiring an experienced Accounts & Finance Manager to oversee financial operations across multiple Indian and international entities within our cross-border e-commerce business.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in accounting and financial reporting, marketplace reconciliations, international taxation, inventory accounting, cash flow management, statutory compliance and team management.

Key Responsibilities

**Accounting & Financial Reporting**

* Manage accounting operations across multiple Indian and international entities.
* Ensure timely monthly, quarterly and annual financial closures.
* Prepare and review P&L, Balance Sheets, Trial Balance and financial statements.
* Finalize monthly P&L by the 10th of every month.
* Review ledgers, bank accounts, credit cards, sales, purchases, creditors, debtors and intercompany transactions.
* Manage accruals, provisions, depreciation, prepaid expenses and forex adjustments.

**E-commerce Accounting & Reconciliation**

* Handle marketplace reconciliations across Amazon, Noon, eBay, Walmart, Lazada, Shopee, Shopify and other platforms.
* Reconcile marketplace sales, settlements, commissions, refunds, returns, chargebacks and deductions.
* Monitor marketplace receivables, delayed settlements and stuck payouts.
* Reconcile marketplace reports with bank statements and accounting records.
* Coordinate with operations and account management teams to resolve discrepancies.

**Financial MIS & Profitability Analysis**

* Prepare monthly financial MIS and consolidated financial reports.
* Analyse revenue, margins, expenses and business profitability.
* Conduct product, brand and marketplace-level profitability analysis.
* Prepare landed-cost calculations, logistics cost comparisons and breakeven analysis.
* Identify cost leakages and opportunities for cost optimization.
* Present financial performance and variance analysis to management.

**Inventory & Procurement Accounting**

* Reconcile inventory across books, warehouses, marketplace reports and operational trackers.
* Monitor inventory movements, stock ageing, purchases, returns and damaged stock.
* Conduct inventory verification and investigate stock discrepancies.
* Review purchase and procurement reconciliations.

**Taxation & Statutory Compliance**

* Manage GST, TDS, Income Tax, Tax Audit, Advance Tax, PT, PF and ESIC coordination.
* Handle export-related GST compliance, LUT renewals and refund applications.
* Coordinate international taxation, including UAE VAT and Corporate Tax, Saudi VAT and Zakat, USA tax compliance, Singapore GST and UK VAT.
* Coordinate with Chartered Accountants, auditors and external tax consultants.
* Manage transfer pricing, related-party compliance and applicable international tax documentation.

**Banking & Treasury**

* Manage banking operations across domestic and international entities.
* Monitor bank reconciliations, cash balances and fund movements.
* Manage Payoneer and other international payment accounts.
* Track foreign remittances, export proceeds and import payments.
* Coordinate with AD banks for EDPMS, IDPMS and remittance documentation.
* Monitor cash flow, forex exposure and intercompany fund transfers.

**Audit, Cost Control & Team Management**

* Coordinate internal, statutory, tax and international audits.
* Maintain financial controls, SOPs, documentation and compliance trackers.
* Review logistics and vendor invoices and identify cost-saving opportunities.
* Lead and supervise the Accounts & Finance team.
* Allocate responsibilities, review performance and train team members.
* Work closely with management on budgets, financial projections and business planning.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* CA / CA Inter / CMA / MBA Finance / M.Com / B.Com.
* 7–12 years of experience in Accounts & Finance.
* Minimum 3–5 years of managerial or team supervisory experience.
* Experience in e-commerce, retail, export-import, cross-border trade or multi-entity accounting preferred.
* Strong understanding of accounting principles, financial reporting and taxation.
* Experience in international entities, marketplace reconciliation and foreign currency transactions.
* Proficiency in Tally Prime or other ERP/accounting software.
* Advanced Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, Lookup functions and financial modelling.
* Strong analytical skills, leadership, ownership and attention to detail.

Pay: ₹500,000.00 - ₹1,200,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

jobs.description:
**Job Summary / Introduction**

* Drive the development of the FAB Asset Management product range across all asset classes and product types, grounded in market analysis, client demand and competitive positioning.
* Own product ideation and design - investment proposition, target segment, vehicle and share class design, fee structure and commercial positioning - with legal documentation, regulatory filing and implementation executed by the relevant departments.
* Own product pricing and economics, including fee grids, margins, distribution economics and profitability, ensuring products are competitive in the market and commercially viable for FAB AM.
* Manage the product lifecycle end-to-end, from pipeline and business case to launch readiness, post-launch review, range rationalisation, mergers and closures.
* Contribute directly to the commercial effort alongside the sales and distribution teams, in particular on RFPs, due diligence questionnaires and client proposals.
* Live and demonstrate the FAB AM values.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Market and competitive analysis: Analyse market trends, flows, client demand and regulatory developments across all asset classes and product types, and maintain systematic benchmarking of competitor ranges, structures, fee levels and commercial propositions.
* Pricing and product economics: Define and own the pricing architecture - management and performance fees, share classes, distribution economics, breakpoints and discounts - and model revenue, margin and profitability per product.
* Product design and structuring: Design the product: investment proposition, mandate and benchmark, vehicle and domicile, share classes, currency and hedging, distribution model and target investor base; structuring here is design, not legal implementation.
* Business case and pipeline: Build the business case for each new product and prepare the papers required by the relevant committees; own the product pipeline and the multi-year roadmap, aligned to the commercial strategy and distribution capacity.
* Commercial positioning: Define the positioning, differentiation and value proposition of each product, and equip the commercial teams with the content, arguments and competitive comparisons needed to sell effectively.
* RFPs and commercial proposals: Contribute actively to the commercial effort with the sales and distribution teams by drafting and reviewing the product, strategy and competitive sections of RFPs, DDQs and client proposals, and by maintaining a reusable library of approved product content and Q&A.
* Lifecycle management: Monitor the performance, flows, profitability and relevance of the existing range, and drive rationalisation, repositioning, mergers and closures where appropriate.
* Cross-functional delivery: Act as design authority and business owner through the delivery of each product, working with Investments, Legal, Compliance, Risk, Operations, Technology and external counsel who execute documentation, filing and implementation.
* Regulatory awareness and reporting: Maintain a solid understanding of the ADGM and CMA product frameworks and their implications for product design and distribution, and report to management on pipeline, launches, pricing and product economics.

**Requirements / Qualifications**

* Experience: 5 to 10 years in product development, product management or product strategy within asset management or regulated financial services.
* Market, competition and pricing: Hands-on experience analysing markets, client demand and competitor ranges using industry databases, and defining or challenging fee structures and product profitability.
* Product knowledge: Solid understanding of investment products, strategies and vehicle structures across all asset classes and product types, including share class and distribution mechanics, and sufficient familiarity with product documentation to direct the teams executing it.
* Commercial support: Practical experience responding to RFPs and due diligence questionnaires and producing client-facing proposal content, with excellent written English and the ability to meet tight commercial deadlines.
* Regulatory and stakeholder skills: Working knowledge of the regulatory environment applicable to product design and distribution; proven ability to lead multi-stakeholder workstreams and manage timelines and dependencies.
* Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business or a related discipline.
* Capabilities: Analytical rigour, commercial judgement, initiative and the ability to turn market insight into a credible, differentiated and profitable product proposition.

**Preferred / Beneficial**

* Regulatory and stakeholder skills: ADGM and CMA an advantage.
* Qualifications: CFA, CAIA or equivalent professional qualifications are advantageous.

jobs.title: Vice President- Retail Credit Policy
jobs.description:
Job Purpose
  
• Manage portfolio risk strategy and performance management for unsecured retail assets, including credit cards, personal loans, BNPL and other digital lending products.
  
• Own the end-to-end risk decision framework across acquisition, account management, line assignment, pricing, collections and customer lifecycle management.
  
• Use advanced analytics, segmentation and AI/ML models to optimize growth, credit quality, customer outcomes and risk-adjusted profitability.
  
• Provide the senior leadership team with forward-looking portfolio insights, clear risk appetite recommendations and timely actions to maintain losses, returns and capital consumption within plan.
  
  
Key Result Areas
  
• Set and execute portfolio strategies for credit cards, personal loans, BNPL and emerging digital credit propositions, aligned with approved risk appetite, growth plans and regulatory requirements.
  
• Own portfolio performance across approval rates, activation, utilization, balances, yield, delinquencies, roll rates, loss rates, risk charge, vintage performance, expected credit loss, capital and risk-adjusted returns.
  
• Develop granular customer, product, channel, employer, income and behavioral segmentation to identify growth pockets, emerging risks and differentiated treatment strategies.
  
• Design and govern risk decision frameworks covering eligibility, score cut-offs, affordability, limits, tenor, pricing, line management, cross-sell, collections and exit strategies.
  
• Lead champion–challenger tests and controlled experiments; define success metrics, guardrails and post-implementation monitoring to scale profitable strategies safely.
  
• Partner with data science teams to develop, validate and deploy application, behavioral, propensity, fraud and early-warning models using traditional and alternative data.
  
• Establish responsible AI and model governance, including explainability, fairness, drift, stability, override, monitoring and human-oversight standards.
  
• Build executive dashboards, forecasts and scenario analyses linking risk drivers to revenue, margin, credit cost, operating expense, capital and lifetime customer profitability.
  
• Define early-warning indicators, portfolio triggers and remediation playbooks for adverse trends, concentration risks and macroeconomic or market shocks.
  
• Provide independent retail credit risk challenge for new products, partnerships, fintech propositions and material changes to customer journeys or decision engines.
  
• Ensure compliance with Central Bank requirements, internal policies, model risk standards, consumer protection expectations and audit requirements.
  
• Lead, coach and develop a high-performing portfolio analytics team and strengthen data-driven decision making across Retail Banking.
  
  
Knowledge, Skills and Experience
  
• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Finance, Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science or a related quantitative discipline; postgraduate qualification is preferred.
  
• Experience: Typically 12–15 years in retail credit risk, portfolio management or risk analytics, including substantial leadership responsibility and direct exposure to credit cards, personal loans and digital lending/BNPL.
  
• Portfolio expertise: Proven ownership of acquisition and account-management strategies, vintages, roll rates, delinquency, loss forecasting, provisions, risk-adjusted profitability, limit management, collections strategies and portfolio optimization.
  
• Analytics and modeling: Strong command of statistical analysis, experimentation, segmentation, forecasting, scorecards and AI/ML applications across underwriting, behavioral risk, propensity, fraud and early warning.
  
• Technical capability: Hands-on proficiency in SQL and at least one analytical language such as Python, R or SAS; strong working knowledge of Power BI/Tableau, large datasets, data pipelines and cloud analytics environments.
  
• Decision frameworks: Demonstrated ability to translate analytics into executable cut-offs, pricing, limits, treatments and growth strategies with clear economics, controls and performance measurement.
  
• Governance: Sound understanding of model risk, responsible AI, explainability, fairness, data privacy, consumer protection, IFRS 9/provisioning concepts and Central Bank requirements relevant to retail lending.
  
• Leadership: Strong executive communication, stakeholder influence and people leadership, with the ability to challenge constructively and present complex risk-return choices to senior committees.

jobs.title: Gen AI Product Engineer
jobs.description:
Join us as a Gen AI Product Engineer
  
  

* In this key role, you’ll be responsible for designing, building, and scaling Generative AI (GenAI)-powered products and features that deliver tangible business value
* We’ll look to you to bridge product thinking and engineering execution, translating user needs into robust, production-ready AI solutions while driving innovation in the application of GenAI capabilities
* This is an opportunity to design and deliver production-grade GenAI solutions, including AI agents, conversational AI, and automation, with a focus on scalability, reliability, and performance
* We're offering this role at vice president level

What you'll do
  
  
As a Gen AI Product Engineer, you'll design, build, and deploy production-grade GenAI products and systems that turn user and business needs into secure, scalable, and reliable solutions. You'll also translate product and user requirements into scalable technical solutions, balancing model quality, latency, system complexity, and long-term maintainability, while building and integrating large language model (LLM) capabilities using modern frameworks and application programming interfaces (APIs).
  
  
This will include working across orchestration layers, retrieval pipelines, system integrations, prompt and context engineering, and model evaluation.
  
  
**You'll Also Be**

* Converting ambiguous product requirements and research concepts into robust technical architectures, balancing model capability, latency, cost, complexity, and maintainability
* Ensuring all GenAI solutions meet enterprise security, governance, responsible AI, and risk management standards, with appropriate controls, escalation, and mitigation built into delivery
* Developing and operating LLM solutions, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, agent workflows, orchestration, prompt and content engineering, and model integration patterns
* Integrating GenAI capabilities into existing platforms through internal APIs, services, event flows, and data pipelines, ensuring resilience, observability, and maintainability in production environments
* Defining and applying approaches to model evaluation, benchmarking, monitoring, and continuous optimisation to improve quality, accuracy, reliability, and user outcomes
* Identifying and managing real-world AI system failure modes, including hallucinations, retrieval failures, tool-call errors, degraded model performance, and unsafe or non-compliant outputs
* Supporting production operations, including service monitoring, incident response, root-cause analysis, and on-call responsibilities where required for business-critical GenAI systems

The skills you'll need
  
  
We're looking for someone with proven experience designing, building, and operating production-grade GenAI software systems, with strong capabilities in Python, front-end design frameworks, distributed systems, API design, cloud-native engineering, observability, and performance-critical workloads. You should also bring experience translating ambiguous research concepts, emerging AI capabilities, user needs, and product requirements into secure, scalable, and maintainable production systems within fast-moving product or research-led environments.
  
  
To succeed in this role, you'll need experience delivering GenAI or LLM-powered products beyond the prototype stage, including self-hosted model inference with frameworks such as vLLM, OpenAI-compatible serving patterns, orchestration layers, software development kit integration, and production systems. You must also bring a practical understanding of LLM application architecture, including prompt and context engineering, embeddings, vector search, RAG pipelines, agent workflows, tool-calling patterns, memory and context management, and the mitigation of real-world AI system failure modes.
  
  
**You'll Also Demonstrate**

* An understanding of model training, fine-tuning, adaptation, inference, and serving pipelines, including trade-offs in model selection, performance, cost, reliability, scalability, and operational complexity
* Experience evaluating, monitoring, and optimising AI systems, with working knowledge of responsible AI, model risk, security, governance, and operational controls in enterprise or regulated environments
* Hands-on experience deploying small language models for latency-, cost-, privacy-, or domain-specific use cases

jobs.description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

Citi, the world leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and a presence in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions worldwide. Citi provides consumers, corporations, governments and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management. Citi enables clients to achieve their strategic financial objectives by providing them with cutting-edge ideas, best-in-class products and solutions, and unparalleled access to capital and liquidity.

  
  

The Derivatives Credit Risk Technology Team is responsible for delivering Counterparty Credit Risk Management software solutions to Citi’s Risk organization which manages Citi’s exposure to financial institutions, governments and corporates that trade with Citi. The team builds and maintains software used to compute metrics that help mitigate Citi’s exposure to counterparty default. These include computation of optimal Margin Allocation for Portfolios and Trades, Haircut for Security and Cash Collateral, Trade and Collateral Liquidity, Collateral Concentration Levels and Wrong Way Risk, amongst others.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  
  

* Liaise with stakeholders across the Risk and Front Office Technology, Counterparty Risk Management, Finance and Front Office business organizations, and external Market Regulators to assemble business requirements for Counterparty Risk Technology projects.

* Manage expectations of various stakeholder groups and help negotiate solutions to complex problems.

* Project manage complex Counterparty Credit Risk projects end to end. Accurately record, maintain, and report Program/Project management tracking data such as milestones via Citi’s internal project tracking systems.

* Help assemble/manage detailed documentation covering Counterparty Risk calculations and other processing, to be used to discuss technology implementation details with the Business users and Market Regulators in various countries/regions. Create flow diagrams, structure charts, and other types of system or process representations when appropriate.

* Facilitate and drive project meetings with both business and technology teams.

* Develop and review test scripts with business users as well as technology teams for System, User and Impact testing.

* Understand, analyse, and explain counterparty mark-to-future exposures on Derivatives books to users. Investigate Potential Future Exposure/EPE/EAD/RWA and related calculations for internal risk management and BASEL regulatory capital reporting based on the exposure profiles generated by the systems.

* Ability to trace changes in day to day exposures to changes in markets, books and or legal agreements.

* Where feasible develop excel prototypes to demonstrate and analyse risk calculations.
  

  

**Knowledge/Experience:**

  
  

* 8-12 years related experience in Business Analysis and Project Management in Capital Markets domain.

* SDLC awareness including knowledge of quality issues in software development.

* Excellent understanding of the mechanics and life cycle of derivatives products, including Options, Futures, Forwards and Swaps. Knowledge of Securities Financing Transactions (SFT) products an advantage.

* Excellent understanding of Counterparty Credit Risk

* Potential Future Exposure, Margin (ISDA MNA and CSA), Collateral Haircut, Liquidity and Period of Risk, Settlement Risk.

* Understanding of Basel III/IV and any other relevant Risk Regulations and measures including PSE, RWA, EAD.

* Knowledge of Market Risk an advantage including Credit Value Adjustment (CVA).

* Extensive project management experience, including co-ordination across remote global teams.

* Where required supervise day-to-day staff management issues, work allocation but especially mentoring/coaching.

* Data Analysis capabilities (Database or Spreadsheet), with extensive experience using Excel required.
  

  

**Education:**

  
  

* Bachelor's degree/University degree or equivalent experience. Master's degree an advantage.

* Graduate in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics) or Finance disciplines.

* FRM/CFA or other Financial mathematics degree or certification is an advantage.

*Exceptional candidates who do not meet these criteria may be considered for the role provided they have the necessary skills and experience.*

  
  

**Competencies:**

  
  

* Excellent verbal and written English.

* Ability to collaborate effectively in a large global team.

* Ability to take ownership and proactively follow up on issues.

* Ability to work well under pressure, to agreed and often challenging deadlines.

* Strong organization skills.

Citi, the leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and does business in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions. Citi provides consumers, corporations, governments and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management. Our core activities are safeguarding assets, lending money, making payments and accessing the capital markets on behalf of our clients.

Our mission is to serve as a trusted partner to our clients by responsibly providing financial services that enable growth and economic progress. We strive to earn and maintain our clients and the publics trust by constantly adhering to the highest ethical standards and making a positive impact on the communities we serve. Our Leadership Standards is a common set of skills and expected behaviors that illustrate how our employees should work every day to be successful and strengthens our ability to execute against our strategic priorities.

  
  

**The Quality Assurance and Testing Validation (QATV) team** delivers independent oversight and rigorous validation across the organization's regulatory reporting ecosystem and is dedicated to ensuring the highest standards of accuracy, reliability and control through testing Citi’s regulatory and management reporting while providing an objective assessment of issue remediation.

QATV Reporting & Analytics team provides analytical support on:

Reporting & Intelligence — Building and maintaining data marts, synthesizing test results into quantitative metrics, and authoring detailed qualitative narratives and formal publication reports for senior stakeholders and report owners.

Operational Intelligence & Capacity Planning — Monitor testing sprints to ensure timeline adherence, leading proactive capacity planning across all execution phases, and leveraging skill assessments to assign qualified personnel to appropriate testing stages.

Testing & Exception Management Automation — Automation of design, creation, and execution of test scripts

  
  

**Job Summary:**

**Assistant Vice President (IC) - Data\Information Management** will be part of QATV team within Citi AIM vertical, a global community driving data-driven transformation across Citi. AIM's objective is to generate actionable intelligence for business leaders. In this role, the Analyst will support the QATV function by maintaining dedicated testing data marts, consolidating validation outcomes, identifying data inconsistencies, and assisting in the drafting of detailed narrative reports and metrics for final publication to key stakeholders.

Working in close collaboration with team leads, the Analyst will also support testing delivery governance and resource management. This includes monitoring sprint cycles to track milestone adherence, maintaining capacity planning models to ensure balanced workload distribution, and assisting with skills-matrix assessments to align team capabilities with testing demand across all phases of regulatory validation.

  
  

**In this role, you are expected to:**

* Assist in organizing and maintaining dedicated testing data marts and data pipelines.
* Expertise in data management principles, SQL, SAS programming for data extraction, manipulation and validations. Guide and mentor junior members in team in this area.
* Use of data warehousing concepts, ETL processes, and experience working with Business Intelligence platforms (e.g., Tableau, Power BI). To act as SME in this area and go-to person for the team.
* Research and identify data inconsistencies, trends, or reporting gaps to support root-cause analysis.
* Automate current process to remove manual effort
* Develop workflows and automation logic using SAS, SQL, Workflow tools
* Conduct in-depth analyses of current operational processes to identify inefficiencies and areas for improvement.
* Continuously improve processes and strategies by exploring and evaluating new data sources, tools, and capabilities
* Work closely with internal and external business partners in building, implementing, tracking and improving decision strategies
* Support your team and help them accomplish their goals with empathy. You act as a facilitator and remove blockers and create a positive atmosphere for them to be innovative and productive at work
  

  

**Qualifications:**

* Work experience: 8+ years with Masters as Educational background

* Technical Skills: Expertise in data management principles, SQL, SAS , Python programming for data extraction and manipulation, and database management systems. Including Tableau, and other BI tools.

* Strong coding expertise in SAS & SQL, Autosys package.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and quantify opportunities for improvement.

jobs.description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

Whether you’re at the start of your career or looking to discover your next adventure, your story begins here. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to expand your skills and make a difference at one of the world’s most global banks. We’re fully committed to supporting your growth and development from the start with extensive on-the-job training and exposure to senior leaders, as well as more traditional learning. You’ll also have the chance to give back and make a positive impact where we live and work through volunteerism.

Citi continues to enhance its business control and governance framework by building out Institutional Credit Management (ICM), a first line of defense business line, to house and consistently manage credit risk activities performed for Citi’s institutional clients. ICM’s objective is to provide integrated end-to-end credit underwriting, identification, measurement, management, and monitoring for wholesale credit across the enterprise.

Within ICM, the Credit Underwriting function (“ICM UW” or “UW”) provides credit analysis, underwriting, and first line of defense credit approval for periodic / material transaction reviews, and any necessary subsequent credit monitoring across all institutional business including Corporate Banking, Services, and Markets relationships.

ICM Underwriters manage a portfolio of relationships, being responsible for the continuous monitoring of that portfolio. That includes the production of annual reviews, quarterly reviews, and the support of ad-hoc transactions and portfolio & industry reviews and stress testing, in partnership with Business and Risk.

**In this role, you’re expected to:**

Executes, aligned with global and regional strategies, all responsibilities regarding underwriting, including, but not limited to:

* Adoption of leading practices in credit analysis, underwriting, and monitoring, including the end-to-end underwriting process, from early origination discussions to development of credit approval memos, and senior approval forums

* Detailed review of financial analysis, due diligence, projection modeling, stress testing, risk ratings and other in-depth analysis performed by junior resources

* Review and approval of Credit Approval Memos (CAM) packages

* Facilitate relationships with key clients in Banking and Risk and with key Regulators, Internal Audit, and control functions

* Support ICM Underwriting organization on strategic initiatives / projects as required

* Ability to provide strategic insights and strong sensitivity to macro and regulatory issues
* Able to discuss and address issues associated with the allocation of risk assets and risk capital in partnership with banking and product organizations

* Proven track record of partnering with global peers in leveraging and implementation of best practices

**As a successful candidate, you’d ideally have the following skills and exposure:**

* 12+ years risk/risk-related credit work experience in banking/financial institutions
* Proven ability to effectively engage with regulators and internal control functions including Internal Audit and Fundamental Credit Risk as well as with external audit
* Demonstrates strong ethics and integrity
* Ability to see the ‘big picture’ in a complex environment
* Can make decisions under pressure and short timeline
* Excellent verbal & written communication skills. Active listening skills.
* Excellent presentation skills – adept at presenting effectively to audiences of various sizes and various constituencies

* Bachelor’s/University degree, Master’s degree preferred

International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) helps deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities, and exceptional people. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to support individuals, families, business owners, investors, and entrepreneurs. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best-in-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance.

  

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join the India Demat Team within India International Wealth and Premier Banking as Assistant Vice President – Demat Operations.

  

**Role Purpose**

  

The role holder will manage end-to-end depository participant operations within a regulated bank environment, encompassing demat account opening and servicing, settlement monitoring, reconciliations, income and DP charge controls, and regulatory reporting. The role will ensure accurate and timely execution in accordance with applicable SEBI requirements, NSDL/CDSL rules and bye-laws, PMLA, and HSBC policies and operating procedures.

  

The incumbent will drive operational efficiency and customer service quality across retail and corporate/institutional DP services, maintain robust risk and control standards, manage audit and regulatory review requirements, and implement regulatory and system changes within prescribed timelines.

  

**Principal Accountabilities**

* + Oversee demat account opening, modification, servicing and closure, including verification of client documentation and KYC/AML requirements, periodic account reviews, and corporate demat requests.
  + Ensure accurate and timely processing of dematerialisation and rematerialisation requests (DRF/RRF), Delivery Instruction Slips (DIS), pledge, un-pledge and invocation requests, and off-market and inter-depository transfers.
  + Monitor settlement cycles and ensure timely reconciliation with depositories and clearing corporations.
  + Oversee daily, weekly and monthly reconciliations of client holdings, DP balances, suspense accounts and control accounts; investigate and resolve reconciliation breaks.
  + Manage provisioning of income entries and reconciliation of DP charges in coordination with Finance/Accounts.
  + Prepare and submit regulatory and depository reports within prescribed timelines and maintain accurate MIS for management review and compliance oversight.

**Customers / Stakeholders**

  

* + Manage DP-related customer queries, grievances and escalations in coordination with branches, relationship and service teams, ensuring timely resolution.
  + Liaise with NSDL/CDSL, registrars and transfer agents (RTAs), Finance/Accounts, Compliance and other internal stakeholders to resolve servicing and operational matters.
  + Drive customer-centric improvements in turnaround time and service quality across retail and corporate/institutional DP services.
  + Act as the principal contact for Demat operational and regulatory matters across Operations, Compliance, Legal, Technology, Risk, Finance, Treasury, the business and relevant depositories.
  + Coordinate responses to regulatory queries, inspections, internal and external audits, and compliance reviews.
  + Drive cross-functional actions independently, secure clear ownership and deliver within agreed timelines.
  + Provide concise management reporting on key operational risks, regulatory actions, exceptions and outstanding deliverables.
  + Promote disciplined execution, clear accountability and strong collaboration across first- and second-line stakeholders.

* **Leadership and Teamwork**
  

* + Demonstrate ownership and accountability for assigned DP operations and coordinate with stakeholders to meet operational, regulatory and audit deadlines.
  + Work collaboratively with branches, service teams, Compliance, Finance and Technology on regulatory implementation, escalations and process changes.

* **Operational Effectiveness & Control**
  

* Conduct periodic process and control reviews to identify operational and regulatory risks.
* Own audit and inspection observations, agree remediation plans and ensure timely, evidenced closure.
* Monitor implementation of regulatory and product changes and confirm that required controls operate effectively.
* Proactively identify and escalate material operational, regulatory, conduct or control risks.
* Regulatory and business deliverables completed within prescribed timelines.
* Timely and sustainable closure of audit, inspection, compliance and control actions.
* Accuracy and completeness of regulatory trackers, governance records, evidence and management information.
* Reduction in repeat exceptions, overdue actions and material control gaps.
* Effective implementation of regulatory, product and process changes with appropriate documentation and stakeholder sign-off.
* Positive stakeholder feedback and effective escalation of material risks.
* Identify opportunities for automation and digitisation to reduce manual intervention and operational errors.
* Track new and revised regulatory and depository circulars and implement required process and control changes within defined timelines.
* Identify operational risks and ensure adherence to maker-checker controls, segregation of duties, standard operating procedures and HSBC operational risk frameworks.
* Monitor exceptions, failed transactions and reconciliation breaks, ensuring timely resolution and escalation of control issues.
* Strengthen controls over DIS usage, fraud prevention and unauthorised transactions, and maintain adherence to applicable KYC/AML, PMLA and depository requirements.
* Manage internal and concurrent audits, compliance inspections and regulatory reviews relating to DP operations; ensure closure of observations within stipulated timelines.
* Maintain HSBC internal control standards and ensure timely implementation of actions arising from audits and regulatory reviews.
  

This specialist role requiring independent judgement, strong execution discipline and the ability to influence senior and cross-functional stakeholders. The role holder will operate within approved product programmes, HSBC policies, procedures and governance standards, escalating matters outside delegated authority or risk appetite.

The role holder will maintain HSBC internal control standards, comply with relevant Group and local policies and procedures, and ensure timely implementation and closure of internal and external audit points and issues raised by regulators, Compliance or Risk.

  

**Role requirements / Educational Qualifications /Certification / Experience:**

  

* Graduate or postgraduate qualification, with relevant experience in banking or financial services, preferably across Liabilities, Banking Operations, Product Management and/or Demat/DP Operations
* 4–10 years of experience in DP operations, custody operations or capital markets operations within a bank, brokerage or financial institution, with hands-on experience of NSDL/

jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

jobs.description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

Whether you’re at the start of your career or looking to discover your next adventure, your story begins here. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to expand your skills and make a difference at one of the world’s most global banks. We’re fully committed to supporting your growth and development from the start with extensive on-the-job training and exposure to senior leaders, as well as more traditional learning. You’ll also have the chance to give back and make a positive impact where we live and work through volunteerism.

  
  

Citi continues to enhance its business control and governance framework by building out Institutional Credit Management (ICM), a first line of defense business line, to house and consistently manage credit risk activities performed for Citi’s institutional clients. ICM’s objective is to provide integrated end-to-end credit underwriting, identification, measurement, management, and monitoring for wholesale credit across the enterprise. Within ICM, the Credit Underwriting function (“ICM UW” or “UW”) provides credit analysis, underwriting, and first line of defense credit approval for periodic / material transaction reviews, and any necessary subsequent credit monitoring across all institutional business including Corporate Banking, Services, and Markets relationships.

  
  

ICM Underwriters manage a portfolio of relationships, being responsible for the continuous monitoring of that portfolio. That includes the production of annual reviews, quarterly reviews, and the support of ad-hoc transactions and portfolio & industry reviews and stress testing, in partnership with Business and Risk.

The successful candidate will join the Commodities Underwriting team and will manage a group of junior analysts based in Mumbai who support Underwriters in London. The Commodities Underwriting team is responsible for the coverage of commodity traders as well as clients from other commodity related industries globally.

**In this role, you’re expected to:**

  
  

Executes, aligned with global and regional strategies, all responsibilities regarding underwriting, including, but not limited to:

  
  

* Maintains underwriting coverage of an existing portfolio of clients while supporting the underwriting of prospective commodities managed clients (CMC); the geographical coverage will include companies from Europe and Asia.
* Manage a team of 4/5 junior analysts in Mumbai by focusing on talent development, workflow management, and performance evaluations.
* Adoption of leading practices in credit analysis, underwriting, and monitoring, including the end-to-end underwriting process, from early origination discussions to development of credit approval memos, and senior approval forums.
* Detailed review of financial analysis, due diligence, projection modeling, stress testing, risk ratings and other in-depth analysis performed by junior resources.
* Review and approval of Credit Approval Memos (CAM) packages for monitoring or transaction purposes.
* Partner with Front Office on structuring and production of term sheets for new transactions.
* Partners with Legal in the negotiation of credit terms related to trading documentation (such as ISDA, EFET and other trading documents).
* Facilitate relationships with key clients in Banking and Risk and other control functions.
* Support ICM Underwriting organization on strategic initiatives / projects as required.

**Risk Management Experience:**

  
  

* Senior credit approval authority covering large and complex underwritings, capital commitments, derivatives with multi-industry experience.
* Ability to work independently, demonstrated credit judgement and experience navigating risk policies.
* Experience in and exposure to global credit risk management standards.
* Ability to understand capital markets products and complex financing and product structures including derivatives.
* Ability to provide strategic insights and strong sensitivity to macro and regulatory issues.
* Able to discuss and address issues associated with the allocation of risk assets and risk capital in partnership with banking and product organizations.

**Client Relationships / Business Partnership:**

  
  

* Proven ability to understand nuances of local markets, local regulation, and the capabilities and practices of competitors
* Navigates organizational complexity and breaks silos
* Creates and sustains a network of strong partnerships with the business in all segments, geographies and other risk functions
* Provides well-reasoned, balanced assessments of risk/return trade-offs associated with transactions and client relationships
* Proven track record of partnering with global peers in leveraging and implementation of best practices

**As a successful candidate, you’d ideally have the following skills and exposure:**

  
  

* Around 13+ years risk/risk-related credit work experience in banking/financial institutions or a commodity trader.
* Proven ability to effectively engage with Senior Credit Officers.
* Prior experience in managing a small team is preferred.
* Demonstrates strong ethics and integrity.

**Education:**

jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.description:
About
**Bright Money**

Bright Money
is a Consumer FinTech for middle-income consumers. It brings together SaaS products that help consumers build credit, manage their debt, and access suitable loans and credit cards - the major financial needs of middle-income consumers living paycheck to paycheck.

Bright is a profitable, India-built, U.S.-market Consumer FinTech, with a revenue trajectory to $100M in the coming 6 months. The business model combines subscription revenue with financial services marketplace revenue from loans, credit cards, and credit-building tools.

Bright has launched an AI money assistant and AI agentic UX flows for access to credit. It will be the first AI-driven Consumer FinTech for middle-income consumers.

The Bright product suite has potential for global markets beyond the US. The market size is 100M global middle-income consumers, with a revenue pool opportunity of $15B.

Bright is backed by three top global venture capital firms and leading tech angel investors in the USA, Europe, and Asia.

Bright was established in 2019 by a leadership team drawn from McKinsey’s Banking Practice (Petko Plachkov and Avi Patchava) and InMobi’s Data Sciences organisation (Varun Modi and Avi Patchava). The core team is ex-InMobi Engineering and Data Sciences, joined more recently by senior leaders from McKinsey. Bright has a data-driven, fast-paced execution culture, and is building a global Consumer FinTech with all functions operating from India.

**What is the role about?**

Bright is looking for a Director - Engineering to lead and scale a core part of our engineering organisation in Bengaluru, reporting to the CTO. You will own delivery and technical direction for the systems behind Bright’s consumer app, credit decisioning, and AI products, and you will build the leadership layer that runs them.

This is a leader-of-leaders role. You will manage engineering managers and leads, shape architecture and platform strategy for your area within the CTO’s technical direction, own headcount, budget, and cloud spend for your teams, and partner with Product, Data Sciences, and the wider leadership team on what gets built next.

Bright is profitable, scaling fast in the U.S. market, and building AI into both the product and how the company runs. The systems are distributed, data-heavy, and carry real money and credit decisions, so engineering quality is a business outcome here, not an internal metric.

**What will you do?**

* Lead your organisation: Own and scale a multi-team group, with engineering managers and leads reporting to you; set the operating rhythm, standards, and performance bar across your teams.
* Build the leadership layer: Hire, coach, and retain senior engineers, leads, and managers, and develop the next line of engineering leadership beneath you.
* Technical strategy: Shape and execute architecture and platform strategy across services, data, and developer tooling for your area, in line with the CTO’s technical direction, and make the build-versus-buy and platformisation calls that shape how fast your teams can ship.
* Delivery at scale: Own end-to-end delivery of distributed, data-heavy systems - roadmap commitments, release predictability, and the trade-offs between speed and durability.
* Reliability & risk: Own availability, performance, security, and the engineering side of compliance obligations for the systems your teams run in a U.S. consumer-lending business.
* AI & ML in production: Partner with Data Sciences to productionise ML and Gen AI systems-serving, monitoring, and retraining - and raise engineering leverage through AI tooling across the org.
* Cross-functional leadership: Partner with Product, Data Sciences, Infrastructure, and business teams on priorities, sequencing, and the commitments engineering makes to them.
* Planning & budget: Own annual and quarterly planning for your area - headcount, vendor decisions, cloud cost and TCO, and the resourcing choices behind them.
* Reporting & visibility: Report clearly to the CTO and the wider leadership team on progress, risk, capacity, and investment, and contribute to leadership reviews as needed.

**Ideal candidate profile**

**Experience & Background:**

* Experience: 12+ years in engineering, with 5+ years in engineering leadership and at least 2 years managing managers or leads.
* Organisation scale: Has led a multi-team group of 20+ engineers, and has grown a team through a period of rapid scaling.
* Systems depth: Deep hands-on background in distributed, high-throughput, data-heavy systems; still able to go deep in a design review and hold a credible technical argument.
* Architecture & platform: Proven ownership of architecture, platformisation, and developer tooling, with evidence of the delivery gains those investments produced.
* ML & AI in production: Experience productionising ML or Gen AI systems in partnership with data science teams.
* Commercial ownership: Experience owning engineering budgets, cloud cost and TCO, vendor decisions, and resource planning.
* Hiring record: A strong track record of hiring and developing senior engineers and engineering managers.
* Domain: Experience in fintech, payments, lending, or another regulated, high-reliability consumer business is a strong plus.
* Location: Based in Bengaluru, or willing to relocate.

**Mindset & Operating DNA:**

* Ownership: Takes accountability for outcomes beyond their own remit, not only for their teams’ deliverables.
* Technical credibility: Earns the respect of senior engineers through judgment and depth, not position.
* Strategic thinking: Connects technical choices to business outcomes and can defend the trade-offs to a non-technical audience.
* Builder of leaders: Measures success by the strength of the managers and engineers they develop.
* Pace: Thrives in a high-growth environment where structure is still being built, and brings clarity rather than waiting for it.

**Non-Fit Profiles**

* Individual contributors or architects without sustained people-leadership experience.
* Managers who have led a single team, without experience managing managers or leading a group through scale.
* Leaders who have moved fully away from technical depth and cannot hold their own in architecture and design discussions.
* Candidates from large, process-heavy environments who need established structure, and are uncomfortable in a fast-moving, ambiguous setting.
* Delivery or programme managers without hands-on engineering ownership.

**What Bright Offers?**

* A profitable sub-unicorn with U.S. market scale - liquidity potential at $1-3B valuations.
* Real ownership: You own delivery and technical direction for a core part of the platform, with a direct line to the CTO.
* Wealth creation: Equity at an inflection stage of scale.
* A data-driven, high-cadence culture that combines consulting rigor with FinTech speed.
* Benefits: Excellent benefits package in line with sector best practice.

jobs.description:
**Head of Marketing / Head of Growth**

**AppsForBharat | Bengaluru | 10+ Years Experience**

**About AppsForBharat**

At
**AppsForBharat**
, we are building Sri Mandir, a leading devotional and spiritual platform that helps millions of devotees connect with their faith through technology.

Our ecosystem brings together three businesses:

* **Sri Mandir:**
  An app and website offering Puja, Chadhava, Seva, devotional content, music and temple information.
* **Sri Mandir Store:**
  An online store offering spiritual products such as Rudraksha, gemstones, bracelets, idols and more.
* **Kundli Guide by Sri Mandir:**
  A platform offering personalised astrology reports and expert consultations.

As we continue to grow, we are looking for a
**Head of Marketing / Head of Growth**
who can build and lead the overall growth strategy across these businesses.

**The Role**

We are looking for a business-focused marketing leader who knows how to acquire customers, drive revenue and build long-term customer engagement.

This is not just a traditional marketing or brand-building role. You will be responsible for driving business growth by bringing together performance marketing, product, customer acquisition, content and retention.

You will work closely with the Product and Business teams to make Sri Mandir an app first platform, acquire more users, improve their experience and encourage them to engage with and purchase multiple services across our ecosystem.

**What You Will Do**

**1. Own Overall Marketing and Business Growth**

* Build and lead the overall marketing and growth strategy across Sri Mandir, Sri Mandir Store and Kundli Guide.
* Drive growth in new users, customer acquisition, transactions and overall revenue.
* Identify new opportunities to expand our user base and reach new customer segments.
* Take ownership of key business metrics such as customer acquisition cost, marketing returns, revenue and customer lifetime value.

**2. Build an App-First Growth Strategy**

* Make mobile apps a primary channel for customer acquisition, engagement and transactions across business categories.
* Develop strategies to increase app downloads, registrations, active users and purchases.
* Work closely with Product teams to improve app onboarding, user journeys and purchase experience.
* Identify opportunities to introduce users to multiple services within the Sri Mandir ecosystem.

**3. Drive Performance Marketing and Customer Acquisition**

* Lead performance marketing across platforms such as Google, Meta and other relevant digital channels.
* Build scalable customer acquisition strategies while maintaining efficient marketing spends.
* Continuously experiment with campaigns, audiences, creatives and channels to improve results.
* Build a strong understanding of what drives conversions and revenue, beyond just app installs or website traffic.

**4. Drive Customer Retention and Repeat Purchases**

* Develop strategies to bring existing users back to the platform and encourage repeat transactions.
* Build strong CRM and lifecycle marketing capabilities through push notifications, WhatsApp, email and other channels.
* Use customer insights and behaviour to create relevant and personalised communication.
* Work towards improving customer retention, repeat purchase rates and lifetime value.

**5. Build Content-Led Growth**

* Use content as a strong driver of customer acquisition, engagement and retention.
* Identify opportunities to leverage devotional, spiritual and astrology-related content to attract and engage users.
* Build content strategies that contribute to business growth and platform engagement, beyond just brand awareness.

**6. Build and Lead the Marketing Team**

* Build a strong marketing organisation across performance marketing, growth, CRM, content and other relevant functions.
* Develop a culture of experimentation, accountability and data-driven decision-making.
* Work closely with Business, Product, Design, Analytics and Technology teams to drive overall company growth.

**What We Are Looking For**

* 10+ years of experience in marketing, growth or performance marketing, preferably in consumer internet, technology, e-commerce, D2C or mobile-first businesses.
* Strong experience in scaling customer acquisition and driving measurable business growth through performance marketing.
* Experience in growing a mobile app, with a strong understanding of app downloads, user activation, engagement, conversion and retention.
* Experience working closely with Product teams to improve customer journeys, app experience and business outcomes.
* Strong understanding of performance marketing platforms such as Google Ads, Meta Ads and other digital acquisition channels.
* Good to have, Experience in CRM, lifecycle marketing, customer retention and repeat purchase strategies.
* Ability to use data and customer insights to identify growth opportunities and make business decisions.
* Experience in building and leading high-performing marketing teams.
* Understanding of content as a tool for customer acquisition and engagement.

**Who May Not Be a Good Fit**

* Candidates whose experience is primarily in traditional brand marketing, PR or communications.
* Professionals whose work has largely focused on large-scale brand campaigns and awareness initiatives.
* Candidates with only campaign execution or paid advertising experience, without ownership of business growth metrics.
* Candidates with no experience in mobile app growth or working with Product teams.

**Why Join AppsForBharat?**

This is an opportunity to build the growth engine for a large and evolving consumer platform. You will have the opportunity to shape how millions of users discover, experience and engage with devotional and spiritual services through technology.

You will own a significant business mandate, work closely with leadership and build a marketing organisation that directly contributes to the company's growth.
