We are looking for an experienced and dynamic **Head Forging** to lead and manage forging operations within our Steel Division at Hyderabad. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in forging operations, production planning, process optimization, quality management, and team leadership within a steel or heavy manufacturing environment.

The incumbent will be responsible for overseeing end-to-end forging operations, ensuring production efficiency, product quality, workplace safety, cost optimization, and on-time delivery while driving continuous improvement initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Forging Operations & Production Management**

* Lead and manage end-to-end forging operations, ensuring efficient utilization of manpower, machinery, and resources.
* Develop and execute production plans to meet business targets, quality standards, and delivery schedules.
* Oversee forging processes, including heating, billet preparation, hot forging, trimming, heat treatment coordination, and associated operations, as applicable.
* Monitor production output, cycle time, rejection rates, and overall equipment effectiveness (OEE).
* Ensure optimum utilization of forging presses, hammers, furnaces, and related equipment.

**2. Process Optimization & Operational Excellence**

* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to improve productivity, reduce cycle time, and minimize material wastage.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement, energy conservation, and cost reduction.
* Implement Lean Manufacturing, 5S, Kaizen, TPM, and other operational excellence practices.
* Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for forging operations.

**3. Quality Management**

* Ensure compliance with established quality standards, customer specifications, and applicable industry requirements.
* Reduce rejection, rework, and scrap through root cause analysis and corrective and preventive actions.
* Work closely with Quality and Engineering teams to resolve process-related quality issues.
* Ensure proper process control, traceability, and documentation throughout production.

**4. Maintenance & Equipment Management**

* Coordinate with the Maintenance team to ensure equipment reliability and minimum downtime.
* Drive preventive and predictive maintenance practices for forging equipment and furnaces.
* Support equipment upgrades, capacity expansion, tooling improvements, and new process implementation.

**5. Safety & Compliance**

* Ensure strict adherence to industrial safety standards, particularly for hot forging, furnace operations, material handling, and heavy equipment.
* Promote a strong safety culture and ensure compliance with applicable statutory and environmental requirements.
* Conduct regular safety reviews, risk assessments, and corrective action follow-ups.

**6. Team Leadership & Development**

* Lead, mentor, and develop production managers, engineers, supervisors, and shop-floor teams.
* Establish clear performance objectives and accountability across the department.
* Identify training needs and improve technical competencies and workforce productivity.
* Foster collaboration across Production, Quality, Maintenance, Planning, and Supply Chain functions.

**7. Cost Control & Business Performance**

* Prepare and monitor departmental budgets, production costs, and resource utilization.
* Drive initiatives to reduce conversion costs, consumable costs, energy consumption, and manufacturing losses.
* Review daily, weekly, and monthly production performance and present operational reports to senior management.

**Educational Qualifications**

* B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering, Metallurgical Engineering, Production Engineering, or a related discipline.
* A postgraduate qualification in Operations or Manufacturing Management would be an added advantage.

**Required Experience & Skills**

* Minimum **15+ years of experience** in manufacturing, preferably in the steel, forging, automotive components, heavy engineering, or allied industries.
* Significant hands-on experience in forging operations and production management, preferably in a steel manufacturing environment.
* Proven experience in managing large-scale manufacturing operations, production teams, and shop-floor activities.
* Strong understanding of forging processes, tooling, metallurgy, heat treatment, quality systems, and manufacturing technologies, as applicable.
* Experience in production planning, capacity utilization, cost control, process improvement, and productivity enhancement.
* Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, TPM, 5S, Kaizen, and root cause analysis methodologies.
* Strong leadership, problem-solving, analytical, and decision-making capabilities.
* Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and deliver operational targets.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Production output and achievement of production targets.
* Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) and machine utilization.
* Rejection, rework, and scrap reduction.
* Manufacturing cost and energy consumption per unit.
* On-time delivery and adherence to production schedules.
* Workplace safety performance and compliance.
* Implementation of productivity and continuous improvement initiatives.

jobs.title: Chief Information Security Officer
jobs.description:
The Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) is responsible for establishing, implementing, operating, monitoring, and continuously enhancing OneFin’s Information Security Management System (ISMS) across all product lines and enterprise infrastructure.

This leader will own end-to-end information security strategy, cloud security governance (AWS), regulatory compliance (RBI guidelines for digital lending and IT governance), ISO/IEC 27001:2022 standards, and client-facing security assessments for institutional banking partners. Implement zero trust security architecture.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Information Security Governance & Strategy**

* Define, maintain, and enforce OneFin's Level-1 ISMS policies, standards, and guidelines in alignment with business goals.
* Report security posture, risk profiles, and incident metrics directly to the CEO, C-suite, and Board of Directors.
* Lead the annual risk assessment framework across all business units, maintaining the enterprise Risk Register and tracking remediation strategies.
* Establish annual security objectives, measurable parameters, and operational security targets.

**2. Regulatory, Compliance & Client Audit Management**

* Direct compliance for ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certifications, surveillance audits, and internal security audits.
* Ensure strict adherence to Reserve Bank of India (RBI) guidelines regarding digital lending, data localization, outsourcing, and cloud management.
* Act as the executive point of contact for financial institution (FI) client audits, managing Information Security Group (ISG) checklists, VAPT review points, and security questionnaires.
* Oversee Data Protection and Privacy compliance, protecting Personally Identifiable Information (PII) and Sensitive Personal Data or Information (SPDI).
* Oversee source code audits, and conduct internal security audits of codebase.

**3. Cloud Infrastructure & Product Security**

* Oversee security configuration across AWS environments, ensuring AES-256 encryption at rest (S3, RDS, ECR) and enforced TLS/HTTPS in transit.
* Enforce secure architecture models for single-tenant / dedicated client deployments on Financial Institution AWS infrastructure.
* Direct Web Application Firewall (WAF) policies, IP/URL whitelisting, geo-blocking, and network perimeter controls.
* Maintain DevSecOps rigor within CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions), ensuring automated peer reviews, static analysis, code coverage thresholds, and container image vulnerability management.

**4. Threat Management & Security Operations (SecOps)**

* Lead the Incident Response Team; ensure end-to-end management, SLA tracking, and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for all P1/Critical incidents.
* Oversee centralized logging, Database Activity Monitoring (DAM), and integration capabilities with Bank SIEM systems.
* Mandate periodic Vulnerability Assessment & Penetration Testing (VAPT) across applications, APIs, and cloud infrastructure.
* Enforce robust Access Control & Identity Management (IAM), including mandatory multi-factor authentication (MFA) across email, code repositories, and cloud portals.

**5. Third-Party Risk & Business Continuity**

* Enforce Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) guidelines, ensuring mandatory MSAs and NDAs across all vendors.
* Manage annual Business Continuity Planning (BCP) and Disaster Recovery (DR) drills, validating Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPO).
* Conduct annual enterprise-wide security awareness training programs and specialized DevSecOps workshops.

**Candidate Qualifications**

* **Education:** Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or related engineering fields.
* **Experience:** 12+ years in Information Security and Technology Risk, with at least 4+ years in a leadership role (CISO, Head of Security, or Director of InfoSec).
* **Domain Background:** Prior experience in Fintech, B2B SaaS, Banking, or Financial Services ecosystems is strictly required.

**Technical & Professional Competencies**

**Cloud Security**- Deep expertise in AWS Security Hub, WAF, KMS, CloudTrail, IAM, RDS/S3 encryption, and containerized deployments (ECS/ECR).

**Frameworks**- Hands-on mastery of ISO/IEC 27001:2022, NIST CSF, OWASP Top 10, and SOC 2 Type II compliance.

**Regulatory Knowledge**- In depth knowledge of RBI Cybersecurity Framework, RBI Digital Lending Directions, and Indian Data Protection laws.

**Application Security**- Expertise in DevSecOps, API security, automated code scanners, tesseract/OCR pipeline security, and LLM/AI model deployment governance.

**Leadership**- Exceptional stakeholder management, board-level reporting, and experience negotiating security requirements with Tier-1 Bank CISOs.

**Certifications (Preferred)**

* Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
* Certified Information Security Manager (CISM)
* Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA)
* ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Auditor / Lead Implementer

Pay: ₹3,000,000.00 - ₹3,500,000.00 per year

PhonePe’s products and services include Consumer Payments (including Digital Distribution Services), Merchant Payments, Lending and Insurance Distribution services, and New Platforms, which comprise Share.Market (stock broking and mutual funds distribution platform), and Indus Appstore (Android-based mobile app marketplace). We empower people and trust them to do the right thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. **Job Summary**
---------------

The Global Process Owner Support (GPOS) role exists to strengthen first-line-of-defence risk management and governance across Credit Origination, Credit Monitoring and Credit Allied Risk processes within Client Coverage. It supports Global Process Owners in embedding applicable policies, standards and controls into day-to-day business activities, helping the business manage operational and process risks consistently across markets. The role delivers oversight of control effectiveness, coordinated remediation of control gaps and exceptions, and clear reporting and escalation of material risks to support informed governance decisions. Working with business, country teams and second-line stakeholders, it also supports process simplification and the implementation of change with appropriate risk assessments and controls. Its primary focus is to maintain effective, consistent and efficient credit processes that support business delivery while operating within established risk tolerances.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

The role holder is an individual contributor with no formal people-management accountability. The role leads and coordinates assigned risk, control and process-improvement activities through stakeholder collaboration, supporting the Global Process Owner / delegate and GPOS Lead across Credit Origination, Credit Monitoring and Credit Allied Risk processes. The role holder is accountable for the quality and timely delivery of assigned assessments, assurance oversight, reporting and remediation coordination; designated action owners remain responsible for completing their actions.
  
**Risk assessment and control implementation**  
• Implement applicable control requirements and procedures, and support each stage of the RCSA, from process and risk identification to monitoring implemented controls, at least annually and when trigger events occur, to maintain a current view of process and residual risks.
  
**Timely risk treatment**  
• Coordinate and track agreed elevated residual-risk actions and treatment plans with designated action owners, maintain records in the Group operational risk management system, and escalate delays to support timely completion.
  
**Learning from risk events**  
• Initiate Root Cause Reviews for in-scope material risk events and, where required, aggregate smaller events with similar root causes to identify recurring weaknesses and support corrective action.
  
**Controlled change delivery**  
• Identify delivery risks and dependencies, assess impacts on critical processes and residual risk, and review and support Operational and Change Risk Assessments and process-impact assessments before go-live, including minor changes where required.

**Broad Accountabilities**  
**Strategy**  
• Targeted Improvements: Work with internal stakeholders to identify gaps and improvement opportunities in credit processes, and lead assigned change and remediation activities to make processes more effective and streamlined.
  
• Support the GPO’s credit transformation agenda by translating agreed priorities into implementation activities and delivering assigned work within agreed timelines.
  
• Automation and Streamlining: Review operational efficiency, effectiveness and quality against changing business and customer needs, and identify actions to improve process performance.
  
• Drive continuous improvement and automation, and remove or simplify unnecessary process steps to improve efficiency and consistency across systems and processes.
  
• Support CPA Team Heads, including the CPA Hub, in improving process efficiency, simplifying processes and increasing capacity.
  
**Business**  
• Assess the process and operational-risk implications of business strategies, projects and programmes, and provide remediation guidance to support informed decisions.
  
• Support global adoption of Credit COE initiatives and work with management to implement agreed process improvements and strategic credit transformation initiatives.
  
• Maintain effective relationships with Business, Finance, Risk, Technology and Operations to resolve process issues and coordinate delivery across markets.
  
• Coordinate stakeholder inputs and supporting information for regulatory and audit requests to enable timely responses.

**Processes**  
• Support the Process Owner in delivering BAU operational-risk requirements on time and in designing and maintaining the Control Assessment Standards framework for front-office processes globally.
  
• Monitor CST/KCI exception trends and agree practical improvement actions with countries to strengthen processes and controls.
  
• Guide QC teams in GBS and countries in understanding and consistently applying checks, particularly those involving qualitative or subjective assessments.
  
• Support process governance by streamlining existing processes, rolling out new processes and resolving Credit and Credit Monitoring queries with the relevant GPOS Lead.
  
• Work with CPAs, Client Management, CPOs, R&C, Business Heads and other regional and country stakeholders to share developments, lessons and best practices, and deliver agreed requirements on time.
  
• Assess change impacts through CCIA, evaluate change readiness and perform GRAM assessments. Provide subject-matter expertise to help mitigate identified process risks.
  
• Support the resolution of Group-specific process issues and related actions identified by GIA.
  
• Support the Process Owner in promptly escalating significant risks and issues to Process Universe Owners, relevant RFOs or Policy Owners. Maintain effective relationships with 2LOD across applicable risk types to support management of the Bank’s risk profile.
  
**Risk Management**  
• Identify process risks and support implementation of the Operational Risk Framework and appropriate controls. Help operations manage risk within established tolerance thresholds and minimise risks and losses in Credit Origination.

* Identify non-standard processes and agree appropriate controls with the GPOS Lead. Review proposed process and system changes for material impacts, and keep DOIs and process documentation up to date.

• Support implementation of applicable Credit, Fraud, Climate, Reputational and Sustainability Risk policies and standards within CC COE, embedding their requirements in managed processes.
  
• Prepare updates on risk initiatives for CC Governance Committee packs, and provide subject-matter expertise for Root Cause Reviews and boundary events to support oversight and corrective action.
  
• Support the design and delivery of relevant Credit Transformation initiatives and partner with TB, FM and Lending to improve the operating model and execution through existing CC credit processes.
  
• Provide ongoing learning and guidance on policies, process risks, controls and governance. Work with 2LOD and Product partners to develop and implement a roadmap for improving the control framework.
  
• Support implementation and closure of Group-level audit Management Action Plans, and delivery of actions arising from PRA Dear CEO Letters and specific reviews relating to owned processes.
  
**Governance**  
• Ensure risks are clearly identified, quantified and reported to the appropriate governance forums, with timely visibility and escalation of material issues.
  
• Assess how effectively the control framework addresses key risks and initiate treatment plans where required. Coordinate remediation of capability, process, data and documentation gaps.
  
• Provide central oversight of CST/KCI assurance checks performed by GBS, including ongoing training and guidance, to maintain standardised and consistent assessments.

We connect Sellers, Buyers, Logistics service providers, Lending partners, Payment solution providers on a unified digital backbone thereby creating end to end visibility and providing a B2C like fulfilment experience for the B2B ecosystem.*

*The evolution of B2B ecommerce is expected to mirror the B2C ecommerce journey, where technology transformed discovery, pricing, fulfilment, and customer experience at scale. Digital penetration today in B2B ecommerce is still under* ***2%****, indicating massive headroom for scalable digital-first platforms. As the Aditya Birla Group, we are uniquely positioned to transform and shape the way commerce is done across these verticals by leveraging our deep industry expertise and scale. jobs.description:
**Company:** Loan2grow Fincap Private Limited  
**Department:** Customer Service & Operations  
**Designation:** Customer Service Executive  
**Location:** Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh  
**Employment Type:** Full-time, Office-based  
**Working Days:** Monday to Saturday  
**Reporting To:** Customer Service Manager / Head of Operations  
**Salary:** As per experience and suitability (Fixed + Performance Incentive)

1. About Loan2grow Fincap

Loan2grow Fincap Private Limited is a growing lending and financial services company focused on providing responsible, accessible and technology-enabled credit solutions to underserved customer segments.

The company offers financing solutions across multiple customer categories and is expanding its digital lending and financial services operations.

At Loan2grow, we believe that a good customer experience is central to responsible lending. We aim to make financial services accessible, transparent and convenient through technology-enabled platforms and responsive customer support.

2. About the Role

We are looking for customer-oriented and proactive professionals to join our Customer Service & Operations team as Customer Service Executives.

The selected candidates will be responsible for handling customer queries, providing assistance throughout the loan application and servicing journey, resolving customer complaints and coordinating with internal teams to ensure timely resolution of customer issues.

The role will involve handling inbound and outbound customer calls, responding to service requests, guiding customers through digital processes and maintaining accurate records of customer interactions.

The Customer Service Executive will serve as an important point of contact between the company and its customers, ensuring that customer concerns are addressed professionally, efficiently and within defined timelines.

This is a full-time, office-based role involving regular telephone-based customer interaction and coordination with internal departments.

3. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Customer Support & Query Management

* Handle inbound and outbound customer calls relating to loan products and financial services.
* Respond to customer queries regarding loan features, eligibility, application procedures and documentation requirements.
* Provide information on loan application status, approval, disbursement and repayment schedules.
* Assist customers in understanding their loan accounts, outstanding balances, EMI obligations and payment timelines.
* Provide accurate information regarding applicable interest rates, processing fees, charges and other loan-related terms.
* Ensure that customer queries are addressed in a professional, courteous and timely manner.
* Escalate complex queries to the appropriate internal teams.

B. Loan Application & Customer Onboarding Support

* Assist prospective customers with the digital loan application process.
* Guide customers through KYC verification, documentation and other onboarding requirements.
* Help customers resolve issues related to application submission, document uploads and verification.
* Follow up on incomplete applications and pending documentation.
* Coordinate with Credit and Operations teams to track application progress.
* Keep customers informed about application status and pending requirements.
* Assist customers in navigating the company's digital platforms and applications.

C. Loan Servicing & Repayment Support

* Handle customer queries relating to loan disbursement, repayment schedules and EMI deductions.
* Assist customers with repayment-related issues, including failed transactions, incorrect deductions and payment confirmation.
* Guide customers on approved repayment channels and payment procedures.
* Coordinate with Finance and Collections teams to resolve payment reconciliation issues.
* Support customers in obtaining loan statements, repayment schedules and other account-related information.
* Track and follow up on unresolved loan servicing requests.
* Ensure that customer concerns relating to loan servicing are addressed within defined timelines.

D. Customer Complaint & Grievance Resolution

* Receive, register and track customer complaints and service requests.
* Understand the nature of customer grievances and identify the appropriate resolution mechanism.
* Coordinate with relevant departments to resolve complaints.
* Follow up on pending complaints until closure.
* Maintain accurate records of complaints, actions taken and resolution timelines.
* Escalate unresolved or sensitive customer grievances to the reporting manager.
* Ensure that customer complaints are handled in accordance with company policies and applicable regulatory requirements.

E. Customer Relationship & Communication

* Maintain professional and positive relationships with customers.
* Communicate loan-related information in simple, clear and understandable language.
* Proactively contact customers regarding pending documentation, application updates and service requests.
* Provide appropriate guidance to customers throughout their loan journey.
* Handle dissatisfied customers and difficult conversations with patience and professionalism.
* Ensure transparency in all customer communications.
* Never make unauthorised commitments regarding loan approvals, interest waivers, settlements or changes in repayment terms.

F. Coordination with Internal Teams

* Coordinate with Sales and Business Development teams for customer acquisition and onboarding-related queries.
* Work with Credit teams to obtain updates on loan applications and pending verifications.
* Coordinate with Operations for documentation, disbursement and loan servicing issues.
* Work with Collections teams on repayment-related customer queries and payment confirmation.
* Coordinate with Finance for payment reconciliation and account-related discrepancies.
* Ensure timely communication and closure of customer requests across departments.

G. Customer Service MIS & Reporting

* Maintain accurate records of customer calls, queries, complaints and service requests.
* Update customer interactions and service request status in the CRM or designated systems.
* Maintain daily customer service reports covering:
* Total inbound and outbound calls.
* Customer queries received.
* Customer requests registered.
* Complaints received and resolved.
* Pending service requests.
* Average query resolution time.
* Escalated complaints.
* Customer follow-up status.
* Share daily and weekly performance updates with the reporting manager.
* Identify recurring customer issues and highlight opportunities to improve service delivery.

4. Qualifications & Experience

**Essential Qualifications:**

* Graduate in any discipline.
* 1–3 years of experience in customer service, customer support, telecalling, contact centres or customer relationship management.
* Good verbal communication skills in Hindi and basic English.
* Comfortable handling inbound and outbound customer calls.
* Basic proficiency in MS Excel, Google Sheets and customer management systems.
* Ability to handle multiple customer queries and service requests simultaneously.

**Preferred Experience:**

* Prior experience in banking, NBFCs, fintech, digital lending, microfinance or other financial services organisations.
* Experience handling loan-related customer queries and servicing requests.
* Familiarity with loan application processes, KYC documentation and digital onboarding.
* Experience resolving EMI, repayment and payment-related queries.
* Experience working with CRM, LOS or LMS platforms.
* Exposure to complaint management and customer grievance resolution.

5. Key Skills & Competencies

* Excellent verbal communication and listening skills.
* Customer relationship management.
* Problem-solving and query resolution.
* Professional telephone etiquette.
* Patience and empathy in customer interactions.
* Ability to handle difficult customer conversations.
* Follow-up and service

jobs.description:
**About the Company:**

DigieSign is a Bengaluru-based legal-tech and fintech company building a connected suite of products that help lenders digitise the full lifecycle of a loan — from signing the agreement to recovering dues and resolving disputes. Our customers are NBFCs, banks and financial institutions across India.

Our product suite:

* DigieSign – Aadhaar and DSC-based eSignatures and digital document execution for loan agreements, sanction letters and other lending documents.
* Serve – End-to-end legal notice dispatch: multilingual notice generation, digital delivery (email, SMS, WhatsApp) and physical dispatch via India Post, with tracking and court-ready delivery reports.
* Collect – Collections automation that helps lenders reach delinquent borrowers at scale and improve recovery rates.
* Resolve – Online Dispute Resolution (ODR) for faster, cheaper resolution of lending disputes through arbitration, conciliation and mediation. We already work with leading NBFCs, and we are now building city-level teams to grow faster. Bengaluru is our home city and the first of these hubs.

**Role Overview**

As City Manager – Sales & Operations, Bengaluru, you will own our business in the city end to end. You will bring in new NBFC and bank customers, and you will make sure that every customer we sign is onboarded smoothly, served well and keeps growing with us. You will run the city like a business unit: pipeline, revenue, delivery quality and client satisfaction are all yours.

This role suits someone who enjoys being in front of credit, legal and collections leaders at lending institutions, and who also likes making operations run cleanly behind the scenes.

**Key Responsibilities**

**A. Sales & Business Development (approx. 60%)**

•Find, prospect and acquire new NBFCs, banks (private, small finance, cooperative), HFCs and MFIs headquartered or with major operations in Bengaluru and Karnataka.

•Build and manage a healthy pipeline: research target accounts, map decision-makers (Heads of Collections, Legal, Credit Operations, Risk, IT/Digital) and run multi-stakeholder sales cycles.

* Run product demos and discovery meetings, and position the full suite: DigieSign, Serve, Collect and Resolve.

* Build proposals, commercial quotes and pricing in line with company guidelines; negotiate and close agreements.

* Handle procurement processes, vendor empanelment, RFPs, information security questionnaires and legal/compliance reviews at client institutions.

* Cross-sell and upsell across the suite to existing accounts (for example, moving a Serve customer onto Collect or Resolve).

* Meet monthly and quarterly targets for new logos, revenue and pipeline.

* Keep the CRM up to date and share accurate forecasts with leadership.

* Represent DigieSign at BFSI industry events, NBFC forums and legal-tech meetups in the city.

**B. City Operations & Client Delivery (approx. 40%)**

* Own client onboarding for the city: account setup, user training, template configuration, data upload formats and go-live.

* Oversee day-to-day delivery for Bengaluru clients, including legal notice dispatch batches, India Post coordination, eSign volumes and ODR case flows, so that SLAs and turnaround times are met.

* Coordinate with internal product, tech, legal and support teams to resolve client issues and escalations quickly.

* Make sure clients receive timely MIS and delivery reports, and review account health with them regularly (monthly reviews and QBRs).

* Track usage, wallet/billing status and collections on invoices for city accounts, and follow up on receivables.

* Manage local vendors and partners (printing, dispatch, courier and field partners) where needed.

* Capture client feedback and feature requests and pass them to the product team in a structured way.

* As the city grows, hire, train and lead a small team of sales and operations executives.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* New NBFC and bank customers signed per quarter

* Revenue and pipeline value against target

* Time from signature to go-live for new clients

* SLA adherence for notice dispatch, eSign and ODR delivery

* Client retention, expansion revenue and cross-sell across products

* Receivables collected on time

**Requirements Must have**

* Graduate in any discipline; MBA preferred.

* 3–6 years of experience in B2B / enterprise sales, account management or operations in BFSI, fintech, legal-tech or SaaS.

* A proven record of selling to NBFCs and/or banks, with an existing network among collections, legal, credit or operations leaders.

* Understanding of the lending lifecycle in India — loan origination, documentation, collections, NPA recovery and legal/recovery processes (SARFAESI, Section 138 NI Act, arbitration).

* Comfort managing operational processes, SLAs and client escalations.

* Strong communication, presentation and negotiation skills in English; Kannada and/or Hindi strongly preferred.

* Comfortable with CRM tools, Excel/Google Sheets and preparing MIS reports.

* Willing to travel within Bengaluru and Karnataka for client meetings. Good to have

* Experience selling eSign, eStamp, legal notice, collections or ODR solutions.

* Exposure to RBI digital lending guidelines and outsourcing norms for regulated entities.

* Experience setting up or scaling a city or regional business from an early stage.

* Experience hiring and leading a small team.

**What We Offer**

* A chance to build and own a city business at an early-stage, fast-growing legal-tech company.

* Direct work with the founding team and real influence on product and go-to-market.

* Competitive fixed pay plus a performance-linked incentive plan.

* A clear growth path to Regional / Zonal Head as we expand to more cities.

Pay: ₹70,000.00 - ₹110,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

Paid media is one tool among many.

**How marketing works at Sav**

Our marketing is fully AI-native. We run AI agents for media planning, creative production, content distribution, analytics, performance media and more. You’ll run this system, decide where to point it, and build new agents where the work needs them. You'll spend your time finding growth, not producing assets by hand.

**What you will do**

* Own customer growth across all four products: new customers, activation, cross-sell and retention.
* Find and test new growth channels quickly. Keep the ones that work, drop the ones that don’t, and scale the winners.
* Build partnerships and distribution deals that bring customers in large numbers.
* Design referral, community and product-led loops with the Product team.
* Direct the AI marketing system and decide what it should do next.
* Launch new products and campaigns with Product and Compliance. Explain regulated products in plain English and Arabic.
* Hire and lead a small team that works the same way.

**What success looks like**

* **In your first 90 days:**
  a growth plan to 10x, with the three bets you’d make first, and at least one of them live with early results.
* **Within 12 months:**
  a clear path to 10x customers, a lower cost per customer, and at least one growth channel that didn’t exist at Sav before you joined.

**What We Are Looking For:**

* 6+ years in growth or marketing, with at least 3 years on financial products such as payments, cards, investing, savings, or digital banking.
* A track record of growing a customer base several times over, with the numbers to show it.
* At least one growth idea you came up with and scaled that wasn’t paid ads: a partnership, a referral loop, a community or a distribution deal.
* Real hands-on use of AI in your work: you’ve built or run workflows that do marketing work, not just used a chatbot for copy.
* Comfort with funnels, unit economics, and data. You read the numbers yourself.
* GCC experience and Arabic are strong pluses.

**How to apply**

Send your CV and a short note, under 200 words, covering:

1. The biggest customer growth you’ve been responsible for: from what number to what number, and how.
2. One unconventional growth idea you’d try for Sav, and why.
3. One example of how you’ve used AI to do marketing work. Tell us what you built, what it did, and what broke.

Applications without all three will not be reviewed.

jobs.title: Head of AI Initiatives (Fintech)
jobs.description:
A global financial group operating across brokerage, fintech, and digital assets is strengthening its AI capabilities to drive automation, intelligence, and operational scale across the business. As part of this effort, we are hiring a Head of AI Initiatives with a strong background in financial services to lead the design and execution of AI-driven initiatives across the organization.

This role requires a deep understanding of financial environments combined with the ability to apply AI in a practical, commercially focused way.

**Role Overview**

The Head of AI Initiatives will be responsible for shaping and delivering the company’s AI agenda across trading, operations, compliance, risk, finance, and customer-facing functions. The role bridges business strategy and technology execution, ensuring AI solutions are relevant, compliant, and embedded into core financial workflows.

This is a leadership role with hands-on ownership of prioritization, delivery, and adoption.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define and lead the AI strategy across financial services functions, aligned with business and regulatory requirements
* Identify AI use cases within trading, brokerage operations, compliance, risk, finance, and customer operations
* Translate financial and operational challenges into clear AI initiatives and delivery roadmaps
* Oversee AI pilots and production deployments, ensuring robustness, scalability, and regulatory awareness
* Partner with technology, data, and product teams to ensure solutions meet financial-grade standards
* Establish governance frameworks, prioritization criteria, and success metrics for AI initiatives
* Support change management and AI adoption across finance-focused teams
* Stay current on AI developments relevant to financial markets, fintech, and digital assets

**Requirements**

* Proven experience leading AI, automation, or advanced analytics initiatives
  **within financial services**
* Background in fintech, brokerage, trading, banking, payments, or regulated financial environments
* Strong understanding of applied AI, machine learning, LLMs, and automation in financial use cases
* Experience working with risk, compliance, and regulatory constraints
* Ability to translate business strategy into executable AI programs
* Strong stakeholder management skills, including senior leadership engagement

Chief Technology Officer, SC Ventures (MyZoi)
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**
**About myZoi**
myZoi is an exciting fintech start-up aiming to promote financial inclusion globally. Our vision is to provide a level playing field to the unbanked and the underbanked in accessing essential financial services in an affordable, convenient, and transparent fashion. We are looking for smart, ambitious, and purpose driven individuals to join us in this journey.
  
  
This is an opportunity to join myZoi as a Chief Technology Officer. The role will be based in the UAE.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Business**

* Working with the CEO, CPO, Product Owners, and partners to lead technology build, evaluate technology trade-offs, oversee vendor engineering engagements, and deliver features and capabilities aligned to the business model to build on the minimum viable product (MVP) to successful global rollout.
* The Chief Technology Officer will discuss with partners, fintechs, co-creation clients, and business to expand the Company’s product offering and geographical footprint.
* Co-ordinate, question and interrogate technology opportunities with engineering team and innovate to sustain a competitive advantage.
* Employ a managerial mindset that seeks to optimise business outcomes for the Company while establishing sound governance, internal processes, adherence to policies and standards. This role requires close coordination with the SC Ventures CTO.
* Thought leadership and demonstratable subject matter expertise on use of machine learning (ML), Artificial Intelligence (AI), Blockchain, APIs, cyber security, DevSecOps and similar technology applications.
* Establish a sound technology operation covering incident management, problem management, service levels (SLAs) and business continuity processes

**Skills And Experience**

* Expert knowledge of mainstream cloud provider (AWS), Cloud-native services, and elastic infrastructure.
* Expert background in .NET technology stack, distributed systems, authentication mechanisms, asynchronous event processing, message queues, and architecture patterns.
* Knowledgeable on modern object orientated programming practises including entity frameworks, dynamic reflection, and reusable interfaces.
* Familiarity with 3rd party system integrations via APIs (HTTP/REST), host-to-host (file exchange by FTP), with background jobs processing of real-time, event triggered, and async automations.
* Familiar with OWASP, secure by design, secure coding practises, code scanning, unit testing, dependency management (deprecation, vulnerabilities, licensing)
* Extensive experience with DevOps including pipeline, release management, multi AWS account deployments.
* Required experience in front-end AngularJS, and good to have familiarity with modular frameworks such as ASP.NET Boilerplate, ASPNetZero, ABP.IO
* Overseeing scrum teams, engineers, and ensuring reliable delivery of sprints, change management of features and bug fixes, and backlog
* Experience with operating highly-available production financial systems
* Familiarity with SQL databases, DNS, service discovery, and related infrastructure components
* Ability to wear multiple hats such as individual contributor, team lead, solution architect, facilitator.
* Beneficial is knowledge of FinTech ecosystem, inclusive of Blockchain, Digital Payments, Primer Services and Transaction Banking Enhancements, as well as other innovations in this space.

**Qualifications**
**Other Responsibilities**

* Have expertise and professional experience in software development and deep understanding of technology delivery.
* Participate in assessing and hiring technical personnel and support the growth in aggressive go-to-market plans.
* Familiarity with ERP and financial systems (purchase orders, invoices, receipts) is desirable.
* Participate with anchor and banks / financial service providers in establishing new integrations.
* Engage with relevant Standard Chartered Functions including Technology and Information and Cyber Security (ICS) for governance and key-control-indicators.
* Advantageous to have experience in ITIL and ISO27001

**Subject Matter Knowledge And Experience**

* 15 years’ experience in similar technology leadership role
* Experience in startups & technology companies a major plus
* Understanding and appreciation for the complexities of the Group’s footprint
* Motivated to address the impact of innovation technology in Financial Services

**Skills And Characteristics**

* Imaginative and creative approach to how we do work
* Curiosity about new technologies, workflows, and products
* Ability to see things from multiple perspectives, as well as ask the question “why” continuously
* Tireless work ethic and enthusiasm to execute and get things done

The role holder is authorised to manage and operate within the scope of the roles and responsibilities outlined above. Role holders are not authorised beyond the scope of this job description unless they have a formal delegation of authority.
  
  
**About Standard Chartered**
We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.
  
  
Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.
  
  
**What We Offer**

* Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
* In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
* Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
* Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
* Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
* Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
* A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.

jobs.title: Senior Marketing Manager - HAL
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**
**About SC Ventures**
**SC Ventures is Standard Chartered ’s innovation, fintech investment and ventures arm. We were established to reinvent banking, as the significant technological disruptions to the industry was impacting its ability to serve clients and customers, in the ways they needed to be served. We are a unique ecosystem of innovators, banking experts, business builders and partners who are focused on rewiring the DNA in banking and bringing breakthrough ideas to scale, together. We are building ecosystems around four high conviction themes: Online Economy & Lifestyle, SMEs & World Trade, Digital Assets, and Sustainability & Inclusion. We are a global team of "Members" (excluding individual ventures), including dedicated colleagues from the Group's support functions, based in Singapore, Hong Kong, London, and the United Arab Emirates**
**About HAL**
**HAL is a B2B domestic and cross border marketplace being built for SMEs in the UAE. Incubated by SC Ventures, the ventures arm of Standard Chartered Bank, the platform will enable digital commerce and access to financial & value-added services. HAL’s vision is to act as a super glue connecting multiple partners & ecosystems by bringing together buyers, sellers, financial institutions, logistics partners under one roof. We are building this as an agentic AI native stack along with several strategic partners in the UAE who bring different capabilities into the platform.**
**SMEs are the backbone of the UAE economy and vital for economic growth and diversification. We want to help SMEs grow profitably, safely and with ease. Hal is being built for scale with the latest technologies and with a vision to truly become the one stop shop for SMEs. We are looking to launch later in the year.**
**The Senior Marketing Manager will lead HAL's marketing function, working closely with the CEO and the commercial, product and partnerships teams. This is a commercially driven role: success is measured by the qualified B2B leads you generate (sellers, buyers and SMEs looking for finance), the revenue they bring in, and HAL's growing share of the UAE SME market. You will be hands-on and highly experimental, testing new channels and ideas quickly, doubling down on what works, and doing whatever it takes to help HAL win in the market.**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategy**

* Develop and own HAL's go-to-market marketing plan, turning business targets for sellers, buyers and finance referrals into lead generation goals, channel priorities and budget.
* Run a structured test-and-learn approach: set clear hypotheses, launch quick experiments across channels, measure results, and scale what works.
* Build simple, reliable full-funnel reporting covering leads, cost per lead, conversion to onboarded users and revenue, and share insights and recommendations with leadership regularly.
* Plan a rolling quarterly marketing calendar aligned to HAL's launch milestones and key UAE moments (e.g. Ramadan, National Day, major trade exhibitions).
* Lead, coach and develop the marketing team, working as one team with sales, product and partnerships to hit shared growth targets.

**Business**

* Own B2B lead generation for HAL: build a predictable pipeline of qualified sellers, buyers and SMEs needing finance (e.g. trade finance, working capital, invoice discounting), and ensure smooth handover to the commercial team.
* Agree with the sales team on the ideal customer profile, lead qualification criteria, and a shared process for lead handover and follow-up.
* Drive seller and buyer acquisition for the marketplace launch, and support activation campaigns so that new users start trading on the platform.
* Partner with banks, logistics, payments and other strategic partners on co-marketing campaigns and joint lead generation.
* Manage the marketing budget with discipline, tracking cost per lead and return on spend and moving budget to the best-performing channels.

**Processes**
**Lead Generation & Performance Marketing**

* Plan, launch and optimise paid campaigns across LinkedIn, Google, Meta and regional platforms, owning cost per lead, conversion rates and return on ad spend.
* Continuously experiment with new acquisition channels, such as WhatsApp campaigns, outbound email sequences, account-based marketing for high-value accounts, partner referrals and B2B directories.
* Build landing pages, lead forms and email and WhatsApp nurture journeys that turn interest into qualified leads.
* Set up and manage the core marketing tools (e.g. CRM and marketing automation such as HubSpot) and tracking so every lead can be traced back to its source.
* Grow HAL's organic visibility through SEO and content, including in AI-assisted search.

**Events & Field Marketing**

* Plan and deliver HAL's events programme: launch events, SME workshops, roundtables, webinars and networking sessions.
* Represent HAL at relevant trade shows and industry events across the UAE, making sure every event produces qualified leads with clear follow-up.
* Build relationships with chambers of commerce, trade associations, free zones and SME programmes to reach SMEs at scale.

**Thought Leadership, Content & PR**

* Build a thought leadership programme that positions HAL and its leaders as trusted voices on SME growth, B2B trade and trade finance in the UAE.
* Manage leadership's LinkedIn presence and secure speaking slots, panels and media interviews.
* Create content that educates and converts, such as articles, guides, case studies, newsletters, short videos and webinars, in English and Arabic where needed.
* Manage PR and media relations for launches and milestones, working with agencies where needed.

**Brand & Sales Enablement**
  
  

+ Establish HAL's brand positioning, key messages and visual identity, and keep them consistent across all touchpoints.
+ Create sales materials, such as pitch decks, one-pagers and case studies, that help the commercial team convert leads.
+ Gather customer and market insights (feedback, competitor moves, win/loss reasons) to sharpen messaging and targeting.

**Risk Management**

* Continuously evaluate agency roster to ensure that right agencies are onboarded while accommodating within the budget requirements

**Governance**

* Ensure compliance with all SCB and venture governance frameworks.
* Manage the function within budgetary constraints, seeking operational efficiencies

**Regulatory & Business Conduct**

* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

**Key stakeholders**

* Internal: CEO, CCO, COO, Head of digital commerce, Head of Financial Services, Head of partnerships.
* External: Relevant external regulator

**Other Responsibilities**

* Embed Here for good and Group’s brand and values in the business and SC Ventures;
* Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures.

**Skills And Experience**

* Marketing
* Branding
* Marketing Channels
* Planning : Tactical & Strategic
* Marketing Strategy & Positioning
* Brand Management

**Qualifications**

* 8–12 years of marketing experience, including at least 3 years in B2B demand generation or growth marketing.
* Highly commercially driven, with a proven track record of generating B2B leads and pipeline and a clear link to revenue (e.g. lead volume, cost per lead, conversion, revenue impact).
* Strong startup or scale-up background, with experience building marketing from the ground up in a fast-moving, high-growth environment.
* Experimental minds

jobs.title: AI Native Head Of Growth - EdTech (French fluent 🇫🇷)
jobs.location: Ajman, Ajman Emirate, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description:
**This Isn’t Another Growth Job**
Most growth teams call themselves data-driven. They have a dashboard, an agency and a ChatGPT licence to write ad copy faster. That’s the 99%.
  
  
We want to be part of the 0.1%: a company where AI doesn’t just help the growth team, it runs the growth loop. Every day, on every channel.
  
  
**Then it’s your chance to define a new category : The Operating System (OS) for Human Greatness Augmented with AI.**
Science-backed. Design-led. AI-powered. Global.
  
  
We’re not looking for someone who only advises on what to test, we’re looking for someone who builds it. A hands-on Head of Growth who can ideate, write the copy, design the strategy and launch experiments directly.
  
  
**What Ai-native Growth Means At Paradox 🤖**
Our growth machine has to be able to:
  
  

* Generate hypotheses. Read the signals (ad performance, webinar attendance, sales calls, objections, churn reasons, comments, competitors’ ads) and propose what to test next, with a cost and an expected impact.
* Act across every tool. Not a chatbot in a tab: it reads and writes in our whole stack, from ad accounts to CRM, landing pages, webinars, email, social DMs and analytics.
* Hold the full context of Paradox. Our DNA, offers, voice, member stories, past campaigns and what they taught us, in one shared company brain.
* Ship its hypotheses. Produce the hook, the ad cut, the page, the email sequence or the funnel variant, and put it live.
* Measure with real KPIs. Every test is tied to a number that matters (cost per qualified lead, show-up rate, close rate, CAC, payback, LTV), not to likes or reach.
* Learn and loop on its own. Scale what works, kill what doesn’t, write the lesson back into the brain, and launch the next cycle without waiting for a meeting.

This is already real. Our growth hub tracks every hypothesis and experiment, with its result. An ads library of thousands of creatives feeds our creative research. Agents cut ads from long-form content, prepare webinars, wire Instagram comment-to-DM automations and audit our tracking after every live. Athena, our AI coach, works with members every day.
  
  
**OUR MISSION**
At Paradox,
  
  
We believe self-help is broken: generic theory, a quick high, no real change.
  
  
We believe people deserve more. More than content. More than motivation.
  
  
They deserve a system that knows them, one that adapts, challenges, and grows with them.
  
  
Growth at Paradox means bringing people into something that actually changes their life, and proving it.
  
  
We do that by merging :
  
  

* Human Intelligence (coaches, peers, and mentors)
* Structured Intelligence (protocols, mental models, rituals)
* Technological Intelligence (AI personalization, feedback loops, adaptive journeys)

To create one seamless ecosystem: Paradox OS.
  
  
**Short history**
Paradox was founded by David Laroche, a creator followed by over 2 million people and known for his interviews with icons like Tony Parker, Mike Horn, Richard Branson and Gad Elmaleh. We started in French. We’re building for the world.
  
  
Here’s the bet: a company that learns by itself grows in a way a company of people alone can’t. A small growth team running a self-learning machine can out-test, out-learn and out-grow teams a hundred times its size.
  
  
We hold ourselves to the standards of Apple, Spotify and MasterClass. While others hide their numbers, we let our results speak.
  
  
**YOUR MISSION 🚀**
As Head of Growth, you’ll be the architect of a growth machine that learns by itself. In a classic growth team, people do the work and AI helps. Here it’s the other way round: agents do the work, you design the system, set the bar and make the calls.
  
  
You don’t just manage a team, you get your hands dirty to identify growth levers and pull them yourself.
  
  
**🎯 YOUR 5 MAIN MISSIONS**

* Build the agents that run growth
* ❌ The old way: a Head of Growth hires people and agencies, briefs them, and checks their work.
* 🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: your team is mostly agents, and you build them yourself. You write their skills, plug them into our tools (ad accounts, CRM, webinars, email, analytics) and write the evals that tell an agent what "good" means: a hook that stops the scroll, a page that converts, a test that’s worth its cost.
* You give autonomy step by step: first an agent suggests, then it acts once you approve, then it acts alone within a budget and guardrails. You move each agent up a level only when its track record earns it.
* Example: in your first month you build the agent that reviews every ad set overnight. At first it only suggests. By month three it pauses losers and moves budget by itself within limits you set, and you only see what was decided and why.
* Build an acquisition engine that runs day and night
* ❌ The old way: a media buyer checks the dashboards each morning, changes bids by hand and waits for the weekly report.
* 🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: you build and improve the agents that watch every ad set, page, webinar and email sequence around the clock. They spot what’s dropping, find the cause, fix it or launch a variant, and report what they did.
* You give autonomy step by step: an agent can pause an ad on its own long before it can raise a budget. You decide where each agent stops and a human takes over.
* Example: show-up rate drops on Tuesday’s webinar. Before anyone notices, an agent has found the cause (a reminder that never went out), fixed it and started testing a new reminder sequence.
* Build a creative machine with taste
* ❌ The old way: a creative team briefs an agency, waits two weeks and gets five ads.
* 🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: you build the agents that turn every live, interview and member story into hooks, ad cuts and shorts, that study what the best advertisers in the world are running, and that write in our voice.
* Your taste becomes the eval: you write down what makes a great hook, a great cut and a great story, in rules and examples the agents check themselves against. Each time you reject something, the reason goes back into the rules.
* Example: one webinar becomes dozens of hook variants by the next morning. You keep the best few, and next week the agents’ first drafts are already closer to your bar.
* Build measurement that checks itself
* ❌ The old way: an analyst rebuilds the numbers in a spreadsheet at the end of the month, and nobody trusts them.
* 🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: you build the agents that connect every touch to cash, from ad to lead, live, sale and transformed member, and that audit the tracking after every campaign.
* No number, no test: you define the KPIs that matter (CAC, show-up, close rate, LTV, payback), and agents refuse to launch a test that isn’t wired to one.
* Example: after each live, an agent cross-checks the ad platform, the CRM and our analytics, finds where they disagree and fixes the leak before the next live.
* Make the machine better every week, and keep the soul
* ❌ The old way: lessons live in people’s heads and leave with them.
* 🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: every result goes back into the company brain, and agents read it before proposing anything. The machine never learns the same lesson twice.
* You measure the machine itself: tests per week, time from idea to live, the share of the work done without a human, and how many agents moved up an autonomy level this month. You push those numbers up.
* And always: no fake scarcity, no fake claims, real stories told with consent. The machine can scale, but it doesn’t decide what’s right. You do.

**How you’ll know you’re AI-native:**
you spend your time building agents, writing evals and making calls, not doing the work by hand. Most experiments are generated and shipped by agents. The output grows every month while the headcount doesn’t.
  
  
**You’ll own these KPIs:**
LTV / CAC ratio, funnel conversion rate by stage, experiments launched per week.
  
  
**Desired outcomes:**
conversion rates 2x better than baseline, growth experimentation that ru

You write their skills, plug them into our tools (ad accounts, CRM, webinars, email, analytics) and write the evals that tell an agent what "good" means: a hook that stops the scroll, a page that converts, a test that’s worth its cost.
* You give autonomy step by step: first an agent suggests, then it acts once you approve, then it acts alone within a budget and guardrails. You move each agent up a level only when its track record earns it.
* Example: in your first month you build the agent that reviews every ad set overnight. At first it only suggests. By month three it pauses losers and moves budget by itself within limits you set, and you only see what was decided and why.
* Build an acquisition engine that runs day and night
* ❌ The old way: a media buyer checks the dashboards each morning, changes bids by hand and waits for the weekly report.
* 🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: you build and improve the agents that watch every ad set, page, webinar and email sequence around the clock. They spot what’s dropping, find the cause, fix it or launch a variant, and report what they did.
* You give autonomy step by step: an agent can pause an ad on its own long before it can raise a budget. You decide where each agent stops and a human takes over.
* Example: show-up rate drops on Tuesday’s webinar. Before anyone notices, an agent has found the cause (a reminder that never went out), fixed it and started testing a new reminder sequence.
* Build a creative machine with taste
* ❌ The old way: a creative team briefs an agency, waits two weeks and gets five ads.
* 🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: you build the agents that turn every live, interview and member story into hooks, ad cuts and shorts, that study what the best advertisers in the world are running, and that write in our voice.
* Your taste becomes the eval: you write down what makes a great hook, a great cut and a great story, in rules and examples the agents check themselves against. Each time you reject something, the reason goes back into the rules.
* Example: one webinar becomes dozens of hook variants by the next morning. You keep the best few, and next week the agents’ first drafts are already closer to your bar.
* Build measurement that checks itself
* ❌ The old way: an analyst rebuilds the numbers in a spreadsheet at the end of the month, and nobody trusts them.
* 🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: you build the agents that connect every touch to cash, from ad to lead, live, sale and transformed member, and that audit the tracking after every campaign.
* No number, no test: you define the KPIs that matter (CAC, show-up, close rate, LTV, payback), and agents refuse to launch a test that isn’t wired to one.
* Example: after each live, an agent cross-checks the ad platform, the CRM and our analytics, finds where they disagree and fixes the leak before the next live.
* Make the machine better every week, and keep the soul
* ❌ The old way: lessons live in people’s heads and leave with them.
* 🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: every result goes back into the company brain, and agents read it before proposing anything. The machine never learns the same lesson twice.
* You measure the machine itself: tests per week, time from idea to live, the share of the work done without a human, and how many agents moved up an autonomy level this month. You push those numbers up.
* And always: no fake scarcity, no fake claims, real stories told with consent. The machine can scale, but it doesn’t decide what’s right. You do.

**How you’ll know you’re AI-native:**
you spend your time building agents, writing evals and making calls, not doing the work by hand. Most experiments are generated and shipped by agents. The output grows every month while the headcount doesn’t.
  
  
**You’ll own these KPIs:**
LTV / CAC ratio, funnel conversion rate by stage, experiments launched per week.
  
  
**Desired outcomes:**
conversion rates 2x better than baseline, growth experimentation that ru

**Corporate Treasury Finance (CTF) & Balance Sheet Reporting & Analytics (BSRA)**
team within Finance. This role is located in
**Pune, India**
.
  
  
In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways:
  
  

* Functional leadership: Lead Corporate Treasury Finance (CTF) and Balance Sheet Reporting & Analytics (BSRA) from India, with full accountability for the quality, timeliness, control and continuous improvement of all deliverables.
* Plan & forecast: Own the end-to-end Balance Sheet and Net Interest Income (NII) plan and forecast process (plan rounds, rest-of-year and multi-year outlooks) for supported Lines of Business, ensuring a consistent methodology and timely submission into planning systems.
* Deposit forecast governance: Lead the deposit forecast and challenger process with Treasury Finance, GLS and LOB CFOs – framing assumptions, sensitivities, beta/pricing expectations and decision asks.
* NII & balance sheet narrative: Own the NII and balance sheet story for senior management, explaining drivers of variance versus plan, forecast and prior periods (rate, volume and mix) along with forward-looking risks and opportunities.
* Subject-matter expertise: Provide leadership on Funds Transfer Pricing (FTP), liquidity metrics (LCR and liquidity stress testing), interest-bearing and non-interest-bearing balance dynamics, and assess the impact of central bank rate changes, client flows and product/currency mix on deposits and NII.
* Reporting & analytics: Oversee daily, weekly, month-end and quarterly reporting – including month-to-date NII estimates, earnings support, management memos and client-, LOB- and firm-level analytics such as deposit pricing cohorts, client movers and beta analysis.
* Stakeholder partnership: Serve as trusted advisor and senior point of contact for Corporate Treasury, CIO, Treasury Finance, LOB CFOs, GLS, Interest Rate Risk, International Treasury, Controllers and Technology; represent India in senior forums and build durable partnerships through clear service models, SLAs and governance cadences.
* Scope expansion: Identify and lead the transition of new LOBs, platforms and processes into the India hub, partnering with Finance Data Strategy, Technology and other Centers of Excellence on firm-wide initiatives.

To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:
  
  

* Education: Master’s degree in a financial discipline such as accounting, finance, economics or statistics, or local country equivalent, is required; MBA preferred. Professional qualifications such as CA, CFA, FRM or CPA are a strong advantage.
* Experience: 15+ years of progressive experience in finance, FP&A, treasury finance or balance sheet management within banking or financial services.
* Domain expertise: Strong knowledge of Asset and Liability Management (ALM), deposits, NII, FTP, liquidity (LCR/LST), interest rate risk and the bank balance sheet, with a sound understanding of financial controls and governance.
* Global operating model: Proven track record of building and scaling India-based Centers of Excellence that partner with US/EMEA senior leadership; ability to influence senior stakeholders and translate complex technical-financial topics into clear business narratives.
* Communication & tools: Excellent written, verbal and executive presentation skills; advanced MS Office; proficiency with enterprise planning, reporting and ERP tools (e.g., Planning Analytics/TM1, Cognos, HFM, Oracle) and Power BI – exposure to Python/SQL, automation and AI tools is a plus.
* People leadership: 7+ years leading multi-layered teams (VPs, AVPs, Specialists and Analysts), with demonstrated strength in organization design, workforce and succession planning, coaching and performance management, and in building an inclusive, high-performance culture.

At BNY, our culture speaks for itself, check out the latest BNY news at:
  
  
BNY Newsroom
  
  
BNY LinkedIn

* World’s Most Admired Companies, Fortune 2025

BNY offers highly competitive compensation, benefits, and wellbeing programs rooted in a strong culture of excellence and our pay-for-performance philosophy. Focus on your health, foster your personal resilience, and reach your financial goals as a valued member of our team, along with generous paid leaves, including paid volunteer time, that can support you and your family through moments that matter.

.

Data and Analytics Professionals at HSBC have responsibility for executing our HSBC Data Strategy. Their responsibilities are threefold:

The role ensures that data is structured, governed, trusted, and managed as a strategic asset, enabling effective decision-making, operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and technology transformation.
  
  
The role leads the development and execution of the organisation's data architecture, data quality, lineage, metadata, and data management capabilities, establishing robust controls and standards across the technology estate while driving adoption and accountability throughout the organisation.

* Define, own, and continuously evolve the end-to-end enterprise data model.

* Ensure consistency, standardisation, and reuse of data assets across platforms, functions, and technology domains.

* Proven Agile Project Management and leading geographically distributed, multidisciplinary teams, influencing senior stakeholders and delivering measurable value at pace within a regulated environment.
* Experience delivering data analysis, data mining, data wrangling and data delivery, producing trusted, reusable and scalable data products for business, operational, risk and regulatory requirements.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

jobs.description:
The Contract Administrator will be responsible for end-to-end post-award contract administration for real estate development projects within the assigned Zone. The role will ensure that Contractual Obligations, Deliverables, Notices, Changes, Extension of Time (EOT), Liquidated Damages, Suspension, Variations, Extra Items, De-scoping / Re-scoping, Termination, Claims, Counterclaims, Time & Cost Risks and Records are administered and manage in a timely, compliant, and commercially protective manner throughout the project lifecycle, safeguarding the interests of Godrej Properties Limited (GPL)

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

**Post-Award Contract Administration**

* Administer contracts after award through completion, handover, and closeout, ensuring all contractual terms, conditions, obligations, and timelines are understood and monitored.
* Track contractual milestones, deliverables, approvals, payment-related conditions, insurance, bonds, bank guarantees, indemnities, undertakings, and other contractual securities,
* Monitor contractor, supplier, consultant, and vendor performance against agreed scope, schedule, quality, safety, documentation, and contractual requirements.
* Ensure timely issuance, receipt, acknowledgement, and follow-up of contractual notices, responses, instructions, approvals, and other formal communications.
* Maintain a centralized, audit-ready repository of contracts, amendments, change orders, correspondence, submittals, approvals, handover/takeover documents, securities, indemnities, and dispute-related records

  

**Time and Cost Management**

* Administer extensions of time (EOT), delays, prolongation claims, disruption claims, cost compensation claims, variations, change orders, and amendments submitted by contractors, suppliers, vendors, or consultants.
* Review claims and entitlement submissions against contractual terms, conditions, notices, records, programmes, specifications, drawings, correspondence, and site documentation.
* Support assessment of time and cost impacts, identify contractual entitlement or non-entitlement, and prepare reasoned recommendations for management review.
* Monitor cost variations, extra claims, provisional sums, retention, liquidated damages, and other commercial implications arising during contract execution.
* Ensure contemporaneous records, delay registers, event logs, progress records, correspondence, and supporting evidence are maintained to defend or support contractual positions.

  

**Claims and Risk Management**

* Identify, assess, and escalate potential or anticipated claim risks during the contract period through a structured Claim Risk Cadence.
* Highlight deviations, non-compliances, delays, scope changes, documentation gaps, and performance issues by contractors, suppliers, consultants, or other external parties.
* Prepare contractual defence strategies, counter-measures, counterclaims, rejoinders, and supporting documentation to protect GPLs commercial and legal interests.
* Assist in drafting statements, responses, rebuttals, position papers, and supporting material for disputes, arbitrations, conciliation, litigation, or other formal resolution processes.
* Coordinate with Legal, Finance, Planning, Design, Quality, Safety, Procurement, Costing, and Project teams to ensure a consistent and well-supported contractual position.

  

**Contractual Correspondence and Documentation**

* Draft, review, and issue clear, accurate, and commercially protective contractual correspondence, including emails, notices, letters, reminders, clarifications, and responses.
* Prepare and review Minutes of Meetings (MOMs) for contract review meetings, claim discussions, coordination meetings, and issue-resolution meetings.
* Ensure contractual communications are properly documented, version-controlled, circulated to relevant stakeholders, and retained in the contract repository.
* Support preparation of contract MIS, compliance dashboards, claim registers, risk registers, open-issue trackers, and periodic management reports.

  

**Stakeholder Coordination**

* Act as the single point of contact (SPOC) for contractual matters within the assigned Zone.
* Work closely with the Head Contract Administration (HO) to escalate, resolve, and align contractual issues across zones and functions.
* Interface with internal stakeholders including Design, Planning, Contracts & Procurement, Costing & Budgeting, Legal, Finance & Accounts, Quality, Safety, and Project Management teams.
* Interface with external stakeholders including contractors, suppliers, vendors, consultants, and other project partners for contractual coordination and issue resolution.
* Conduct periodic contract administration reviews and ensure timely follow-up on pending actions, notices, claims, risks, and compliance gaps.

  

**Compliance and Governance**

* Ensure all contract administration activities comply with approved contract terms, internal policies, governance procedures, approval matrices, and documentation standards.
* Flag contractual, commercial, procedural, and compliance risks to the relevant stakeholders in a timely manner.
* Ensure availability, validity, and adequacy of bank guarantees, indemnities, undertakings, insurance, and other contractual securities throughout the project lifecycle.
* Support internal audits, reviews, due diligence, and dispute-readiness requirements by maintaining complete, accurate, and accessible contract records.

  

**Key Deliverables**

* Contract administration tracker and milestone register.
* Contractual correspondence register and notice tracker.
* Change order / variation / amendment register.
* EOT and claim assessment register.
* Claim risk register and Claim Risk Cadence report.
* Compliance and non-compliance tracker.
* Contract document repository and document control records.
* Contract MIS and periodic management reports.
* Dispute / arbitration support documentation and records.

  

**Required Skills and Competencies**

* Strong understanding of construction and real estate contracts, including scope, obligations, variations, EOT, claims, notices, securities, and dispute-resolution provisions.
* Ability to interpret contract terms and assess time and cost entitlements in a structured and evidence-based manner.
* Strong drafting skills for contractual letters, notices, emails, MOMs, claims responses, rejoinders, and management reports.
* Strong documentation, record-keeping, tracking, and MIS capabilities.
* Ability to identify commercial and contractual risks early and recommend practical mitigation measures.
* Strong coordination and stakeholder-management skills across project, commercial, legal, finance, and technical functions.
* Detail-oriented, proactive, commercially aware, and able to work under deadlines.
* Familiarity with contract management systems, document control practices, and project-management tools is desirable.

  

What are we looking for?

  

**Qualification**

* B.E Civil minimum with 10+ years of related work experience in the field of contracts administration of construction projects.
* Relevant experience in contract administration, contracts management, quantity surveying, commercial management, claims management, or project controls within real estate, construction, infrastructure, or development projects.
* Experience in handling contractor claims, EOT assessments, variations, change orders, contractual notices, and dispute-support documentation is preferred.
* Exposure to FIDIC, standard-form construction contracts, or organization-specific contract frameworks is desirable

  

Whats in it for you?
