jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Commercial Services
jobs.description:
### **A****BOUT TIDE**

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

**Tide facts:**

* Tide is available for UK, German and French SMEs
* Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
* Over $300 million raised in funding
* 3,000 Tideans globally
* We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

### **ABOUT THE TEAM:**

Tide is hiring a Director of Engineering to lead the engineering organisation behind Commercial Services. You will report to the CDTO and partner with Product and Design leadership as one leadership team accountable for the outcomes of the domain.

Commercial Services is where Tide extends from helping members run their business to helping them grow it. You will shape how quickly every member becomes discoverable, how much of their buying and selling runs through Tide, and how far AI can turn that into a lasting advantage across every market we serve.

Sell gives every member a live, discoverable presence, from the Tide Business Pages we are launching for 2 million members across the UK and Europe, to Own Website, catalogue, bookings, CRM and lead capture, and embedded fulfilment through Delivery as a Service.

Buy turns that member base into a two-sided marketplace through the Tide Online Network, alongside Tide Promotions (gift cards, cashback and personalised offers), business supplies from partners, and Vendor Hub for e-procurement.

You will be the single owner accountable for engineering delivery, architecture and people across both.

### **ABOUT THE ROLE:**

This role sits at the intersection of SME commerce, marketplaces and banking. Our members sit on both sides of the marketplace, our partners extend what we can offer them, and our banking platform lets us layer payments, credit, insurance and rewards into the experience at the point of need, which few commerce players can do. We need someone who can bring both streams onto one consistent engineering bar, ship quickly and build the platforms that turn Commercial Services into a material recurring revenue line for Tide.

As Director of Engineering you will

* Set the engineering strategy and technical direction across the Sell and Buy value streams, from launch through to scale.

* Apply our OnePlatform principles so we build once, deploy globally, and keep market-specific logic isolated.

* Director engineering leadership of a multi-team organisation of around 50 engineers across backend, frontend, data and analytics, led through at least one layer of engineering leaders.
* Domain experience in e-commerce, two-sided marketplaces, CRM or procurement platforms, including the trust and safety controls they need, with fintech or SME banking experience a plus.
* Strong track record of turning platform investment into measurable product and commercial outcomes.
* Experience building partner and third-party integration platforms at scale.
* Strong product and design partnership instincts.
* Comfortable setting direction through ambiguity and launching new products into multiple markets.
* Strong judgement across organisation design, delivery, architecture and technical quality.
* Experience bringing AI or agentic experiences into customer-facing commerce products would be a bonus.

### **OUR TECH STACK:**

* Backend: Java, Spring/Spring Boot, microservices architecture
* Mobile/Web: Flutter / Angular
* Infrastructure: AWS (SNS+SQS), PostgreSQL via RDS or Aurora, GCP (BigQuery, Vertex)
* Observability: Coralogix (OpenTelemetry
* Claude for agentic ways of working

### **WHAT YOU'LL GET IN RETURN:**

Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans:

* Competitive Compensation - Competitive salary and share options.
* Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.
* Parental Leave – Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.
* Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.
* Health Insurance – Private family insurance with additional OPD coverage and top-up options.
* Life & Accident Cover – Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection.
* Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.
* Volunteering & Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth.
* Learning & Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more.
* WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually.
* Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office.
* Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it's time for a replacement.
* Snacks & Meals – Office perks with snacks, coffee, tea, and lunch (location dependent).

### **TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING**

At Tide, we champion a **flexible workplace** model thatsupports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams.

While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.

### **TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE**

jobs.title: Area Manager - Credit & Operations
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTIONAREA MANAGER – CREDIT & OPERATIONS

**Industry:** NBFC- Gold Loan  
**Location:** Thiruvananthapuram / Assigned Area  
**Department:** Credit & Operations  
**Reporting To:** Regional Manager / Head of Operations

1. Job Purpose

The Area Manager – Credit & Operations will be responsible for managing credit operations, customer visits, loan appraisal and approval, branch performance, business development and portfolio quality across assigned branches.

The position requires an experienced professional who can balance credit discipline with business growth, regularly visit branches, motivate employees, support customer acquisition and ensure efficient branch operations.

The Area Manager will play a key role in improving business performance across Gold Loan, Business Loan and Commercial Property Loan products.

2. Duties & Responsibilities

**A. Branch Visits & Business Development**

* Visit every assigned branch at least once a week.
* Review branch-wise business performance, loan disbursements, outstanding and collection efficiency.
* Motivate Branch Managers and employees to improve business sourcing and achieve assigned targets.
* Conduct regular meetings with branch teams to review performance and business plans.
* Identify local business opportunities and support branches in acquiring new customers.
* Participate in important customer meetings and assist branch teams in converting high-value loan proposals.
* Identify operational and business challenges and provide suitable solutions.
* Monitor staff productivity and provide guidance to improve individual performance.
* Develop strategies to improve branch business across Gold Loans, Business Loans and Commercial Property Loans.
* Submit weekly branch visit reports with observations, business updates and action plans.

**B. Customer Visits & Credit Assessment**

* Conduct regular customer visits for Business Loan and Commercial Property Loan proposals.
* Visit business premises, commercial establishments and properties to assess customer credentials and business activities.
* Evaluate customer repayment capacity, business operations and financial position.
* Independently verify information provided in loan applications and identify discrepancies.
* Meet prospective and existing customers to understand their financial requirements.
* Support branch teams in handling high-value and critical loan proposals.
* Ensure proper field verification and due diligence before recommending loan proposals.

**C. Credit Appraisal & Loan Approval**

* Review and evaluate loan applications across assigned branches.
* Assess customer eligibility, repayment capacity, income documents and credit history.
* Ensure proper assessment of collateral, property valuation and legal documentation.
* Review and approve or recommend loan proposals within delegated authority.
* Ensure adherence to credit policies, lending norms and product-specific eligibility criteria.
* Identify potential credit risks and take preventive measures.
* Ensure proper documentation and verification before loan disbursement.
* Improve credit processing turnaround time without compromising lending standards.

**D. Gold Loan Operations**

* Monitor gold loan appraisal procedures and ensure adherence to company guidelines.
* Ensure accuracy in gold purity testing, weight assessment and valuation.
* Monitor Loan-to-Value (LTV) compliance and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Conduct surprise inspections and verification of gold packets and vault procedures.
* Ensure proper custody, security and reconciliation of pledged gold ornaments.
* Monitor gold loan renewals, closures, overdue accounts and auction procedures.

**E. Business Loan & Commercial Property Loan Operations**

* Supervise credit evaluation and processing of Business Loan and Commercial Property Loan applications.
* Review financial statements, bank statements, income documents and business cash flows.
* Ensure proper property valuation, legal scrutiny and title verification for property-backed loans.
* Coordinate with legal, technical and credit teams for timely processing.
* Ensure compliance with approved lending policies and sanction conditions.
* Monitor documentation, disbursement and post-disbursement compliance.

**F. Branch Operations & Process Control**

* Monitor daily branch operations and ensure operational discipline.
* Conduct periodic branch inspections and operational audits.
* Ensure proper cash management, document custody and record maintenance.
* Review daily transactions, disbursement reports and operational MIS.
* Identify process gaps and implement corrective measures.
* Ensure adherence to internal SOPs and operational guidelines.

**G. Portfolio Monitoring, Collections & Recovery**

* Monitor branch-wise portfolio performance and overdue accounts.
* Track NPA, delinquency and collection efficiency.
* Identify early warning signals and potentially stressed accounts.
* Coordinate with Branch Managers for recovery and overdue reduction.
* Ensure timely follow-up of maturing and overdue loan accounts.
* Recommend corrective actions to improve portfolio quality.

**H. Team Management & Motivation**

* Guide, supervise and motivate Branch Managers and branch employees.
* Train branch teams on credit policies, documentation and operational procedures.
* Conduct regular performance reviews and operational training.
* Ensure accountability and adherence to defined responsibilities.
* Support branch teams in achieving business and collection targets.
* Build a customer-focused and result-oriented working culture.

**I. Compliance, Risk Management & Audit**

* Ensure compliance with applicable RBI regulations and internal policies.
* Monitor KYC, AML and customer due diligence requirements.
* Coordinate internal, concurrent and statutory audits.
* Ensure timely closure of audit observations.
* Report operational irregularities, fraud indicators and policy violations to management.
* Ensure effective implementation of risk management practices across branches.

**J. MIS & Management Reporting**

* Prepare and review branch-wise credit and operational performance reports.
* Monitor loan sanctions, disbursements, outstanding, collections and overdue positions.
* Submit periodic reports to Regional Management / Head Office.
* Analyse operational bottlenecks and recommend process improvements.
* Prepare weekly branch visit reports and follow up on pending action points.
* Support management in implementing business growth and risk management strategies.

3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* **Branch Visits:** Minimum one visit to every assigned branch every week.
* **Business Growth:** Improvement in branch-wise sourcing and loan disbursements.
* **Customer Visits:** Regular field visits for customer verification and credit assessment.
* **Credit Approval:** Timely appraisal and decision-making.
* **Branch Motivation:** Regular performance meetings and staff engagement.
* **Credit Quality:** Effective control over NPA and overdue accounts.
* **Gold Loan Operations:** Accuracy in appraisal, LTV compliance and gold security.
* **Operational Efficiency:** Audit scores, process adherence and documentation quality.
* **Collections:** Improvement in recovery and collection efficiency.
* **Reporting:** Timely submission of weekly and monthly MIS reports.

4. Candidate Profile

* Graduate / Postgraduate in any discipline; finance or banking qualifications preferred.
* 8–15 years of experience in Banking or NBFC operations.
* Strong experience in credit appraisal, loan operations and branch administration.
* Exposure to Gold Loans, Business Loans and Loan Against Property / Commercial Property Loans.
* Experience in handling multiple branches or geographical areas preferred.
* Good knowledge of RBI regulations, KYC, AML and credit risk management.
* Strong customer relationship, business development and team leadership skills.
* Willingness to travel regularly

**Product Manager, Input Zone**

  

**About our Team:-**

DSM Product is the product management team within Data Source Management (DSM, led by Adrian Scotney), part of Data Operations (led by Kanwar Singh). It is led by the Head of Product Management and owns product management for how publisher content enters the Input Zone, Elsevier’s governed gateway for academic publisher content. This includes technical onboarding, ingestion development, publisher rights data (Salesforce) and the Platform Intelligence reporting that supports content providers.

The team is organised around three areas: Platform Intelligence (PLINT), Salesforce/SCM, and the Content Acquisition Liaisons functions that cover ingestion development and technical onboarding.

  

**About the Role:-**

The Product Manager, Input Zone will own the technical onboarding and ingestion-development activities for the Content Acquisition Liaisons group and lead execution of related workstreams. They will own the development plan for the ingestion pipeline and technical onboarding workflow, represent this area within the PM team, and have a solid understanding of content providers and publishers. They will represent their technical needs to the delivery team, prioritise and communicate production issues affecting ingestion or onboarding, and support and participate in demos to key stakeholders at programme milestones.

**Customer Focus**

* Interacts with content providers, publishers, and internal engineering teams during technical onboarding and represents their requirements.

* Anticipates onboarding and ingestion needs (for example, journal processing moving to the DPOP-601 workflow and the Scopus transition off the legacy OpsBank workflow) and prioritises them for the group.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, BG&C
jobs.description:
**Senior Manager, BG&C**
========================

Req ID: 124671

Department: GO - GCC Bengaluru

Division: Group Operations

Location: Bengaluru

**About Us**
------------

At ANZ, we're shaping a world where people and communities thrive, driven by a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our millions of customers.

**About the Role**
------------------

The Senior Manager, Business Governance & Controls (BG&C), leads the first-line operational risk and control agenda for the Bengaluru GCC. The role establishes a consistent and effective risk and control environment aligned with ANZ’s Risk Appetite and enterprise risk framework, while ensuring business and functional leaders retain clear ownership of their risks and controls.

  

As the senior risk partner to the GCC Head and GCC Leadership Team, the role provides independent-minded advice and constructive challenge, strengthens risk culture and operational resilience, and enables well-informed business decisions. The role also leads the continuous improvement of control testing, assurance insights and governance reporting across the GCC.

  

Banking is changing and we’re changing with it, giving our people great opportunities to try new things, learn and grow. Whatever your role at ANZ, you’ll be building your future, while helping to build ours.

  

**Role Type: Full Time, Permanent**  
**Role Location: Bengaluru**

**What will your day look like?**
---------------------------------

As a Senior Manager, BG&C, you will:

  

* Develop and execute the GCC first-line risk and control strategy, aligned with ANZ’s Risk Appetite, enterprise risk framework and relevant regulatory obligations.
* Establish and maintain a consistent GCC-wide approach to identifying, assessing, managing, monitoring and reporting operational and compliance risks, with clear business ownership of risks and controls.
* Act as the senior risk partner to the GCC Head and GCC Leadership Team, providing timely advice, evidence-based insights and constructive challenge to support informed decision-making.
* Lead GCC-wide risk assessments across operational, technology, cyber, data, third-party, people, conduct, regulatory and change risks, ensuring material exposures and emerging themes are identified and addressed.
* Oversee the GCC operational resilience agenda, including first-line oversight of critical operations, material service providers, intra group arrangements, business continuity and key dependency or concentration risks.
* Coordinate GCC implementation of relevant enterprise and regulatory risk requirements, including PACT, NFR framework changes and CPS 230-related obligations, in partnership with Group Risk and specialist teams.
* Lead the design, uplift and consistent application of control testing methodologies, quality benchmarks, documentation standards and review practices across GCC teams and portfolios.
* Champion data-led and automated testing approaches where appropriate, ensuring enhancements are well governed, scalable and improve the quality and efficiency of assurance outcomes.
* Synthesise risk assessments and control testing outcomes into clear, prioritised insights for the GCC Leadership Team and relevant governance forums, including transparent escalation of material weaknesses, systemic issues and non-compliance risks.

* Oversee the quality and progress of remediation, challenging whether actions address root causes and provide sufficient evidence of sustainable closure, while retaining accountability with the relevant business owner.
* Lead first-line coordination of internal, external and in-country audits for the GCC, ensuring effective business engagement, timely responses and disciplined tracking of agreed actions.
* Build a strong risk and compliance culture by coaching leaders, strengthening accountability and promoting open, transparent engagement across businesses, functions, second line, Audit and other key stakeholders.
* Lead and develop the BG&C team, ensuring effective resourcing, clear priorities and the skills and capability required to meet current and future GCC needs.
* Drive continuous improvement of the GCC risk and control environment, supporting business, process, systems and automation changes while ensuring associated risks are understood and appropriately managed.

**What will you bring?**
------------------------

To grow and be successful in this role, you will ideally bring the following:

  

**‘Must have’ knowledge, skills and experiences**

  

* Strong degree of know-how and ability to drive strategic initiatives
* Strong understanding of risk and control frameworks, including control taxonomies and enterprise risk standards.
* Knowledge of regulatory obligations relevant to conduct, compliance, and operational risk.
* Awareness of business processes, control design principles, and first‑line risk responsibilities.
* Analytical capability to interpret data, identify patterns, and translate findings into actionable insights.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey risk messages clearly and influence stakeholders.
* Ability to assess control adequacy and effectiveness, including root‑cause analysis and evidence evaluation.
* Stakeholder engagement and relationship‑building skills, with confidence to challenge constructively.
* Planning and prioritisation skills to manage testing cycles, competing workloads, and quality standards.
* Experience delivering control testing, quality assurance, or risk assessment activities in a regulated environment.
* Demonstrated involvement in analysing business processes and identifying control gaps or compliance issues.
* Strong understanding of risk management and operational risk
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to lead discussions and partner effectively with stakeholders across geographies
* Knowledge of banking processes and/or products
* Extensive experience in enterprise risk management and/or leadership roles within the banking, financial services or KPO sectors
* Knowledge of retail banking products and processes
* Demonstrated experience in risk and compliance management
* Strong stakeholder management
* Demonstrated experience in people leadership and capability development

**‘****Good to have’ knowledge, skills and experiences**

  

* ERP systems and Risk toolkits
* PACT
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Programs
* Business and Executive Report Writing

  

**Qualifications**

  

* Relevant tertiary qualifications
* Overall 15+ years of experience in banking, including a minimum of five years in risk, compliance or audit

  

You’re not expected to have 100% of these skills. At ANZ a growth mindset is at the heart of our culture, so if you have most of these things in your toolbox, we’d love to hear from you.

**So why join us?**
-------------------

From the moment you join ANZ, you'll be doing meaningful work that will shape a world where people and communities thrive.

  

But it's not just our customers who'll feel your impact. you'll feel it too. Because at ANZ, you'll have the resources, opportunities, and support you need to take the next big step in your career.

  

We're a diverse bunch at ANZ in different roles, different locations, doing different things. That's why we have a range of flexible working arrangements, so our people can 'make work, work for them'. We also provide a range of benefits including access to health and wellbeing services and discounts on selected products and services from ANZ and more.

  

At ANZ, you'll be part of an organisation where the different backgrounds, perspectives and life experiences of our people are celebrated. That's because we're committed to building a workplace that reflects the diversity of the communities we serve. jobs.title: Head of Banking & Payment Partnerships
jobs.description:
**Who we are**
We are a global wealth-tech company powering the next generation of trading. We deliver cutting-edge centralised trading solutions and robust B2B financial infrastructure. Our proprietary trading platform offers clients seamless access to stocks, ETFs, bonds, futures, options, swaps, funds, and currency pairs- all within a single, multi-currency account.
  
  
We believe in the boundless flow of capital and information. Whilst developing EXANTE, we saw technology as a means to improve global connectivity of the financial services industry. Over the years, we have earned a reputation for providing superior service and for getting the results our clients and customers want.
  
  
Most importantly, people have come to know us for our technological insights and focus on privacy. Our inspiration stems from the talent and ambition of our clients. We are offering an ecosystem of financial products and services that would provide the most tailored assistance to traders.
  
  
**Our culture**
Everything at EXANTE starts with our people. We bring together almost 800 minds across 70 locations. We place trust in our team with real autonomy - the freedom to drive change across products, processes and everything in between. That trust fuels innovation, and the demands of the markets build resilience; we adapt, push forward, and we look after each other while we do it.
  
  
That freedom is matched by real investment in growth: we back our people with ongoing learning, hands-on development and the kind of stretch opportunities that turn good careers into great ones.
  
  
**The Role Purpose**
We are looking for an experienced and commercially driven Head of Banking & Payment Partnerships to lead the development, expansion and management of EXANTE’s global banking and payment partner network.
  
  
This is a senior, hands-on role with end-to-end responsibility for establishing and maintaining strategic relationships with banks, payment service providers and e-money institutions across multiple jurisdictions.
  
  
You will play a critical role in strengthening our banking infrastructure, diversifying counterparty relationships, optimising commercial terms and ensuring reliable banking and payment services that support our international business and clients.
  
  
Working closely with senior leadership and cross-functional teams, you will combine strong industry relationships, commercial negotiation skills and operational expertise to build a resilient, cost-effective and scalable banking network.
  
  
**Reporting Line**
— Chair Of Executive Committee
  
  
**Worksite**
— Remote
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Develop and expand our global banking network: Identify, evaluate and establish new relationships with banks, payment service providers and e-money institutions across key jurisdictions, including Malta, Cyprus, the UAE and Mauritius, supporting EXANTE’s international growth and operational needs.
* Own the end-to-end counterparty lifecycle: Lead the entire process from initial engagement and commercial negotiations through due diligence, onboarding, account opening and ongoing relationship management, ensuring timely and successful execution.
* Drive commercial value: Negotiate competitive banking and payment terms, including transaction fees, interest on client balances, credit facilities, account conditions and service levels, with a focus on cost optimisation and long-term value.
* Manage and strengthen strategic partnerships: Build trusted, sustainable relationships with existing banking partners through regular engagement, proactive issue resolution and ongoing management of compliance requirements, account restrictions and service performance.
* Lead banking due diligence and onboarding: Coordinate complex KYC, AML and regulatory due diligence processes, working closely with internal Compliance, Risk and other stakeholders to address counterparty requirements and facilitate successful onboarding.
* Ensure operational readiness and resilience: Partner with Finance, IT and Operations to establish effective banking and payment processes, including account structures, payment connectivity, transaction flows, reconciliations and contingency arrangements.
* Optimise counterparty diversification and performance: Monitor banking relationships, service quality, costs and counterparty concentration, identifying opportunities to mitigate risks, improve efficiency and strengthen the resilience of our banking infrastructure.
* Drive cross-functional execution and reporting: Collaborate with senior leadership and teams across the business to prioritise banking initiatives, manage multiple onboarding projects and provide clear visibility of partnership pipelines, commercial outcomes and emerging risks.

**What You Will Bring**
- Extensive relevant experience: At least 8 years of experience in banking relationship management, treasury, payment partnerships or financial institution coverage, ideally within a brokerage, fintech, payment institution, e-money business or financial services environment.
  
  

* Established banking network: Strong, active relationships with banks, financial institutions and payment providers, ideally across key international markets, including Europe, the UAE and other relevant jurisdictions.
* Proven track record of establishing banking partnerships: Demonstrable success in securing new banking relationships, opening corporate and client-money or safeguarding accounts, and establishing payment solutions for regulated financial services businesses.
* Strong commercial and negotiation skills: Experience negotiating banking fees, interest arrangements, credit facilities and service agreements, with the ability to demonstrate measurable commercial improvements and cost efficiencies.
* Deep understanding of banking due diligence: Strong knowledge of KYC, AML, regulatory requirements and financial institution onboarding processes, particularly for businesses operating across multiple jurisdictions with complex international client bases.
* Knowledge of banking and payment infrastructure: Solid understanding of banking operations, client-money arrangements, payment flows and relevant payment systems, such as SWIFT, SEPA, local payment rails and banking APIs.
* Excellent stakeholder and relationship management skills: Ability to engage confidently with senior banking executives, compliance and risk teams, internal leadership and cross-functional stakeholders, building credibility and maintaining productive long-term partnerships.
* Strong execution and project management capabilities: A proactive, structured and results-oriented approach, with the ability to manage multiple complex banking initiatives simultaneously and drive them through to completion.
* International financial services exposure: Experience supporting brokerage or financial services businesses with international client bases, particularly across European, CIS or Middle Eastern markets, would be a strong advantage.
* Communication skills: Fluency in English, with excellent communication, presentation and influencing skills

jobs.title: Head of Treasury

I am working with a well-established investment holding group in the UAE that is looking to appoint a Head of Treasury. The business has a significant portfolio of investments across multiple sectors and international markets.

As the group continues to grow and diversify, it is looking for someone to take ownership of its treasury function, develop its funding strategy and improve how cash, liquidity and financial risk are managed across the portfolio.

**Head of M&A**

Location: Dubai, UAE · Permanent

Our client, a banking group in the UAE, is hiring a senior M&A banker to build and lead a new advisory franchise within its Investment Banking business. This is a franchise-building role for an entrepreneurial dealmaker who can both originate and execute.

**Purpose of the role**

To originate, win and execute M&A and private capital advisory mandates across the bank’s client base. You’ll turn existing financing relationships into broader advisory relationships and build a sustainable, leading regional M&A franchise. The role needs strong transaction execution together with a commercial, proactive approach to origination and client development.

**Key accountabilities**

* Origination and franchise building: proactively find M&A and strategic advisory opportunities across the bank’s client base, and originate new mandates with relationship managers and sector teams.
* Trusted adviser: build senior relationships with shareholders, boards and management teams, and position the bank beyond its traditional financing role as an adviser on acquisitions, disposals, capital raising and strategy.
* M&A execution: lead sell-side and buy-side transactions end to end. This covers transaction strategy, valuation, process design, marketing materials, due diligence, negotiations and closing.
* Equity story and positioning: develop compelling equity and investment narratives for clients and assets, combining rigorous financial analysis with a clear view of strategic positioning, growth prospects and value creation.
* Buyer and investor access: identify, approach and build credibility with strategic buyers, financial sponsors, sovereign investors, family offices and other institutional investors, both in the region and internationally.
* Private capital: originate and execute private capital raising mandates, including growth equity, minority investments and other strategic capital solutions.
* Cross-bank collaboration and growth: bring the bank’s full capabilities and relationships to clients, build a sustainable pipeline of mandates, and grow Investment Banking revenues and the bank’s market profile.

**Experience and qualifications**

* About 15+ years of high-quality M&A or investment banking advisory experience, ideally at a leading investment bank or advisory platform.

jobs.description:
**Financial Advisory Service Offerings**

Teneo guides companies and their stakeholders through periods of uncertainty and stress to assess options, address financing and/or balance sheet stresses, create liquidity headroom, reduce costs, improve profitability, more efficiently run their businesses and turnaround and/or exit underperforming businesses, whilst communicating appropriately with stakeholders. Our expert team also brings market-leading experience in developing and delivering contingency plans and insolvencies across multiple jurisdictions, providing credible fallback plans to protect value or helping to shape and affect a restructuring.

We advise clients on strategies and actions to create, protect and realize value across the full spectrum of stressed or distressed transactions and industries, while helping leaders solve complex business challenges and achieve their goals. No two situations are the same, and our advice and approach is tailored to each set of circumstances and client priorities.

**The Role**

As part of ambitious growth plans for our already successful Middle East Financial Advisory business, we are looking for Managers, Associate Directors, Directors and Managing Directors to join our Financial Advisory team in the UAE. Our Managers, Associate Directors, Directors and Managing Directors have the opportunity to lead on a diverse range of engagements across different sectors and geographies, with responsibility for leading projects or key workstreams, managing junior staff and supporting senior leadership in client-facing delivery.

**Key Responsibilities**

Client service

* Lead and/or manage key parts of engagements, providing support to senior team members or often directly to the Senior Managing Directors.
* Support client management teams in preparing and challenging business plans, short and/or longer term cash flow forecasts and restructuring plans.
* Providing cash management services to clients to identify working capital and other cash flow improvements.
* Reviewing and stress-testing integrated business plans, budgeting and forecasting models using a fact-based, data driven approach, including KPI definition, data visualization, reporting automation and touchless forecasting.
* Reviewing detailed, integrated 3 statement forecasts (profit & loss, cashflow and balance sheet), and discounted cashflow (DCF).
* Preparing report outputs that may range from business plan documentation and board reports when working for a company, through to preparation of independent business reviews when working for creditors.
* Developing, analysing and presenting restructuring, refinancing and/or insolvency options using input from other teams, e.g. insolvency or tax analysis, sector and financial modelling.
* Liaising with the Company’s legal advisors to understand key aspects of legal documentation and also drive any documentation processes (term sheets, waivers, loan documentation etc.).
* Preparation of engagement letter(s) and ensuring adherence to all compliance requirements to support financial and risk management.
* Apply an understanding of engagement economics.

Knowledge acquisition

* Build client relationship skills, sector knowledge and continue to develop leadership skills.
* Continue to build technical expertise, broader business advisory and people management skills.
* Understand the market, topical issues and our Financial Advisory propositions.

People and leadership

* Support practice and talent development.
* Provide on-job coaching and development to staff.
* Develop junior staff outside of jobs through appraising and mentoring.
* Support wider Financial Advisory training initiatives.
* Manage diverse teams within an inclusive team culture where people are recognised for their contribution.

Business development

* Own elements of business development including actively supporting business development activities, building and expending your own contact network and supporting Middle East Financial Advisory marketing and sales activities.
* Participate in existing business development programmes and key client accounts.
* Identify opportunities to expand jobs as well as opportunities to provide wider Teneo services to existing clients.
* Take responsibility for leading marketing initiatives aimed at specific channels to market, or events.

Examples of the types of projects you would be expected to work on include:

* Company diagnostic, turnaround planning, and implementation
* Debt restructuring
* Short-term cash flow forecasting and cash management office set-up
* Preparation and validation of business plans
* Independent business reviews and options analysis
* Working capital management
* Operational cost reduction
* Interim management and active PMO leadership

**Key Skills & Experience**

Basic Qualifications

* A minimum of 5 years Financial Advisory experience gained either as an advisor within a professional services company, consultancy or investment bank.
* Very strong analytical skills, including: business analytics, business planning, short term cash flows, financing options.
* Understanding of financial statements and related data to assess historical financial performance and future outlook for client companies and prospects.
* Good understanding of the Financial Advisory marketplace, its trends, and key players (principals and advisers).
* Excellent interpersonal skills.
* Strong project management skills, with ability to lead mid-large teams and develop people.
* Understanding of debt markets, banking, loan agreements and other relevant financial and legal documentation.

Preferred Qualifications

* An Accounting degree and/or Qualified Accountant.
* Arabic language skills are strongly preferred, but not mandatory.
* Experience in the UAE or KSA market is strongly preferred.

**About Teneo**

Teneo is a leading global financial advisory powerhouse that provides innovative, market leading solutions from recognized experts across offices in the UK, US, The Caribbean and Bermuda, Europe, Middle East, Australia, and Asia Pacific, supported by Teneo’s wider global offering of c.2,000 professionals. We offer our clients unique, integrated solutions to complex issues.

Teneo’s full range of advisory services includes strategic communications, investor relations, financial advisory and restructuring, management consulting, physical and cyber risk, organisational design, board and executive search, geopolitics and government affairs. The breadth of our offering and our ability to provide bespoke and seamless advisory services, on either a standalone or integrated basis, makes us truly unique. Teneo's Middle East Financial Advisory senior leadership team has worked on the majority of the largest and most complex situations completed in the Middle East over the past 2 decades.

jobs.description:
**Job Purpose:**

To lead EDB’s investment and funding strategy by managing multi-asset portfolios and optimizing capital deployment across fixed income, equities, and private equity. The role ensures efficient liquidity and cost of funds through structured funding solutions, including public/private issuances and repo facilities. It also involves overseeing portfolio performance, regulatory compliance, and execution of investment and funding activities aligned with the bank’s strategic objectives, while driving cross-functional collaboration and revenue growth.

**Key Roles and Responsibilities:**

* Formulate, evaluate and implement investment policies, guidelines, asset allocation, selection of external investment managers, risk management, compliance monitoring and rebalancing through advanced planning and management of investment risk at strategic, managerial and operational levels.
* Manage the investment portfolios, analyze market trends and economic indicators as well as execute trades based on their analysis.
* Construct and continuously manage the fixed income portfolios within the approved parameters to generate alpha (risk-adjusted return) for the bank.
* Utilize cash flow planning for the funds and investments across a multi-year time horizon to assist in strategic decision-making.
* Align investment goals with the overall objectives of the bank and position portfolios accordingly.
* Conduct detailed financial analysis of the private equity portfolio, coupled with arranging quarterly performance calls with their senior management teams, attending AGMs, developing exit strategies (where required), and apprising EDB management periodically.
* Assess the funding needs of the bank, develop funding strategies, source potential investors, and formulate capital structure strategies to advise on capital investment decision making and ensure compliance with financial regulation.
* Choose the most cost-efficient effective funding solutions for the bank to minimize CoF while continuously revamping the mix to achieve optimum results
* Grow the short-term financing tools and manage liquidity of the bank by establishing a Repo framework in accordance with GMRA guidelines to optimize returns or to raise funding using fixed income securities
* Execute all tasks related to any existing or new issuances by the bank (public or private), including deliberations with the JLMs (Joint Lead Managers), external counsels and auditors, securities exchanges, regulators, rating agencies, etc.

**Operational Responsibilities:**

* Originate, price, execute, book, manage and monitor investments like Fixed Income securities, Listed and Unlisted Equities, Repo and Reverse Repos and other investments.
* Assess the bank’s cash positioning, including forecasts, and recommend ways to utilize idle funds by identifying potential investment opportunities
* Anticipate interest rate shifts and optimize trade timing to secure favorable terms with brokers and banks while negotiating terms like interest rates, yield, pricing, before making any investment decisions, ensuring alignment with EDB Investment guidelines and objectives.
* Rotate cash across assets classes or within the same asset class to optimize returns in the short term (when required), while focusing on maximizing the annuity income for the bank on a longer-term risk adjusted net-FTP basis
* Manage the private equity portfolio, review and analyze the company’s yearly valuations, attend EGMs & AGMs, report to senior management on company’s performance, manage dividend payouts, capital reductions or injections, including devising exit strategies
* Coordinate with the Risk Management and Compliance teams to ensure exposure remains within the limits defined with adherence to CBUAE and Basel regulatory requirements
* Partner with EDB’s Balance Sheet Management function to understand the bank’s funding requirements in the short, medium and long term.
* Perform market scan with banks, investors and other external counterparties to select viable funding solutions for the bank and recommend the same to ALCO
* Work with internal as well as external stakeholders, from origination to completion, to close the selected approved financing solution
* Transact Repo and Reverse Repo trades to manage short-term financing needs in accordance with approved guidelines. This requires the presence of an approved Repo framework, including a Product Manual, Standard Operating Procedure (SoP), and Operational Risk Assessment Plan (ORAP) duly signed off. Additionally, all transactions must be supported by executed GMRA agreements with counterparties, a functional collateral management operation, established counterparty limits, and a pricing mechanism with clearly defined haircuts.
* Draft and submit memos related to the Investment and Funding businesses to the relevant committees of the bank for approvals as per the DoA matrix
* Coordinate with the MIS team/Finance to deliver periodic performance updates as well as reports for senior management’s review and monitoring
* Evaluate and manage the bank’s capital adequacy, liquidity, profitability, and other ratios with the Risk department.
* Cultivate strong relationships with external counterparties while managing internal stakeholders with an equal amount of care and responsibility.
* Ensure all revenue, cost, and volume targets are delivered under the stipulated guidelines.
* Be the key driver in delivering a larger share of the P&L responsibility for T&I.
* Conduct constructive and meaningful discussions with senior management, using market knowledge and business expertise to build trust and affinity, leading to better performance results
* Develop and implement sound business practices across all investment as well as funding related activities/operations to promote efficiencies in work processes.
* Maintain a trusted partner status with Middle Office, Market Risk, Finance, and Operations.
* Comply 100% with all Legal, Risk, Compliance, and Operational requirements as well as ensure there are no breaches
* Function within the framework and boundaries of EDB’s policies as well as overall organizational and governance frameworks
* Maintain adherence to Treasury & Investments policies, procedures, and processes that comply with the leading practices, laws, and regulations
* Take decisions as per the approved authorization matrix.
* Always maintain the highest standards of work ethics, making sure that one operates in a professional environment, there are zero compromises on compliance or principles, any breaches of limits, etc. are immediately escalated, and all activities are performed under the approved audit framework

* Tracking document requests, open questions, workshops, findings, risks, actions, and decisions.
* Ensuring due diligence outcomes are converted into clear recommendations, action plans, and implementation implications.
* Coordinating across Al Ramz, Andersen, KGiSL, and other third-party vendors.
* Tracking vendor deliverables, dependencies, open actions, risks, and unresolved decisions.
* Ensuring vendor commitments are clear, measurable, and properly followed up.
* Escalating gaps, delays, unclear ownership, or weak delivery discipline when needed.

**Requirements**
----------------

* Experience in Enterprise PMO, Program Management, Transformation Governance, or Strategic Program Delivery for 4+ years.
* Strong experience in PMO methodology, governance, program controls, and executive reporting
* Experience working in financial services, capital markets, brokerage, banking, fintech, investment platforms, or similar regulated environments
* Experience coordinating complex business and technology transformation programs
* Strong stakeholder management across senior leadership, business, IT, finance, legal, compliance, and vendors
* Experience preparing steering committee materials, executive dashboards, decision papers, and program status reports
* Experience managing multi-vendor environments
* Financial services transformation exposure
* Ability to simplify complex topics for CFO / CTO-level stakeholders
* Ability to drive accountability across multiple parties

**Reasons to join us**

The company supports them in this and gives them access to the best educational platforms, seminars, and practices. In addition, for over 19 years, Andersen has assembled a huge knowledge base and established a robust resource management institution.

Join us!

This role is responsible for the ongoing monthly testing of the Quality Assurance program for all Wealth clients records in UAE. jobs.title: Senior Manager - Enterprise Transformation (India)
jobs.description:
Osfin.ai is a fast-growing transaction intelligence platform for Financial Services firms globally. Osfin.ai helps Financial Services firms automate payments and ledger reconciliation, disputes and chargebacks management, payouts automation, and more. Osfin.ai's customers have been able to transform their 100+ complex and resource-intensive FinOps processes smoothly.
  
  
**Who Is an Ideal Fit for Us?**
As Osfin scales, we are building a bench of enterprise-level subject-matter experts who can lead transformation and modernisation for large organisations and help us enter new finance domains. This is a high-ownership, client-facing role for someone who combines deep domain authority with a strong instinct for AI & automation and the commercial sense to turn expertise into product and growth.
  
  
**What Will You Get to Work On?**
As Director, Enterprise Transformation at Osfin.ai, you will look after:

* Process & Operating Model Redesign: Redesign end-to-end processes (Record-to-Report, Procure-to-Pay, Order-to-Cash) and the operating model to improve speed, scale and control.

* Governance and KPI framework running with regular executive reporting.
* Visible gains in cycle time, cost, or control quality.

* Shape how Osfin works and scales, alongside the founders and senior leadership.

Immediate joiners preferred (up to 30 days considered)

jobs.description:
Job description:
  
  

Location: India – Bangalore

Job Summary

We are seeking a Director, Treasury Program Management, to lead large treasury programs

across the global organization.

This role drives execution across treasury systems, bank connectivity, payments

modernization, settlement workflows, controls, reporting, exception-based processing,

automated dashboards, Sigma reporting, and process improvement.

The Director will lead programs across payments, capital markets, middle o

ice

workflows, credit facility administration, loan seasoning, investing, management reporting,

and forecasting.

What You’ll Do

Program Delivery & Governance

• Lead treasury programs end-to-end: Manage planning, execution,

implementation, adoption, and post-go-live stabilization while overseeing

milestones, risks, dependencies, governance, and issue management.

• Own program delivery & governance: Maintain program plans, stakeholder

updates, and reporting while translating business objectives into workstreams,

requirements, testing plans, controls, and implementation roadmaps.

• Coordinate cross-unctional stakeholders: Partner with Treasury, Capital Markets,

Middle O

ice, Finance, Accounting, Operations, Technology, banks, vendors, and

service providers.

• Drive automation & exception-based processing: Reduce manual e

ort, improve

data quality, strengthen controls, and expand automated dashboards, Sigma

reporting, and operational transparency.

• Improve payments, settlements & bank connectivity: Enhance payment

initiation, approval workflows, settlement instructions, reconciliations, and bank

connectivity including SWIFT and ISO 20022.

• Standardize treasury payment workflows: Streamline processes across regions,

funds, entities, currencies, and banking partners while reducing breaks and manual

intervention.

ice operations: Improve funding

• Support capital markets & middle o

coordination, trade lifecycle hando

s, confirmations, settlement tracking, and cash

movement visibility.

• Enhance operational reporting & transparency: Develop dashboards and

reporting to track funding requirements, settlement exceptions, breaks, open items,

and operational risk.

• Improve credit acility administration & loan processes: Enhance drawdowns,

repayments, interest tracking, lender notices, covenant workflows, borrowing base

activity, and facility utilization reporting.

• Strengthen investing, orecasting & reporting: Improve liquidity planning,

investment tracking, cash forecasting, variance analysis, and treasury decision

support.

• Deliver analytics & automated reporting: Build dashboards, Sigma reporting,

KPIs, executive updates, and treasury operating metrics while improving data flows

and reporting quality.

Testing, Controls & Change Management

• Lead requirements gathering, current-state reviews, future-state design, SIT, UAT,

regression testing, defect triage, and production readiness.

• Ensure strong documentation of processes, controls, roles and responsibilities,

escalation paths, and operating procedures.

• Drive adoption of new processes and ensure delivery outcomes are embedded into

daily operations.

What You’ll Bring

Required Experience

• 15 - 20 years of experience in treasury, treasury operations, middle o

ice, capital

markets operations, finance transformation, program management, or related

financial services roles.

• Experience leading large treasury, finance, or operations programs across multiple

stakeholders.

• Strong understanding of payments, settlements, bank connectivity, controls,

reporting, treasury workflows, and operational risk.

• Experience with requirements gathering, process design, testing, implementation,

and change management.

• Strong stakeholder management, delivery governance, presentation, and issue

resolution skills.

Must-have technical skills for this role include reporting, visualization, workflow,

automation, and testing capabilities across the treasury ecosystem, including automated

dashboards, Sigma reporting, SWIFT payment format testing automation, and treasury

platform testing automation.

• Hands-on experience using Excel, Power BI, Tableau, Sigma, Alteryx, SQL, Python,

workflow tools, test automation frameworks, or low-code automation platforms to

support treasury process improvement, reporting, and automation, with examples

including Power Automate, UiPath, Automation Anywhere, Blue Prism, KNIME, dbt,

Apache Airflow, pytest, Robot Framework, and Selenium-based testing approaches.

• Strong proficiency building dashboards, operational KPI views, variance analysis,

issue trackers, reconciliations, and executive reporting materials.

• Ability to define dashboard requirements, data models, business rules, workflow

metrics, and reporting packs that support treasury oversight and exception-based

processing.

• Experience working with large data sets, control evidence, exception reports,

process flows, testing evidence, and controls documentation.

• Must have experience supporting or driving automation for SWIFT payment format

testing, including payment message validation, formatting rule checks, bank

specific requirements, and regression testing across bank connectivity and treasury

payment workflows.

• Must have experience coordinating or executing automated testing across the

treasury ecosystem, including payments, settlements, reporting, controls,

interfaces, and related system integrations.

• Strong familiarity with SIT, UAT, regression testing, parallel runs, defect triage, test

evidence management, and implementation readiness.

• Ability to partner e

ectively with Technology teams, data teams, and operations

stakeholders without being a pure technology role.

• Exposure to AI-enabled automation or agentic workflow capabilities in treasury,

finance, or operations is a plus.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in asset management, private equity, banking, capital markets, fintech,

treasury operations, or global capability centers.

• Exposure to Treasury Management Systems, payment platforms, banking portals,

ERP tools, reporting platforms, or workflow tools.

• Familiarity with SWIFT messaging, ISO 20022, bank connectivity, settlement

processes, and treasury controls.

• Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, Information

Systems, Engineering, or related field.

• CTP, PMP, CPA, CFA, or process improvement certification preferred.

.

Experience: >10 YEARS
  
.

If you are looking for a game-changing career, working for one of the world's leading financial institutions, you've come to the right place.
  
  
As a Director of Software Engineering at JPMorganChase within Corporate Technology, you lead multiple technical areas, manage the activities of multiple teams, and collaborate across technical domains. jobs.title: EPM (Enterprise Performance Management) - Director
jobs.description:
The Opportunity
  
  
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
  
  
As an EPM Director you will lead Oracle Enterprise Performance Management client work, shaping budgeting, forecasting, financial consolidation, and reporting solutions that help organizations improve financial planning and analysis processes. As a Director you will set strategic direction, guide business development efforts, oversee multiple work streams, and inspire teams while upholding quality, integrity, inclusion, and a commercial mindset within our Technology Consulting practice. In this role at PwC, you will assess client needs, design and implement Oracle-based solutions, provide training and support, and use your leadership to cultivate opportunities for growth across engagements.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Leading Oracle enterprise performance management client engagements from strategy through implementation and ongoing support
* Shaping budgeting, forecasting, consolidation, and reporting solutions that align finance processes with business objectives
* Driving business development efforts by identifying client needs, defining solution approaches, and advancing growth opportunities

* Developing executive-level client relationships and advising finance leaders on performance management priorities and transformation paths
* Translating business process requirements into Oracle-based designs, configuration decisions, and integration approaches
* Guiding teams in financial planning and analysis, operational performance management, and reporting optimization
* Applying analytical thinking to evaluate current-state processes, diagnose gaps, and develop practical improvement recommendations
* Mentoring emerging leaders and promoting a collaborative environment that supports professional growth and knowledge sharing
* Validating compliance with professional standards, independence requirements, and firm policies across client delivery activities

What You Must Have
  
  

* At least a Bachelor's degree
* At least 17+ years of experience
* Oral and written proficiency in English required

What Sets You Apart
  
  

* Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Accounting, Accounting & Finance, Finance, Management Information Systems, Economics, Business Administration/Management
* At least one of the following: Oracle Cloud certification in Enterprise Performance Management or related Oracle EPM Cloud applications
* Demonstrating Oracle EPM Cloud delivery across planning and reporting
* Leading client-facing finance transformation and executive discussions
* Developing market-facing ideas for performance management solutions
* Translating financial data into actionable business insights
* Mentoring teams while balancing multiple client priorities

Delivery Leadership
  
  

* Lead multi-tower Oracle Cloud ERP & EPM programs end-to-end — from mobilization through stabilization.
* Establish program governance, delivery frameworks, and reporting cadence with PwC Global Engagement teams (Onshore teams).
* Ensure on-time, on-budget delivery with measurable quality and business outcomes.
* Drive delivery predictability using PwC methodologies, accelerators, and delivery standards.

Client & Engagement Management
  
  

* Partner with US and other regional engagement teams and client stakeholders to shape and deliver Oracle Cloud transformation roadmaps.
* Serve as escalation and quality assurance lead for offshore delivery, ensuring seamless client experience.
* Support business development through pre-sales, estimation, orals, and client presentations.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with global counterparts and client stakeholders to ensure a seamless and high-quality client experience.

Solution Architecture & Process Excellence
  
  

* Architect, design and review complex end to end solutions across Oracle Cloud EPM (Planning, Consolidation, Allocation, Account Reconciliation, Master Data management & Reporting Analytics).
* Drive business process re-engineering efforts by leveraging out-of-the-box Oracle functionalities to minimize customizations and maximize value.
* Leverage PwC accelerators, automation, and analytics to enhance delivery speed and value realization.
* Promote innovation in delivery through automation, GenAI, and advanced analytics adoption to enhance delivery speed and client value realization.

People & Practice Leadership
  
  

* Build, coach, mentor and grow large multidisciplinary Oracle teams within the AC.
* Drive practice-wide goals for utilization, capability development, and professional certifications across both functional and technical tracks.
* Lead internal practice initiatives, including the creation of reusable assets, accelerators, thought leadership, and the industrialization of delivery processes.
* Foster a culture of inclusion, care, collaboration, high performance, and continuous learning.

Operational & Financial Excellence
  
  

* Identify and deploy resources to projects; ensure consistent day-to-day engagement and productivity.
* Forecast demand, manage delivery capacity, and enable efficiency through a balanced onshore–offshore model.
* Ensure strict adherence to the firm’s quality standards, risk management protocols, and compliance requirements.

jobs.title: VP WRB Operational Excellence
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

* Drive transformational change across our global finance operations through process optimisation, quality enhancement, and strategic innovation.
* This is pivotal role reports directly to the GPLs and partners with central Process Performance Excellence (PPE) team to elevate operational maturity across GCFO workstreams
* Drive PPE Framework & Op Ex Strategy within relevant GPL workstream to identify optimisation opportunities
* Collaborate with GPLs and work on Book of work to focus to uplift the maturity of the processes and making it leaner etc.
* Play a critical role in process mining, identifying KPIs & dashboards to drive process insights

****Key Responsibilities****
**Strategy**
**Process Transformation & Innovation**

* Lead end-to-end process redesign initiatives across finance functions, delivering measurable improvements in efficiency, accuracy, & cycle times
* Architect scalable operating models that support business growth while reducing complexity & operational risk
* Champion automation & digital transformation leveraging RPA, AI/ML, and intelligent workflow solutions
* Establish PPE governance frameworks with clear ownership, controls, & performance metrics
* Drive standardisation & harmonisation of processes across regions & business units

**Business**
**Operational Excellence & Quality Management**

* Design & implement comprehensive quality assurance frameworks with zero-defect mindset
* Deploy Lean Six Sigma methodologies to eliminate waste, reduce variation, & optimise resource utilization
* Build continuous improvement culture through kaizen events, process mining, & root cause analysis
* Operationalise KPI dashboards & real-time monitoring capabilities for proactive issue resolution
* Lead defect prevention programs & implement mistake-proofing techniques across critical processes

**Processes**
**Strategic Partnership & Change Leadership**

* Work with Finance leadership to translate strategic objectives into operational roadmaps
* Act as trusted advisor to GPL and PPE Head on operational transformation priorities
* Lead cross-functional teams through complex change initiatives with strong stakeholder engagement
* Develop business cases demonstrating ROI for process improvement & technology investments
* Foster collaboration between Finance, Technology, Operations & Risk teams

**People & Talent**
**Capability Building**

* Develop training programs to upskill finance teams on process improvement methodologies
* Create centre of excellence for process optimization, automation, and quality management
* Mentor Process leaders on operational excellence principles & change management

**Risk Management**
**Regulatory & Compliance Excellence**

* Ensure process designs meet regulatory requirements (UK ACG, Basel, PRA, IFRS, tax & Regulatory compliance)
* Strengthen controls environment while simplifying processes & reducing operational burden
* Support audit readiness through robust documentation, testing protocols, & evidence management
* Drive remediation of audit findings & regulatory observations with sustainable solutions

**Governance**

* Reports directly to Head of Operational Excellence who drives the Strategy, operating model changes & strategic initiatives across GPLs.

**Regulatory & Business Conduct**

* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

**Key stakeholders**

* GCFO COO MT
* Relevant GPL
* PPE Team
* Global Op Ex team
* ARIS GPT
* SAP Signavio
* ProHance team
* Relevant Technology teams
* Infrastructure & Security Teams

****Skills and Experience****

* Expert in process mapping, analysis, and redesign using tools like ARIS, Signavio, or Celonis
* Proficient in data analytics and visualization platforms (Tableau, Power BI, Alteryx)
* Strong knowledge of ERP systems (SAP, Oracle) and finance technology ecosystem
* Experience with project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, hybrid approaches)
* Advanced Excel and data manipulation capabilities for complex analysis

****Qualifications****
**Education**

* MBA, Master's in Finance, or equivalent advanced degree
* 12-15+ years in finance operations, with 5+ years leading operational excellence or transformation programs
* Proven track record delivering large-scale process transformation in banking or financial services

**Training**

* Deep domain expertise across multiple finance functions (Accounting, Financial Reporting, FP&A, Treasury, Tax)
* Hands-on experience with process improvement methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, Value Stream Mapping)
* Demonstrated success implementing automation solutions (RPA, workflow tools, AI-enabled platforms)
* Strong understanding of regulatory environment and compliance requirements in banking

**Licenses**

* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt certification required; Master Black Belt preferred

**Certifications**

* Professional certifications (CA, CPA, CFA, CIMA, or equivalent) highly valued

****About Standard Chartered****
We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.
  
  
Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.
  
  
****What We Offer****

* Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
* In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
* Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
* Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
* Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
* Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
* A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

**Posting End Date:**
25/11/2026
  
  
For further information, and to apply, please visit our website via the “Apply” button below.

Asset Servicing Change The Bank- Director- Core Services
jobs.description:
We’re seeking someone to join our team as a Change The Bank Director in the Asset Servicing Group to manage assigned APAC and India change projects with a degree of autonomy, from initial analysis through implementation and adoption.
  
  
In the Operations division, we partner with business units across the Firm to support financial transactions, devise and implement effective controls and develop client relationships. This is a Team Specialist position at Director level within the Core Services.
  
  
Since 1935, Morgan Stanley is known as a global leader in financial services, always evolving and innovating to better serve our clients and our communities in more than 40 countries around the world.
  
  
**What You'll Do In The Role**

* Work closely with Operations to understand front-to-back processes, controls and pain points, and identify opportunities for efficiency, automation and platform renovation.
* Partner with Technology, global Asset Servicing teams, Business Units and partner functions to define requirements and deliver practical, scalable solutions.
* Develop and maintain project plans, milestones and governance, proactively managing risks, issues, dependencies and escalations.
* Provide clear delivery updates and change communications to stakeholders, including senior management, highlighting progress, decisions and areas requiring attention.
* Coordinate solution validation, user acceptance testing, defect resolution and business sign-off against agreed requirements and controls.
* Support implementation readiness and post-delivery review, ensuring changes achieve measurable and sustainable business outcomes.

**What You'll Bring To The Role**

* 5–7 years of relevant industry experience, ideally in Corporate Actions, Asset Servicing or securities operations.
* Good knowledge of process governance, operational risk, controls and escalation management.
* Experience delivering change with Technology teams, including requirements definition, solution design, testing and implementation.
* Strong stakeholder management and written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to provide clear delivery updates across global teams and to senior stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity, assess options and articulate business value.
* Proven project management skills, including the ability to work independently, manage competing priorities and drive delivery in a fast-paced environment.
* A continuous-improvement mindset, strong attention to detail and a collaborative approach to knowledge sharing.

**What You Can Expect From Morgan Stanley**
At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work.
  
  
To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste https://www.morganstanley.com/about-us/global-offices into your browser.
  
  
Morgan Stanley is an equal opportunity employer committed to building and maintaining a workforce that is diverse in experience and background. Our recruiting efforts reflect our strong commitment to a culture of inclusion, where individuals are hired, developed, and advanced based on their skills and talents.
  
  
Our workforce reflects a broad cross-section of the global communities in which we operate, bringing a variety of backgrounds, talents, perspectives, and experiences.
  
  
For more information, please visit: https://www.morganstanley.com/people-opportunities/eeo.
