jobs.title: Account Director, Private Sector (MEA & Turkey)
jobs.description:
Build a Safer World.
  
  
TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.
  
  
TRM helps financial institutions detect and stop illicit finance, and this role brings that mission to private sector clients including banks, payment providers, crypto natives and fintechs across MEAT. You will own the Private Sector business in a territory where TRM is building coverage, setting account strategy and strategic deals with compliance and risk leaders. What makes this seat unusual is a large greenfield territory plus the freedom to shape your own go-to-market with local partners and AI-assisted research.
  
  
**The Impact You Will Have**

* Open new private sector accounts across the MEAT region. Working with internal and external stakeholders to build effective networks to deliver commercial execution of TRM’s services to leading private sector organisations across the region.
* Win a mixture of high velocity and larger more strategic engagements, by turning AML and fraud pain points into a clear business case, with AI-drafted account plans and proposals that you sharpen with your own market judgment.
* Own and define the model to build a 3x qualified pipeline each quarter through targeted campaigns, using AI-assisted segmentation and local-language messaging, and measure what converts.
* Decide how TRM enters each market, choosing between direct selling, resellers, and regional partners, and back each choice with AI-assisted analysis of account data.
* Grow strategic existing customers engagements through renewals, upsells, and new use cases.
* Bring customer and regulatory insight back to Product and Marketing so the next release matches how banks in your region actually work.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 5+ years selling SaaS or data products into banks, payment firms, crypto or fintechs in MEAT, or 4+ years with deep AML and financial crime expertise, plus experience using AI tools to research and prioritize accounts.
* A record of closing a mixture of quick deal cycle and strategic longer term, higher value engagements and meeting quota, with AI-supported forecasting and pipeline reviews.
* Working knowledge of regional AML and sanctions frameworks and how compliance, risk, and procurement teams buy.
* Hands-on use of AI for prospecting, account planning, and call preparation, with clear examples of time or revenue gained.
* Experience building pipeline in a new territory, forming human lead networks and AI-assisted tools to test and measure what works.
* Credible, clear communication with senior compliance and risk executives, in person and virtually, including AI-assisted preparation for each meeting.
* Fluent English, other relevant languages including Arabic, Turkish, French a bonus
* Based in Dubai and willingness to travel regularly across the region.

**About The Team**

* TRM’s EMEA Sales team gives each Account Director full ownership of a territory and the room to choose how to win it.
* The team collaborates closely and supports one another through shared pipeline insight, deal reviews, and open sharing of what works.
* The work is hard in a useful way: regulated buyers, several countries, long procurement cycles, and a product category that is still new to many banks.
* You will work with RevOps, Marketing, Legal, Product, and Solutions Architecture, who move quickly to back your deals.

**Learn About TRM Speed In This Position**

* Within your first 30 days, you rank every target bank and fintech in your territory and start outreach to the top tier, so pipeline grows before onboarding ends.
* When a compliance leader asks for a demo late on a Friday, you and TRM’s Solutions team deliver it that day, turning a warm inquiry into a scheduled evaluation by Monday.
* Within 90 days, you build qualified pipeline worth at least 3x your quota, backed by an account plan for every Tier 1 target.

**Team Operating Rhythms**

* Distributed, not distant: the team works across Gulf time, and occasional US calls on complex deals.
* Slack is the center of day-to-day communication. @mention colleagues for timely responses.
* Weekly 1:1 with your manager, a weekly team call, a weekly pipeline call, a weekly forecast call, and regular pod calls.
* Company-wide all-hands and founder Q&A sessions keep everyone connected to the mission.

**Required Online And Collaboration Hours**

* Schedule: Core hours overlapping Gulf Time, with flexibility for occasional US calls.

**Application Instructions**
If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.
  
  
Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.
  
  
If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.
  
  
**Interviewing with TRM**
Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.
  
  

* Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.
* Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.
* First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.
* Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.
* References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.
* Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.
* Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.
  
  
**AI Fluency at TRM**
AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.
  
  
We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.
  
  
At TRM, AI Fluency Means You Are Among The Top 10 Percent Of Operators In Your Function In How You Apply AI To
  
  

* Accelerate repeatable workflows
* Structure and solve problems
* Improve output quality
* Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.
  
  
**Life at TRM**
We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.
  
  
TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.
  
  
Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.
  
  
**At TRM, You Should Expect**

* Priorities and targets to change quickly
* Operating with a high degree of ambiguity
* A high level of personal ownership and accountability
* Close collaboration across teams and functions
* Frequent, high-touch communication
* Creati

jobs.description:
**Job Description**
The Job in short
  
  
As a Customer Success Director at Backbase, you will be at the forefront of driving customer satisfaction and success across the Middle East You will be responsible for ensuring that our customers derive maximum value from Backbase’s Engagement Banking Platform. This role involves frequent travel across the region and requires a strong ability to build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders at all levels, from C-suite decision-makers to programme leaders.
  
  
Your mission is to foster product adoption and license consumption, enhance customer satisfaction, and contribute to Net ARR Growth by ensuring that our customers successfully leverage Backbase's solutions to achieve their business goals.
  
  
Meet the Job
  
  

* Customer Relationship Management:

Develop and nurture strong, long-lasting relationships with key customers across your region.
  
  
Regularly engage with senior stakeholders to understand their evolving needs and expectations throughout the software development lifecycle, positioning yourself as a trusted advisor and valuable resource.
  
  
Facilitate complex discussions that involve multiple stakeholders, helping to align their goals with Backbase's solutions and unblocking any adoption and license consumption challenges.
  
  

* Value Maximization:

Collaborate with customers to identify opportunities to maximize the value they derive from Backbase products.
  
  
Work with Backbase Customer Advisory to localize business cases. Provide strategic guidance and best practices to ensure business cases align to the region and bank specific goals, ensuring customers are fully utilizing the range of product capabilities available to them.
  
  
Proactively identify and address potential challenges, working towards solutions that align with the customer’s business objectives.
  
  
Develop joint success plans with senior stakeholders, with clear objectives that are aligned with their strategic goals.
  
  
Actively work with the customer on roadmap planning to track and ensure the realization of the business case throughout the programme lifecycle.
  
  

* Advocacy Building:

Identify and cultivate customer advocates who are willing to share their success stories and experiences with Backbase solutions.
  
  
Collaborate with marketing teams to create case studies, testimonials, and other materials that showcase customer success.
  
  

* Feedback Collection and Product Improvement:

Gather and analyze product utilization, and end user feedback on product experiences, providing actionable insights to R&D and steward the Request for Feature (RFF) process as a joint responsibility with the Services team.
  
  
Act as a bridge between customers and Backbase’s product development organization. Work with the Backbase UX Research team, ensuring that customer needs and suggestions are considered in future product enhancements.
  
  

* Account Management:

Proactively manage renewals by aligning customer success plans and business cases with value realization, ensuring continued customer satisfaction and retention.
  
  
In collaboration with Sales, identify opportunities for account growth by understanding the banks’ business dynamics and leveraging them to expand ARR.
  
  
**How About You**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Technology, Business, or a related field.
* Experience: 10+ years of experience in a customer-facing role, including consulting, customer support, delivery or account management in KSA, with a focus on customer success in the technology or software industry.

* Language Proficiency: Fluent in Arabic, with strong written and verbal communication skills. Proficiency in English is also required.
* Customer-Centric Mindset: Passionate about delivering success for customers, with a deep commitment to understanding customer needs and delivering solutions that exceed their expectations.
* Results-Driven: Strong focus on customer satisfaction, with the ability to analyze data and provide actionable insights and maintain dashboards that drive product adoption and customer success.
* Relationship Builder: Exceptional communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to challenge, negotiate, influence, and persuade stakeholders.
* Autonomous and Cross-Functional: Ability to work independently, take ownership of customer success initiatives, and drive results, while collaborating across teams with Sales, R&D and Services colleagues, as well as Backbase’s partner network.
* Organizational Skills: Capable of prioritizing tasks, multitasking, and demonstrating adaptability in a dynamic environment.
* Commercial and Functional Acumen: Understand the unique cultural and digital trends in the customer’s market and speak to business drivers, with a strong focus on maximizing value for customers. Experience in banking or other Financial Services is a plus.
* Frequent Traveler: Willingness to travel frequently across the region to engage with banks and ensure their success with Backbase.

This role offers a unique opportunity to make a significant impact on Backbase’s customer success, helping our customers achieve their strategic goals while driving growth and adoption of our engagement banking platform and other solutions.

CEO

None (leads a network of process owners and champions across departments and cities)  
  
**Role Purpose**  
The Manager - Process Excellence will design, document and embed standard operating procedures (SOPs) across all departments of Acme Interiors, and lead continuous improvement so that work is done the same way, to the same standard. The role owns the process architecture of Acme Interiors end to end: mapping how work actually flows today, fixing the gaps, writing the SOPs, getting them adopted and checking that they are followed.

**Key Responsibilities**  
**1. Process Mapping and SOP Development**  
 Build and maintain the company-wide process inventory (process architecture) for all departments: Sales & BD, Design, Estimation & Costing, Commercial / QS, Procurement, Stores & Logistics, Projects & Site Execution, MEP, EHS, Finance & Accounts, HR, Admin & Facilities and IT  
 Map current-state (as-is) processes with department heads and site teams using SIPOC, swimlane flowcharts and RACI matrices

 Define delegation of authority (DoA) and approval limits for key financial and operational transactions in consultation with Finance and leadership  
 Run a single document control system: SOP numbering, version control, review dates, ownership and a central SOP repository

 Identify bottlenecks, rework, delays and leakages across the project lifecycle (enquiry to handover and final billing) and lead improvement projects to fix them

**What Success Looks Like in the First 12 Months**

¢ Internal audit cycle running, with measurable improvement in audit compliance  
¢ At least three improvement projects delivered with measured time or cost savings  
¢ ISO 9001 certification readiness achieved (if approved by leadership)

**Why Join Acme Interiors**

Acme Interiors is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion.

jobs.title: Senior SAP & ERP Transformation Lead
jobs.description:
**Senior SAP & ERP Transformation Lead**

**Experience:** 1012+ Years  
 **Qualification:** B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology or equivalent  
 **Preferred Expertise:** SAP, ERP Architecture, ERP Migration, Process Re-engineering and System Integration

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced SAP & ERP Transformation professional with deep end-to-end knowledge of SAP's technical and functional architecture, who can assess, rationalise and eventually lead the migration of the organisation's existing SAP ecosystem to an alternative ERP platform.

The individual will be responsible for understanding the existing SAP landscape across modules, mapping interdependencies between processes, identifying redundancies and recommending an appropriate future-state ERP architecture.

The role requires a strong combination of technical programming capabilities, functional SAP expertise, business process understanding and ERP migration experience. The individual should be capable of evaluating how a change in one module, process or configuration impacts other interconnected business functions.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. End-to-End SAP Architecture & Expertise**

* Develop a comprehensive understanding of the existing SAP landscape, including its modules, configurations, customisations, workflows and integrations.
* Demonstrate strong techno-functional knowledge across SAP modules such as:

+ SAP MM – Materials Management
+ SAP PP – Production Planning
+ SAP SD – Sales & Distribution
+ SAP FI/CO – Finance & Controlling
+ SAP QM – Quality Management
+ SAP PM – Plant Maintenance
+ SAP WM/EWM – Warehouse Management
+ SAP HCM – Human Capital Management

* Understand the interdependencies between modules and assess the downstream and upstream impact of system-level changes.
* Review existing custom developments, ABAP code, interfaces, reports and system configurations.

**2. ERP Migration & Transformation**

* Lead the assessment and migration strategy for transitioning from the existing SAP environment to an alternative ERP platform.
* Evaluate suitable ERP solutions such as Oracle ERP, ERPNext or other enterprise platforms based on business requirements.
* Develop a comprehensive migration roadmap covering data, processes, applications, integrations and infrastructure.
* Identify functionalities that can be migrated, redesigned, consolidated or eliminated.
* Ensure data integrity, business continuity and minimal operational disruption during migration.
* Lead migration planning, testing, validation, deployment and post-implementation stabilisation.

**3. Business Process Re-engineering**

* Map and document existing end-to-end business processes across departments.
* Identify redundant, overlapping, outdated or inefficient processes.
* Design, restructure, consolidate or eliminate processes wherever required.
* Develop future-state workflows aligned with business requirements and operational efficiency.
* Ensure that changes in one business process are evaluated for their impact on other interconnected functions.

**4. Technical & Development Expertise**

* Possess strong understanding of SAP technical architecture, ABAP programming, debugging and custom code development.
* Understand APIs, database architecture, data structures, integrations and middleware.
* Assess the feasibility of replicating or redesigning existing SAP functionalities in the new ERP environment.
* Work with technical teams to develop customised solutions, interfaces and automation wherever required.

**5. Stakeholder Management & ERP Governance**

* Work closely with Finance, HR, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Sales, Projects and other business functions.
* Conduct functional assessments and gather business requirements from stakeholders.
* Establish centralised control over ERP-related projects, changes and process improvements.
* Develop system documentation, process maps, impact assessments and migration governance mechanisms.
* Coordinate with implementation partners, consultants and internal IT teams.

  

**Desired Candidate Profile**

* 10–12+ years of relevant experience in SAP consulting, ERP architecture, ERP transformation or large-scale ERP migration.
* B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, IT or a related engineering discipline preferred.
* Strong techno-functional expertise across multiple SAP modules.
* Hands-on experience with ABAP programming, debugging, system configuration and integration.
* Demonstrated experience in ERP migration, preferably from SAP to Oracle, ERPNext or other enterprise ERP platforms.
* Strong understanding of cross-functional business processes and system interdependencies.
* Experience in process mapping, process redesign and business process re-engineering.
* Ability to independently assess existing systems and recommend appropriate technology and process solutions.
* Strong project management, analytical and stakeholder management capabilities.

  

**Key Expectations from the Role**

The successful candidate should be able to:

1. Understand the existing SAP ecosystem end-to-end without depending entirely on external consultants.
2. Map all existing modules, processes, customisations and system interdependencies.
3. Identify what needs to be retained, modified, consolidated or discontinued.
4. Assess the impact of any proposed change across the entire ERP ecosystem.
5. Recommend the most suitable alternative ERP platform and migration approach.
6. Develop and execute a structured migration roadmap with minimal business disruption.
7. Establish a centralised ERP architecture and governance framework for the organisation.

  

**The ultimate objective is to move from a fragmented and heavily dependent SAP environment towards a streamlined, integrated and scalable ERP ecosystem.**

**Organisational Development Consultant**
=========================================

Req ID: 128597

Department: T&C Organisation Design & Implementation

Division: Talent & Culture

**About Us**
------------

At ANZ, we're shaping a world where people and communities thrive, driven by a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our millions of customers.

  

Organisation Design and Implementation are trusted advisors and delivery partners to T&C and the business, through a strategy led, data informed, and people enabled approach to delivering workforce transformation projects end-to-end.

------------------

As an Advisor - Organisation Design & Implementationin Talent & Culture, you’ll play a key role in helping day-to-day delivery and execution of large, complex people and workforce transformation initiatives, ensuring clear business outcomes are achieved. These initiatives may include the development of new operating models, organisation design and restructures, location or offshoring strategies, M&A people streams, data-led workforce analysis or broader transformation programs.

  

Supporting the development of high-quality insights, recommendations and deliverables that help leaders make informed decisions and enable successful implementation. This may include owning defined workstreams, coordinating project activities, conducting analysis, preparing materials, managing risks and dependencies, and partnering with stakeholders across the business and T&C.

  

The role plays an important part in helping OD&I deliver practical, evidence-based and people-centred outcomes. It requires strong consulting, problem-solving, stakeholder engagement and delivery skills, with the ability to work through complexity, manage competing priorities and contribute to successful transformation outcome.

  

The degree of autonomy, program size / complexity and leadership responsibility will vary depending on the level of the role.

  

Banking is changing and we’re changing with it, giving our people great opportunities to try new things, learn and grow. Whatever your role at ANZ, you’ll be building your future, while helping to build ours.

**Role Location:**  
Bengaluru

Regular Shifts(Hybrid/Blended)

* Supporting the delivery of Organisation Design & Implementation initiatives across operating model, organisation design, data management, workforce transformation, restructuring and implementation.
* Owning or contributing to defined project workstreams, ensuring activities are delivered to a high standard and aligned to agreed outcomes.
* Conducting organisational and workforce analysis to support insights and recommendations, including structure, spans and layers, role design, capability, governance and implementation considerations.
* Preparing high-quality project deliverables, including analysis, options, recommendations, stakeholder packs, governance materials, implementation plans and progress updates.

* Contributing to continuous improvement of OD&I frameworks, tools, methodologies, templates and ways of working

**What will you bring?**
------------------------

To grow and be successful in this role, you will ideally bring the following:

  

* Must have a minimum of 5+ years of relevant experience contributing to people, workforce, organisation design, operating model, or business transformation initiatives.
* Understanding of one or more OD&I core capabilities, such as organisation design, operating model design, restructuring, M&A people streams, workforce transformation, location strategy or data management.
* Strong analytical skills, including the ability to gather, interpret and synthesise workforce, organisational and business information.

* Strong consulting and problem-solving skills, including the ability to structure issues, identify root causes and develop practical solutions.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to produce high-quality presentations, papers, updates and stakeholder communications.
* Ability to manage competing priorities, work through ambiguity and deliver quality outcomes in a complex environment.
* Ability to think systemically, connecting organisational, operational, customer, financial and people impacts when developing analysis and recommendations
* Experience in supporting the professional development and capability uplift of teams.

**So why join us?**
-------------------

ANZ is a place where big things happen as we work together to provide banking and financial services across more than 30 markets. With more than 7,500 people, our Bengaluru team is the bank's largest technology, data and operations centre outside Australia. In operation for over 33 years, the centre is critical in delivering the bank's strategy and making an impact for our millions of customers around the world. Our Bengaluru team not only drives the transformation initiatives of the bank, it also drives a culture that makes ANZ a great place to be. We're proud that people feel they can be themselves at ANZ and 90 percent of our people feel they belong.

  

We know our people need different things to be great in their role, so we offer a range of flexible working options, including hybrid work (where the role allows it). Our people also enjoy a range of benefits including access to health and wellbeing services.

  

We want to continue building a diverse workplace and welcome applications from everyone. Please talk to us about any adjustments you may require to our recruitment process or the role itself. Every day, our teams push toward a future where "Health for all, Hunger for none" is within reach, and every role, from the lab to the field to the boardroom, helps us get there. We give people the ownership to shape outcomes, the support to grow through new skills and experiences, and a global community where different perspectives are valued. If you want your work to count and the room to become your best, you'll find it here.**

  

**We’re changing the way we work at Bayer, for higher productivity, faster innovation, and better results. We call it Dynamic Shared Ownership (DSO). Learn more about what DSO will mean for you in your new role here** **https://www.bayer.com/en/strategy/strategy**

  

**Job Purpose**

The **Associate – Cash Applications** is responsible for the accurate and timely application of customer payments within the Accounts Receivable process. The role involves matching remittance information, clearing open items, reconciling cash receipts, resolving unapplied or unidentified payments, and supporting day-to-day Cash Application activities.

The Associate works closely with customers and internal teams to ensure accurate processing, timely resolution of exceptions, strong controls, and high-quality service delivery.

**Key Tasks and Responsibilities**

* Process and apply incoming customer payments accurately and within agreed timelines, including bank transfers, lockbox receipts, cheques, cards, direct debits, and other payment methods.
* Match remittance advice with customer payments and correctly allocate receipts against invoices, customer accounts, deductions, credit notes, and other open items in the ERP system.
* Perform daily cash and bank reconciliation activities and ensure alignment between bank statements, cash receipt records, and the Accounts Receivable sub-ledger.
* Investigate unapplied, unidentified, misapplied, duplicate, short, or excess payments and coordinate with customers and relevant internal teams for resolution.
* Maintain customer accounts, clear open items, process approved adjustments, and follow up on workflow items and process exceptions.
* Handle customer and internal queries through email, calls, workflow tools, and other communication channels.
* Record and execute transactions in line with approved process documentation, accounting policies, service-level agreements, and quality standards.
* Complete required Internal Control System activities accurately and on time and maintain supporting documentation for audit purposes.
* Support month-end and period-end closing activities.
* Prepare and maintain operational reports related to cash posting, unapplied cash, unidentified cash, ageing, productivity, quality, and other relevant KPIs.
* Identify recurring process issues and escalate exceptions or process gaps to the Senior Associate or Team Lead.
* Support process improvement, automation, analytics, and AI initiatives within Cash Applications.
* Maintain process documentation, standard operating procedures, and work instructions.
* Participate in knowledge-sharing, cross-training, and continuous-learning activities.
* Adapt to changes in processes, systems, regional requirements, and transformation initiatives while maintaining service quality.

**Who you are**

* University degree or equivalent qualification, preferably in **Accounting, Finance, Commerce, Business Administration** , or a related discipline.
* Typically **1–3 years of relevant experience** in Cash Applications, Accounts Receivable, or another Order-to-Cash process.
* Good understanding of **Cash Applications, customer account reconciliation, open-item clearing, unapplied cash management, and basic accounting principles** .
* Experience working with ERP systems. Hands-on experience with **SAP or SAP S/4HANA** would be an advantage.

================================================

Req ID: 128692

Department: T&C Organisation Design & Implementation

Division: Talent & Culture

**About Us**
------------

At ANZ, we're shaping a world where people and communities thrive, driven by a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our millions of customers.

  

Organisation Design and Implementation are trusted advisors and delivery partners to T&C and the business, through a strategy led, data informed, and people enabled approach to delivering workforce transformation projects end-to-end.

**About the Role**
------------------

As a Lead Organisation Design & Implementation in Talent & Culture, you’ll play a key role in helping day-to-day delivery and execution of large, complex people and workforce transformation initiatives, ensuring clear business outcomes are achieved. These initiatives may include the development of new operating models, organisation design and restructures, location or offshoring strategies, M&A people streams, data-led workforce analysis or broader transformation programs.

  

The role acts as a critical integrator across business stakeholders, T&C partners, project teams and cross-functional contributors to drive progress, manage complexity and deliver outcomes at pace. This includes leading project teams, managing risks and interdependencies, removing roadblocks, supporting governance and providing subject matter expertise across core OD&I delivery areas.

  

The role may lead a standalone program or manage a major stream within a broader enterprise transformation initiative, balancing strategic outcomes, stakeholder needs, total investment, delivery risk and time to benefit. The role will also provide strategic advice and challenge to business leaders on organisational effectiveness, operating model design, workforce impacts and implementation considerations.

  

Banking is changing and we’re changing with it, giving our people great opportunities to try new things, learn and grow. Whatever your role at ANZ, you’ll be building your future, while helping to build ours.

  

**Role Type:** Permanent  
**Role Location:**  
Bengaluru  
**Work Hours:**  
Regular Shifts(Hybrid/Blended)

  

**Please note that while this advertisement is for a single role, there are multiple vacancies available for this position.**

**What will your day look like?**
---------------------------------

* Leading the end-to-end delivery of Organisation Design & Implementation initiatives across operating model, organisation design, data management, workforce transformation, restructuring and implementation.
* Providing strategic advice, challenge and subject matter expertise to senior business leaders, T&C Business Partners and project stakeholders.
* Conducting organisational diagnostics and analysis to identify opportunities, risks and recommendations relating to operating model effectiveness, workforce structure, spans and layers, capability, governance and role design.

* Acting as the integrator across stakeholders, workstreams and delivery teams to manage interdependencies and reduce execution risk.

**Detailed Description**
------------------------

* Supporting governance activities, including critical path analysis, risk and issue management, dependency management, stakeholder management, reporting, and supporting budget, resource and scope management.
* Identifying resourcing needs and recommending adjustments to ensure projects or programs are set up for successful delivery.
* Monitoring key metrics and measures of success, including progress against outcomes, delivery milestones, financial impacts and benefits realisation.
* Translating organisation design recommendations into practical implementation plans, ensuring changes are successfully embedded and benefits are realised.
* Supporting leaders and stakeholders through the people impacts of transformation, ensuring implementation activities are thoughtful, compliant and people-centred.
* Building trusted relationships with business leaders, T&C BPs, T&C teams, cross-functional partners and other key stakeholders to resolve issues and remove barriers to success.

**What will you bring?**
------------------------

* 10+ years of relevant experience across Talent & Culture, organisational design, workforce transformation, consulting, or business transformation environments.
* Depth and breadth of experience in at least one of the OD&I core capabilities: organisation design, operating model design, restructuring, M&A people streams, workforce transformation, location strategy or data management.
* Proven experience leading complex people, workforce or business transformation initiatives from mobilisation through to implementation.
* Strong understanding of organisation design principles, operating model design, workforce analysis, role design, governance, and implementation planning.
* Ability to engage, influence and challenge senior stakeholders, including business leaders, T&C Business Partners, and cross-functional delivery partners.
* Experience leading multidisciplinary teams or project teams to execute complex business change and deliver agreed outcomes.
* Strong project and program management experience, including governance, critical path analysis, dependency management, issue and risk management, stakeholder management, and support for budget, resource, and scope management.
* Ability to quickly understand complex business problems, diagnose root causes and develop practical, evidence-based solutions.
* Strong consulting, problem-solving, and facilitation skills, with the ability to structure ambiguous problems and bring stakeholders together around clear recommendations.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to prepare clear papers, updates, recommendations, and executive-level messaging.
* Tertiary qualifications in a relevant discipline
* Experience in supporting the professional development and capability uplift of teams.

**So why join us? (Bengaluru GCC)**
-----------------------------------

ANZ is a place where big things happen as we work together to provide banking and financial services across more than 30 markets. With more than 7,500 people, our Bengaluru team is the bank's largest technology, data and operations centre outside Australia. In operation for over 33 years, the centre is critical in delivering the bank's strategy and making an impact for our millions of customers around the world. Our Bengaluru team not only drives the transformation initiatives of the bank, it also drives a culture that makes ANZ a great place to be. We want to continue building a diverse workplace and welcome applications from everyone. Please talk to us about any adjustments you may require to our recruitment process or the role itself. If you are a candidate with a disability or access requirements, let us know how we can provide you with additional support.

  

To find out more about working at ANZ visit https://www.anz.com/careers/. You

**Experience:** 5–15 Years

**Job Summary**

Levarus Solutions is looking for experienced FLEXCUBE Migration Consultants with strong hands-on experience in Core Banking data migration, system migration, and FLEXCUBE version migration projects.

We are seeking professionals who have practical experience in migrating legacy Core Banking Systems to FLEXCUBE and/or performing migration and upgrade activities across different FLEXCUBE versions, ranging from **11.8 to 14.x**.

The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in data migration, data mapping, extraction, transformation, loading, reconciliation, and validation, along with good knowledge of FLEXCUBE modules and banking operations.

This is a dedicated migration role. Candidates with only production support, application maintenance, or general Oracle database migration experience without FLEXCUBE project exposure will not be considered.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Participate in end-to-end FLEXCUBE Core Banking migration projects.
* Execute data migration activities from legacy Core Banking Systems to Oracle FLEXCUBE.
* Work on FLEXCUBE version-to-version migration and upgrade projects across versions 11.8 to 14.x.
* Analyze source system data and perform source-to-target data mapping based on FLEXCUBE data structures.
* Develop and execute data extraction, transformation, loading, and validation processes.
* Prepare and execute SQL/PL-SQL scripts for data migration, data conversion, and reconciliation.
* Perform data cleansing, transformation, validation, and exception handling to ensure data accuracy and integrity.
* Work on migration of core banking data, including Customer/CIF, CASA, Accounts, Loans, Deposits, General Ledger, and transaction records.
* Conduct mock migration runs, migration rehearsals, and data validation exercises.
* Identify migration gaps, data inconsistencies, and technical issues and coordinate their resolution.
* Prepare migration plans, mapping documents, technical specifications, validation reports, and reconciliation reports.
* Coordinate with functional consultants, technical developers, database teams, and banking stakeholders throughout the migration lifecycle.
* Support SIT, UAT, cutover planning, production deployment, and go-live activities.
* Ensure successful migration execution within project timelines and quality standards.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Strong hands-on experience in FLEXCUBE migration projects.
* Overall IT/Core Banking experience of 5–15 years.
* Mandatory FLEXCUBE project experience.
* Experience working with FLEXCUBE versions ranging from 11.8 to 14.x.
* Strong proficiency in Oracle SQL and PL/SQL.
* Hands-on experience in data extraction, transformation, loading (ETL), and data conversion.
* Expertise in source-to-target data mapping and migration strategy.
* Experience with Oracle database objects, packages, procedures, functions, and migration scripts.
* Knowledge of SQL\*Loader and data loading utilities.
* Experience in data reconciliation, data validation, and data integrity checks.
* Strong understanding of Core Banking modules such as:
* CASA (Current and Savings Accounts)
* Customer Information / CIF
* Branch Operations
* Teller Operations
* Loans and Lending
* Deposits and Term Deposits
* General Ledger (GL)
* Funds Transfer and Payments
* Understanding of migration testing, mock runs, cutover, and go-live activities.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience migrating legacy banking platforms to FLEXCUBE.
* Experience in FLEXCUBE version migration and upgrades.
* Exposure to multiple Core Banking migration projects.
* Knowledge of Oracle Data Integrator (ODI), Informatica, or other ETL tools.
* Experience with Unix/Linux and Shell Scripting.
* Understanding of banking data models and FLEXCUBE database structures.
* Experience working with international banking clients and cross-functional delivery teams.
* Good analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities.

**Mandatory Eligibility Criteria**

* FLEXCUBE experience is mandatory.
* Candidates must have actual FLEXCUBE migration project experience.
* Experience in at least one complete or substantial migration project is preferred.
* Candidates must be able to explain the source banking system, target FLEXCUBE version, modules migrated, migration approach, and their individual contribution.
* Candidates with only general Oracle database migration or FLEXCUBE production support experience will not be considered.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills are essential.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

We are looking for hands-on FLEXCUBE Migration Professionals who can independently manage migration deliverables, understand complex banking data structures, execute migration activities, and ensure accurate and seamless data transition.

The candidate should demonstrate strong technical expertise, banking domain knowledge, ownership of migration activities, and the ability to collaborate effectively with functional, technical, and client teams.

**Interested candidates are invited to apply with their updated resumes.**

About Levarus Solutions

Levarus Solutions is an IT consulting and technology services company specializing in Core Banking, ERP, CRM, Business Intelligence, AI/ML, and Digital Transformation solutions. We help financial institutions modernize their technology platforms through enterprise-grade implementation and consulting services.

**Role Summary**  
  
The IT Project Manager is a member of the global Agile Delivery & Project Management team within the Digital Services Team (DST) and reports to the Manager, Agile Delivery. The role leads a broad range of technology projects that support Husky's core business functions. These include Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Sales, Service, Finance and HR, as well as enterprise applications, system integrations, infrastructure and business process improvement.

Working closely with the Manager, Agile Delivery, business stakeholders, Steering Committees, technical teams and vendors, the IT Project Manager is responsible for planning, managing and delivering projects that achieve their intended business outcomes. All work is completed in accordance with the DST PMO project management model, governance standards and controlled templates.

**Key Responsibilities/Areas of Accountability**

* Manage multiple concurrent projects end to end, from initiation and charter through stage gates, Go/No-Go, go-live, hypercare and closure.

* Work with sponsors and business stakeholders to define scope, success criteria, deliverables and expected benefits.

* Manage vendor and partner engagements, including Statements of Work, onboarding, knowledge transfer and deliverable quality.

* Maintain project governance, including RAID registers, decision logs, Project Status Updates and Steering Committee reporting, using the governance profile appropriate to project size and risk.

* Manage project financials, including budgets, forecasts and variance reporting.

* Engage Architecture, Information Security, Financial Controls/ITGC and Audit/SOX requirements where applicable.

* Coordinate testing, cutover and business readiness activities, and partner with business and change leads on training and communication to support adoption.

* Apply Agile, Waterfall or Hybrid delivery approaches as appropriate to the work.

* Support peers and project team members by sharing experience, and contribute to continuous improvement of PMO practices, templates and lessons learned.

**Qualifications/Requirements**

* Degree in Information Technology, Engineering, Business or a related field.

* 5+ years of IT project management experience with a proven track record of delivering projects on time, on budget and to agreed scope.

* Experience delivering projects across multiple business functions, such as Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Sales, Service and Finance.

* Solid understanding of end-to-end business processes and how enterprise systems support them.

* Demonstrated ability to work effectively with cross-functional stakeholders and vendors, including aligning competing priorities and resolving issues.

* Experience working with global or distributed teams across time zones.

* Experience managing third-party vendors, including SOWs and deliverable management.

* Strong working knowledge of project governance, including stage gates, RAID management, status and Steering Committee reporting, and financial tracking.

* Clear and confident written and verbal communication skills in English.

* Strong planning, organization and follow-through, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.

* Working knowledge of Agile and traditional delivery methodologies.

* Proficiency with tools such as Planview, Azure DevOps, Microsoft Project, Excel and Microsoft 365/Teams.

**Assets**

* Experience delivering ERP projects (for example, BaaN, AX, Dynamics, or Oracle) across modules such as supply chain, procurement, sales, finance or manufacturing.

* Experience with supply chain and operations solutions, such as planning, procurement, inventory, warehouse management, logistics or MES.

* Experience with sales and service solutions, such as CRM, configure-price-quote (CPQ), e-commerce, field service or aftermarket systems.

* Experience with finance solutions and integrations, such as financial close, accounts payable/receivable, banking or tax systems.

* Experience with system integrations, infrastructure or application rollouts across multiple sites or regions.

* Experience applying Audit/SOX and ITGC controls within project delivery.

* Project management certification, such as PMP, PMI-ACP, PRINCE2, CSM/PSM or equivalent.

  
  
  

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks. No agency or telephone inquiries please.

Business Area: Finance

Area of Expertise: Controls

Contract: Permanent

Reference Code: JR-0000138160

  

Join Barclays as AVP - Control Finance, where core responsibility is to execute design assessment and operating effectiveness testing of controls in accordance with testing plans and aligned to relevant policies, procedures and quality standards providing assurance to Management that the processes and controls within the reviewed Business Unit are effectively designed and operating to mitigating the identified risks. At Barclays, we don't just anticipate the future - we're creating it.

  

To be successful in this role, you should have below skills:

  
  

* Experience in risk management or controls assurance or internal audit.
* Understanding of SOx and Risk Management practices including but not limited to Internal Audit.
* Ability to communicate internal control concepts clearly, in a business context.
* Verbal and written communication skills to deal with internal and external stakeholders. Keeps stakeholders up to date with the progress of the audit work, observation status, etc.
* Understand on Investment banking products and had exposure to Banking & Markets division.
* Understanding of Markets finance functions.
  

  

Some other highly valued skills may include below:

  
  

* Knowledge of internal control and regulatory requirements & practice e.g. Sarbanes-Oxley, COSO, Basel IV regulations.
* Proficient in use of MS Office packages (Outlook, Word, Excel, Power-point).
* Understanding on data analytics skills used in control testing.
  

  

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

  
  

The role is based out of Gurugram.

**Purpose of the role**

To partner with the bank, to provide independent insurance on control processes and advise on improvements to ensure the efficiency and effectiveness of the bank’s internal controls framework.

**Accountabilities**

* Collaboration across the bank to maintain a satisfactory, robust, and efficient control environment through the execution of ad-hoc assessments and testing on the design and operational effectiveness of the internal controls, aligned to control policies and standards.
* Development of detailed test plans and procedures to identify weaknesses in internal controls and other initiatives aligned to the bank’s control framework to mitigate any potential risks and issues, prioritised by its severity to disrupt bank operations, potential losses, and reputational impact.
* Communication of key findings and observations to the relevant stakeholders and business units to improve overall control efficiency and provide corrective actions to senior managers. Collaboration with other control professionals to resolve complex issues and ensure consistent testing methodologies across the bank.
* Development of a knowledge centre containing detailed documentation of control assessments, testing on design and operational effectiveness of procedures, findings, and the distribution of material on internal controls to train and upskill colleagues within the bank.

**Assistant Vice President Expectations**

* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

**Job Description**
Our Architecture team is looking for a skilled and experienced Digital Asset Technical Architect to design, implement, and manage a greenfield digital asset ecosystem, focusing on custody management, stablecoin issuance, and seamless integration with our bank's mobile banking platform. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of deploying digital asset solutions, strong technical expertise in key management, security architecture, cloud technologies, and a comprehensive understanding of regulatory compliance, particularly with the Central Bank of UAE (CBUAE) mandates.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Architect and implement a secure, scalable digital asset ecosystem.
* Design institutional-grade custody solutions including wallets, HSMs and key management.
* Lead stablecoin issuance and lifecycle management capabilities.
* Integrate digital asset platforms with core banking, payments and mobile banking.
* Establish security architecture, risk controls and operational governance.
* Ensure compliance with CBUAE regulations and AML/CFT requirements.

Digital Asset Platform Architecture
  
  

* Design and deploy a secure, scalable, and compliant digital asset ecosystem from the ground up.
* Establish custody management, stablecoin issuance, tokenization, and digital wallet capabilities.
* Integrate digital asset services with core banking systems, mobile banking platforms, exchanges, and third-party ecosystems through APIs.

**Blockchain And Distributed Ledger Technology (DLT)**

* Expertise in blockchain technologies and distributed ledger protocols (e.g., Ethereum, Hyperledger) for building custody management and stablecoin issuance solutions.

Blockchain & Smart Contract Development.
  
  

* Architect solutions using blockchain and distributed ledger technologies such as Ethereum and Hyperledger.
* Design, develop, and govern secure smart contracts for stablecoin issuance, transaction processing, and digital asset management.
* Enable interoperability across external digital asset networks, exchanges, and banking infrastructure.

Security & Key Management.
  
  

* Implement enterprise-grade cybersecurity controls, including HSM-based cryptographic key management.
* Establish security frameworks based on NIST, ISO 27001, and industry best practices.
* Lead penetration testing, vulnerability assessments, incident response planning, and disaster recovery strategies. Cloud, Infrastructure & DevOps.

**Cloud And API Integration**

* Architect cloud-native, highly available, scalable, and resilient digital asset platforms.
* Define end-to-end infrastructure architecture covering HA, DR, performance, security, and elimination of single points of failure.
* Establish CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps practices to ensure secure and efficient solution delivery.

Regulatory Compliance & Governance.
  
  

* Ensure compliance with CBUAE regulations, AML/KYC requirements, and applicable international digital asset standards.
* Monitor regulatory developments and adapt technology solutions and operating models accordingly.
* Collaborate with regulators and internal control functions to maintain governance and compliance.

Operations & Vendor Management.
  
  

* Manage the complete solution lifecycle from requirements gathering through production support.
* Develop operational playbooks, monitoring frameworks, dashboards, and automation capabilities.
* Evaluate and manage technology vendors, blockchain providers, custodians, and strategic partners.

Enterprise Architecture & Strategic Leadership.
  
  

* Apply TOGAF and Enterprise Architecture principles to create a future-ready digital asset platform aligned with business strategy.
* Design modular, API-first, microservices-based architectures to promote flexibility and scalability.
* Drive stakeholder engagement, change management, and cross-functional collaboration across business, technology, risk, compliance, and security teams.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, IT, Engineering or related field.
* 8+ years of architecture or platform engineering experience in banking, fintech or digital assets.
* Experience with custody platforms, wallets, tokenisation and stablecoin ecosystems.
* Strong knowledge of blockchain, cryptography, cloud platforms and cybersecurity.
* Expertise in API management, enterprise integration and digital banking ecosystems.
* Experience with UAE digital asset regulations.
* Knowledge of tokenized deposits, CBDCs, stablecoins and blockchain interoperability.
* Professional certifications in cloud, security, architecture or blockchain technologies.
* Cloud Architects certification from public cloud providers like AWS, Azure etc.
* Certification on Virtualization and related technology.

jobs.title: Platform Architect - Data Platform
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
RAKBANK is looking for a highly experienced Data Platform Architect to lead the architecture, strategy, governance, and evolution of the Bank’s Enterprise Data Platform. This role is responsible for defining and governing scalable, secure, cloud-native data platforms that support analytics, AI/ML, regulatory reporting, customer intelligence, and enterprise-wide data products. You will play a critical role in shaping RAKBANK’s modern data ecosystem, driving architecture decisions across Databricks Lakehouse, Azure, Kafka, Informatica, Power BI, Data Governance, and AI-ready data foundations.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing**
**Enterprise Data Platform Strategy & Architecture**

* Define and maintain the Enterprise Data Platform target-state architecture and roadmap.
* Establish architecture standards, principles, reusable patterns, and reference architectures.
* Ensure alignment with enterprise architecture, security, compliance, and cloud strategy.
* Lead architecture decisions supporting analytics, AI/ML, reporting, and regulatory capabilities.

**Platform Ownership & Governance**

* Own platform architecture standards across Databricks, Delta Lake, Azure Data Factory, Confluent Kafka, Informatica/IICS, metadata, and data quality services.
* Drive platform scalability, resilience, observability, performance, and cost optimization.
* Define engineering standards, automation frameworks, CI/CD practices, and operating models.

**Data Governance, Privacy & Compliance**

* Embed governance, lineage, metadata, quality, retention, access control, encryption, masking, and privacy-by-design principles.
* Ensure compliance with UAE PDPL, CBUAE regulations, internal policies, and audit requirements.
* Partner closely with Data Governance, Information Security, Risk, and Compliance teams.

**Integration & Streaming Architecture**

* Define enterprise integration standards for batch, real-time, and event-driven architectures using Kafka, CDC, APIs, and ETL/ELT.
* Govern integration patterns across on-premises, cloud, SaaS, and partner ecosystems.
* Eliminate non-standard point-to-point integrations and uncontrolled data movement.

**AI & Advanced Analytics Enablement**

* Design trusted and governed foundations for AI, Machine Learning, GenAI, and advanced analytics.

jobs.title: Snr Solution Architect, UAE Enterprise
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for a Senior Solutions Architect to join our Commercial Sector Enterprise team in the UAE. You will work directly with customers in Financial Services organizations navigating complex digital transformations where the technology strategy is not yet defined and the right path forward requires both technical depth and business judgment.
  
  
This is a builder role. You will go into customer environments, understand their hardest problems, and design solutions that work — from whiteboard architecture through proof of concept to production. You will bring deep expertise across cloud infrastructure, modern application development, data and analytics, and increasingly, generative AI and machine learning. You will earn trust by shipping things that matter, not by presenting slides.
  
  
You will be part of a collaborative, supportive team that values curiosity, ownership, and impact. We learn from each other, develop each other, and build an environment where every voice is heard.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
As a Senior Solutions Architect, you will own the technical relationship with customers end-to-end. This means:
  
  

* Partnering with enterprise FSI customers to understand their business objectives, assess their current technology landscape, and architect cloud solutions that deliver real outcomes — in cost optimization, operational efficiency, security, reliability, and innovation.

  

* Building hands-on: prototypes, proofs of concept, reference architectures, and production-ready designs. You lead by doing, not just advising.

  

* Helping customers adopt and build with generative AI and machine learning — identifying high-value use cases, designing architectures for foundation models and intelligent applications, and guiding teams from experimentation to production.

  

* Acting as the customer's technical advocate inside AWS — translating field insights into clear, prioritized feedback that shapes the roadmap for AWS services and features.

  

* Creating and sharing technical content that scales your impact: workshops, blog posts, code samples, reference architectures, and public talks at meetups, user groups, and conferences.

  
  
A day in the life  
No two days look the same. You might spend the morning whiteboarding a solution for a bank's leadership team, then move into a hands-on working session with an insurer's engineering team to design a resilient, low-latency payments or core banking architecture. In the afternoon you might review a colleague's proposal for a regulatory reporting data platform, write a blog post about a security and compliance pattern you found in the field, or join a call with an AWS service team to push for a feature your customer needs. You balance depth with breadth, strategic thinking with hands-on execution, and customer urgency with long-term technical direction.  
  
About the team  
AWS Solutions Architects in MENAT are a tight-knit team of builders and technologists who are passionate about helping customers in one of the world's fastest-growing cloud markets. We work across diverse industries and cultures, which demands adaptability, curiosity, and genuine respect for our customers' contexts. We support each other through knowledge sharing, peer reviews, and a culture of continuous learning. We believe the best ideas come from diverse perspectives, and we actively foster an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 8+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
* 8+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* 8+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 10+ years of infrastructure architecture, database architecture and networking experience
* Experience working with end user or developer communities
* 10+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

jobs.title: SENIOR DIRECTOR, AI SERVICE LINE
jobs.description:
**About the Role**

**The Opportunity**

The Data and Analytics services industry is undergoing its most consequential transformation in two decades — and this role sits at the epicentre of it. At Saama Technologies, we are not retrofitting AI into an existing delivery organisation. We are building an entirely new category of delivery capability, one where AI agents, LLMs, and autonomous workflows are not accelerators bolted onto existing processes, but first-class components of how we architect, deliver, and govern client engagements.

**Your Mandate**

You will build and lead Saama's most strategically critical delivery capability — a purpose-built team for AI-native client engagements where specification replaces code as the primary unit of human effort, and AI agents orchestrate delivery end to end. In parallel, you will serve as the organisation's foremost internal change agent, progressively uplifting existing delivery teams to adopt AI-augmented ways of working, and anchoring technology governance through an Architecture Review Board with organisation-wide authority.

**Key Accountabilities**

* You will
  **own end-to-end technical delivery for the organisation's AI-native client engagements**
  — a first-principles capability built for greenfield mandates where traditional software delivery models no longer apply. You will be taking full ownership of end-to-end technical delivery, estimation, AI-specific quality assurance, model evaluation, and technology risk management within each engagement.
* You will
  **define, enforce, and continuously evolve the delivery standards, assets and accelerators choices, and quality gates that govern AI-native engagements**
  . This includes establishing a specification-centric development methodology and translating it into a repeatable, practice that the broader organisation can adopt at scale.
* You will
  **ensure every AI-native engagement is architected not only for current client outcomes but for long-term extensibility**
  — specifically, designing solutions that can subsequently be integrated into the organisation's broader delivery portfolio and replicated across accounts.
* You will
  **lead the progressive AI enablement of existing delivery teams across the organisation**
  — embedding AI coding tools, intelligent automation, and prompt engineering practices into data engineering workflows previously built on conventional, human-led approaches. You will co-lead the transition from time-and-materials commercial models to outcomes-based constructs in partnership with Business Unit leads, and will track productivity uplift and AI maturity systematically across accounts.
* You will be
  **part of the organisation's Architecture Review Board**
  — a mandatory governance gate for all AI-embedded client projects — conduct periodic technology risk audits across the active delivery portfolio, define and maintain AI standards and responsible AI guardrails, and serve as the final escalation authority for AI technical decisions across all Business Units.
* You will
  **represent Saama in client-facing engagements**
  — leading technical solutioning discussions, delivery consulting, and value proposition conversations directly with client stakeholders. You will bring credibility and depth to conversations on technology risk, architecture trade-offs, and AI adoption strategy, serving as a trusted advisor to clients across active and prospective engagements.
* You will
  **build the AI Service Line’s delivery capability on two tracks**
  — targeted external hiring to bring in specialised AI engineering and architecture talent, and a structured internal programme for upskilling and cross-skilling existing associates into AI-native delivery roles. You will own the capability roadmap that ensures the team’s depth and breadth keeps pace with the demands of the engagement portfolio.

**What You Bring**

* 20+ years of progressive experience in Data, Analytics, and AI delivery within an IT services context, with at least four years in a Senior Director or equivalent leadership role accountable for delivery quality, team performance, and client outcomes.
* Demonstrated hands-on expertise in AI engineering and architecture — including LLM integration, agentic workflow design, RAG pipeline development, and evaluation frameworks for generative AI systems — and the ability to lead senior engineers in applying these within live client engagements.
* A proven track record of building net-new delivery capabilities from the ground up, including team formation, methodology design, and commercial model evolution — not merely inheriting and optimising established practice.
* Experience leading or co-leading commercial model transitions — from time-and-materials to outcomes-based constructs — in partnership with business development, presales, and client governance functions.
* Familiarity with cloud-native AI delivery on platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, and AWS, including native AI tooling and its application in enterprise Data and Analytics engagements.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Run discovery. Understand the use case and the client's process, find the real pain point, and agree the north star metric with the client so everyone knows what outcome the agent has to deliver.
* Design the call flow. Translate business logic into a call flow and conversation design, then brief the FDE on the workflow to build.
* Build agents. Write and iterate production prompts, especially when the FDE is busy on a complex workflow.
* Do RCA. When results dip, listen to the conversations, work out why they failed (prompt, data, flow or telephony) and drive the fix.
* Own the client relationship. Be the person the client calls first. Run governance calls, reviews and escalations, and build trust with stakeholders from operations teams up to business heads.
* Make delivery happen. Plan and run the project with the FDEs: scope, timelines, dependencies on the client's tech and data teams, go-lives. Unblock things before they slip.
* Run on numbers. Own the account's metrics (connect rate, conversion, collections, cost per outcome). Build the analysis, explain what moved and why, and turn it into the next change to the agent.
* Build the account roadmap. For every account, write a strategic plan for expansion: new use cases, new teams, more volume. Size each one, build the business case and take it to the client.
* Sell through value. Pitch upsell and cross-sell with evidence from your own account's results, working with sales and leadership on commercials.
* Test and improve. Run A/B tests on agents, prompts and voices, and read them out.

**Who we're looking for**
-------------------------

Two backgrounds have worked best for this role:

* A growth product manager, ideally with about 2 years of consulting before moving into product, or
* A consultant with 3 to 4 years at a top-tier consulting firm.

Either way, you have:

* Strong client handling. You're comfortable in a room with senior stakeholders and can manage difficult conversations.
* Sharp analytics. You can pull and work the data yourself (SQL, spreadsheets) and turn it into a recommendation.
* Project management discipline across several workstreams and people you don't manage.
* Commercial instinct: you can see where an account can grow and make the case for it.
* Clear, short writing.
* Prompt engineering experience. We don't mean using ChatGPT or Claude day to day; we mean you have built agents that carry out a specific task and have run at scale with real users.
* Conversation design sense. You can read a transcript, see where it went wrong, and fix the flow or the prompt.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Experience at a voice or conversational AI company, or deploying AI for enterprise clients.
* BFSI background: lending, collections or insurance operations.
* Working proficiency in Hindi or a South Indian language.

  
**Benefits**  

* You own real revenue accounts from day one and work directly with the partner who runs them.
* You'll learn what makes AI agents work in production at scale.
* There's a clear path to running a portfolio of accounts as the team grows.

**About Us**
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
  
  
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
  
  
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
  
  
**Overview**
**Job Description**
Visa Consulting & Analytics (VCA) is Visa's consulting division, serving Visa's clients (including card issuers, acquirers and merchants) and solving their strategic problems focused on improving performance. Drawing on our expertise in strategy consulting, payments, data analytics, marketing, operational and macroeconomics, VCA drives high impact and tangible financial results.
  
  
Cards benefits team within VCA manages the deployment of cards benefits programs for Visa’s clients in AP. This is to support Visa’s clients with differentiated card propositions and stay relevant to and drive preference amongst consumers.
  
  
As a Senior Manager, Operations – Card Benefits, you will define and drive the regional operations strategy for Visa’s card benefits program. You’ll lead transformation initiatives that establish scalable operating frameworks, enhance delivery performance, and strengthen cross-market collaboration. This role is ideal for a strategic operator and people leader who thrives in ambiguity, brings structure to complexity, and inspires a team to achieve sustainable, high-impact outcomes.
  
  
This role involves a significant component of cross-functional work and will require the Senior Manager to work closely with the VCA market teams, Product, Sourcing and partners to streamline operations across AP.
  
  
**What a Senior Manager Does At Visa**
In this role, you are expected to:
  
  

* Shape and Scale Operations: Lead the transformation of Visa’s card benefits operations across Asia Pacific, designing scalable frameworks, automation opportunities, and governance models to support long-term growth.
* Own Client Onboarding and Delivery: Oversee onboarding for new clients, managing vendor relationships, contracts, and financial processes—including POs, renewals, and top-ups—to ensure seamless implementation.
* Operational Intelligence and Insight: Define and implement analytics and reporting frameworks that provide visibility into performance, benefits utilisation, and commercial optimisation opportunities.
* Drive Financial Discipline: Oversee billing, revenue, and expense recognition, ensuring accurate and efficient financial management across multiple markets.
* Vendor and Partner Leadership: Build and manage strategic vendor partnerships, driving consistency, efficiency, and value across service delivery.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with key internal stakeholders—such as finance, sourcing and legal—to optimise processes and enhance operational outcomes.
* Build Capabilities and Lead Talent: Recruit, lead, and develop a high-performing operations team, championing a culture of accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.
