* Lead Through Ambiguity: Navigate complex, evolving business contexts with agility and composure, bringing clarity, alignment, and focus to teams and stakeholders.
* Champion Innovation: Lead or support special projects that modernise processes, expand services, and enhance client and cardholder experiences across Asia Pacific.
* Client Relationship Management: Serve as the primary point of contact for market teams and issuing/acquiring/merchant/fintech bank clients across assigned markets, building trusted, long-term partnerships and ensuring high levels of satisfaction and retention
* Stakeholder Coordination: Collaborate closely with internal teams - including product, operations, sourcing, and legal to ensure seamless onboarding, implementation, and ongoing delivery of benefits services
* Kssue Resolution: Proactively address and resolve client concerns, operational challenges, or service escalations to maintain strong relationships and protect the company’s reputation.

**Projects You Will Be a Part Of**
You’ll spearhead the delivery of Visa’s premium card benefits helping issuers enhance customer value, deepen engagement, and differentiate in competitive markets.
  
  

* Work with the Consulting and Product team to operationalize card benefits program that can help us transform the way issuer and Visa drive PV and engagement amongst Visa cardholders
* Development and maintenance of relationships with merchants and third-party suppliers
* Negotiation of terms and agreements to secure relevant benefits for Visa’s clients at compelling terms to ensure card benefits provision drives payment volume as well as Value Added Service revenue.
* Collaborate with stakeholders within VCA, Regional Products & Solutions, and in-market counterparts to align benefits with business goals and strategies
* Monitor and evaluate the performance of secured benefits, report on these findings and make recommend changes to strategy as may be necessary to clients
* Manage the budget, financial planning and forecasting for benefits.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
  
  
**Qualifications**
What you will need:
  
  

* Minimum 8+ years of experience in financial services or consulting or loyalty programs across operations and execution
* Minimum 6+ years of strong experience utilizing analytical and project management skills
* Ability to build and maintain professional relationships, with proven negotiation and communication skills, used to secure deals and offers, ideally from merchants and third parties
* Strong team player internally and with clients, working independently to coordinate cross functional activities, obtaining critical support from multiple stakeholders
* Proven ability to define operational strategy and build scalable processes for long-term success
* Deep experience managing vendors, contracts, and commercial negotiations, including rate setting and performance review
* Strong financial acumen to manage budgets, forecasts, and multi-market billing accuracy
* Demonstrated success as a people leader, fostering high-performing, collaborative, and empowered teams.

* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office and analytical tools
* Proven experience leading automation, transformation, or process redesign initiatives

jobs.description:
Welcome to Frontline Managed Services where innovation, technology, and efficiency converge to redefine the landscape of IT, Financial, and Administrative Managed Services for legal and professional service firms. As pioneers in the industry, we are driven by a relentless commitment to excellence.

  

**Join Our Team and Be a Catalyst for Change!**

We don't just follow industry standards; we set them. Our dynamic environment thrives on pushing boundaries and embracing challenges. We are more than a workplace; we are a community of forward-thinkers dedicated to shaping the future.

  

**Position Overview**

As a key member of the FinanceAR team, you will own the daily posting, application, and reconciliation of cash across all payment channels to keep our books accurate, reduce unapplied cash, and enable a timely month-end close. Under general supervision, this role requires strong attention to detail, sound judgment, and practical bookkeeping knowledge to resolve exceptions and maintain high data quality. Youll partner closely with AR, Collections, and stakeholders to deliver on strict SLAs.

  

**Schedule**  Monday through Friday - 6:30 PM to 3:30 AM IST

  

**What You’ll Do**

* Post & apply daily cash from bank statements/lockbox/portals (ACH, wires, direct debit, cheques) within agreed SLAs
* Minimize unapplied/unidentified cash: research remittances and coordinate with customers/AR to keep unapplied balances applied correctly.
* Reconcile cash activity: match postings to the GL and subledger; investigate and correct errors in entries, computations, and balances.
* Month-end close support: prepare reconciliations, clear suspense accounts, and provide schedules to meet on-time close targets.
* Continuous improvement: analyze recurring exceptions and Excel reports; recommend changes to reduce manual rework
* Stakeholder communication: respond to inquiries from customers, AR, and management; document resolution paths and escalate risk items promptly.

  

**What You Bring**

* 2+ years hands-on experience in cash application within Accounts Receivable.
* Bachelor’s degree (Accounting, Finance, or Business Administration) required.
* Working knowledge of payment modes (direct debit, ACH, wires, cheques) and remittance research.
* Proficiency with Excel (lookups, filters, basic pivots) and MS Office; comfort learning bank/lockbox portals.

**Job Title:** Financial Accountant  
**Experience:** 3+ years  
**Industry:** Engineering Consulting / Manufacturing / Project Management Company / EPC

We are seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented **Account Manager** with at least **3 years** of experience in managing banking operations, personal accounting, and international trade (import/export). The ideal candidate will have hands-on expertise in **Bank Guarantees**, **Personal Accounting**, and **Import & Export documentation and compliance**. You will be responsible for managing financial records, ensuring regulatory compliance, and acting as the liaison between internal stakeholders and external financial institutions.

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

**1. Bank Guarantees & Financial Instruments**

* Manage the full lifecycle of **Bank Guarantees** (issuance, renewal, cancellation).
* Work closely with banks to handle **Letters of Credit (LCs)**, **Standby LCs**, and **foreign remittance processes**.
* Ensure all financial instruments are in line with internal policies and regulatory standards.

**2. Personal Accounting**

* Oversee personal financial planning, expense tracking, investment reporting, and tax preparation for key stakeholders or directors.
* Maintain confidentiality and accuracy in personal records, assets, and liabilities.
* Handle payments, credit card reconciliations, and property-related financial records.

**3. Import & Export Management**

* Prepare and review all documentation related to imports/exports including commercial invoices, packing lists, certificates of origin, and shipping instructions.
* Liaise with customs agents, freight forwarders, and banks for timely clearance and compliance.
* Monitor currency fluctuations and advise on cost impacts.

**4. Financial Reporting & Analysis**

* Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements and MIS reports.
* Analyse variances in budgets vs. actuals and recommend corrective actions.
* Support cash flow forecasting and working capital management.

**5. Vendor and Client Account Management**

* Maintain up-to-date records of receivables and payables.
* Ensure timely invoicing, collections, and vendor payments.
* Reconcile customer and vendor accounts regularly.

**6. Taxation & Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with **GST, TDS, Income Tax, Customs Duties**, and other local and international tax laws.
* File statutory returns on time and support audits by internal and external authorities.
* Liaise with CA firms, legal advisors, and consultants as required.

**7. Banking & Treasury Operations**

* Handle all bank transactions including fund transfers, FD management, and online banking.
* Maintain strong relationships with banking partners to support financial needs.
* Monitor daily cash positions and support investment decisions.

**8. Internal Controls & Audit Support**

* Implement and maintain robust internal controls over financial transactions.
* Prepare documents and respond to internal, statutory, or external audit requirements.
* Ensure all transactions are properly documented and authorized.

**9. Coordination with Cross-Functional Teams**

* Work closely with logistics, procurement, legal, and sales teams to ensure end-to-end transaction support.
* Provide financial insights and data support for business decisions and planning.

**10. Technology and System Support**

* Use accounting software efficiently for bookkeeping, reconciliation, and reporting.
* Recommend and help implement automation or ERP tools for improving financial processes.

jobs.title: Financial Advisory Job Opportunities (Manager, Associate Director, Director & Managing Director)
jobs.description:
**Financial Advisory Service Offerings**
----------------------------------------

Teneo guides companies and their stakeholders through periods of uncertainty and stress to assess options, address financing and/or balance sheet stresses, create liquidity headroom, reduce costs, improve profitability, more efficiently run their businesses and turnaround and/or exit underperforming businesses, whilst communicating appropriately with stakeholders. Our expert team also brings market-leading experience in developing and delivering contingency plans and insolvencies across multiple jurisdictions, providing credible fallback plans to protect value or helping to shape and affect a restructuring.

We advise clients on strategies and actions to create, protect and realize value across the full spectrum of stressed or distressed transactions and industries, while helping leaders solve complex business challenges and achieve their goals. No two situations are the same, and our advice and approach is tailored to each set of circumstances and client priorities.

**The Role**
------------

As part of ambitious growth plans for our already successful Middle East Financial Advisory business, we are looking for Managers, Associate Directors, Directors and Managing Directors to join our Financial Advisory team in the UAE. Our Managers, Associate Directors, Directors and Managing Directors have the opportunity to lead on a diverse range of engagements across different sectors and geographies, with responsibility for leading projects or key workstreams, managing junior staff and supporting senior leadership in client-facing delivery.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

Client service

* Lead and/or manage key parts of engagements, providing support to senior team members or often directly to the Senior Managing Directors.
* Support client management teams in preparing and challenging business plans, short and/or longer term cash flow forecasts and restructuring plans.
* Providing cash management services to clients to identify working capital and other cash flow improvements.
* Reviewing and stress-testing integrated business plans, budgeting and forecasting models using a fact-based, data driven approach, including KPI definition, data visualization, reporting automation and touchless forecasting.
* Reviewing detailed, integrated 3 statement forecasts (profit & loss, cashflow and balance sheet), and discounted cashflow (DCF).
* Preparing report outputs that may range from business plan documentation and board reports when working for a company, through to preparation of independent business reviews when working for creditors.
* Developing, analysing and presenting restructuring, refinancing and/or insolvency options using input from other teams, e.g. insolvency or tax analysis, sector and financial modelling.
* Liaising with the Company’s legal advisors to understand key aspects of legal documentation and also drive any documentation processes (term sheets, waivers, loan documentation etc.).
* Preparation of engagement letter(s) and ensuring adherence to all compliance requirements to support financial and risk management.
* Apply an understanding of engagement economics.

Knowledge acquisition

* Build client relationship skills, sector knowledge and continue to develop leadership skills.
* Continue to build technical expertise, broader business advisory and people management skills.
* Understand the market, topical issues and our Financial Advisory propositions.

People and leadership

* Support practice and talent development.
* Provide on-job coaching and development to staff.
* Develop junior staff outside of jobs through appraising and mentoring.
* Support wider Financial Advisory training initiatives.
* Manage diverse teams within an inclusive team culture where people are recognised for their contribution.

Business development

* Own elements of business development including actively supporting business development activities, building and expending your own contact network and supporting Middle East Financial Advisory marketing and sales activities.
* Participate in existing business development programmes and key client accounts.
* Identify opportunities to expand jobs as well as opportunities to provide wider Teneo services to existing clients.
* Take responsibility for leading marketing initiatives aimed at specific channels to market, or events.

Examples of the types of projects you would be expected to work on include:

* Company diagnostic, turnaround planning, and implementation
* Debt restructuring
* Short-term cash flow forecasting and cash management office set-up
* Preparation and validation of business plans
* Independent business reviews and options analysis
* Working capital management
* Operational cost reduction
* Interim management and active PMO leadership

**Key Skills & Experience**
---------------------------

Basic Qualifications

* A minimum of 5 years Financial Advisory experience gained either as an advisor within a professional services company, consultancy or investment bank.
* Very strong analytical skills, including: business analytics, business planning, short term cash flows, financing options.
* Understanding of financial statements and related data to assess historical financial performance and future outlook for client companies and prospects.
* Good understanding of the Financial Advisory marketplace, its trends, and key players (principals and advisers).
* Excellent interpersonal skills.
* Strong project management skills, with ability to lead mid-large teams and develop people.
* Understanding of debt markets, banking, loan agreements and other relevant financial and legal documentation.

Preferred Qualifications

* An Accounting degree and/or Qualified Accountant.
* Arabic language skills are strongly preferred, but not mandatory.
* Experience in the UAE or KSA market is strongly preferred.

**About Teneo**
---------------

Teneo is a leading global financial advisory powerhouse that provides innovative, market leading solutions from recognized experts across offices in the UK, US, The Caribbean and Bermuda, Europe, Middle East, Australia, and Asia Pacific, supported by Teneo’s wider global offering of c.2,000 professionals. We offer our clients unique, integrated solutions to complex issues.

Teneo’s full range of advisory services includes strategic communications, investor relations, financial advisory and restructuring, management consulting, physical and cyber risk, organisational design, board and executive search, geopolitics and government affairs. The breadth of our offering and our ability to provide bespoke and seamless advisory services, on either a standalone or integrated basis, makes us truly unique. Teneo's Middle East Financial Advisory senior leadership team has worked on the majority of the largest and most complex situations completed in the Middle East over the past 2 decades.

jobs.title: Head of New Verticals Business Planning and Performance
jobs.description:
**Our Global Structure**

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

**The Team**

Deliveroo is on a mission to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders.

Our Grocery & Retail team manages Deliveroo's Grocery and non-food Retail businesses. We work closely with our partners and cross-functional teams to drive growth, strengthen the customer proposition and improve business performance.

As the scale and complexity of Grocery & Retail continues to grow, the Strategy & Performance function plays a central role in setting market strategy, leading business planning, embedding strong performance management and ensuring we continue to improve the customer experience.

**The Role**

The Head of Strategy & Performance, New Verticals - Middle East is responsible for setting the strategic direction of Deliveroo's Grocery and non-food Retail business and ensuring we translate that strategy into measurable growth and performance.

This is a high-impact leadership role with significant exposure to senior local and global stakeholders, sitting at the centre of some of the most important decisions shaping the future of Grocery & Retail in the Middle East. You will work closely with the Director of Grocery & Retail and wider leadership team across strategy, business planning, performance, customer value proposition and high-priority cross-functional initiatives.

You will lead two core functions: Strategy & Performance and Category Management, setting their direction, building strong teams and bringing together data, customer insight and commercial context to determine where we should focus, what needs to change and how we deliver against our ambitions. Through Category Management, you will shape the customer proposition across key levers including conversion, selection, catalogue quality, pricing, promotions and merchandising, ensuring priorities translate into tangible improvements across the customer journey.

The role combines big-picture strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You will need to be equally comfortable defining long-term priorities, diagnosing why the business is performing the way it is, influencing senior stakeholders and getting into the details to unblock complex initiatives.

You will directly manage the Strategy & Performance Manager and Senior Category Manager, with the wider Category Management team also sitting within your organisation.

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* **Own Grocery & Retail strategy and planning:** Set the strategic direction for Grocery and non-food Retail, lead annual and quarterly planning, identify and size the biggest growth opportunities, and partner closely with Finance to translate strategic priorities into financial plans, business cases and clear targets.
* **Drive business performance:** Own the overall performance framework for Grocery & Retail, ensuring leadership understands what is driving performance and where action is required. Set the direction for WBRs, MBRs and performance diagnostics, and build a strong culture of accountability and follow-through.
* **Shape the customer proposition and Category Management agenda:** Own the overarching CVP strategy and set the direction for Category Management across key levers including selection, availability, pricing, promotions, merchandising, catalogue quality and conversion. Ensure priorities are grounded in customer behaviour, commercial performance and competitor insights.
* **Lead high-impact strategic initiatives:** Take ownership of complex, cross-functional opportunities and problems that do not naturally sit within one team, from initial diagnosis and strategic direction through to alignment, delivery and handover into BAU.
* **Lead and develop high-performing teams:** Lead the Strategy & Performance and Category Management functions, directly managing the Strategy & Performance Manager and Senior Category Manager. Set clear priorities, coach and develop the team, and build the capabilities, tools and operating models needed for both functions to scale effectively.
* **Influence senior stakeholders and shape decisions:** Act as a strategic partner to the Director of Grocery & Retail and wider leadership team, representing Grocery & Retail in key local and central discussions and shaping decisions on the business's most important strategic priorities.

**Qualifications:**

* 6+ years of experience in Strategy & Operations, strategy, consulting, investment banking, commercial, growth or business operations, ideally in a high-growth technology, marketplace or startup environment; experience in on-demand delivery, Grocery, Retail or digital category management is a strong advantage.
* Strong commercial and analytical judgement, with the ability to understand business performance, diagnose root causes and make clear recommendations grounded in data and commercial context.
* Strong ability to structure ambiguity, taking broad or loosely defined business problems, framing the problem clearly, identifying the right questions and translating them into a practical strategy and execution plan.
* Strong influencer and relationship builder, able to bring senior and cross-functional stakeholders on the journey, communicate in a way that resonates with different audiences and drive alignment without relying on formal authority.
* Proven end-to-end execution capability, including mobilising the right teams and resources, securing investment or headcount where needed, removing blockers and driving complex initiatives through to measurable outcomes.
* Proven people leadership experience, with the ability to set clear direction, develop high-performing teams, coach managers and build the capabilities and ways of working needed for teams to scale effectively.
* Strong data literacy and comfort using analytical and AI tools to accelerate analysis, problem-solving and decision-making; experience with tools such as Looker, Cursor, Claude or similar is an advantage.

**Benefits and Diversity**

* Annual Holiday Leave
* Annual flight allowance
* Free Deliveroo Plus - Free delivery and access to special offers
* Enhanced Maternity & Paternity benefits
* End of year parties & regular social events
* An extremely fun team to work alongside!

At Deliveroo we know that people are the heart of the business, and we prioritize their welfare. We offer many great benefits in areas including health insurance, family, financial coverage, community, convenience, growth opportunities, time away, and relocation.

We believe a great workplace is one that represents the world we live in and how beautifully diverse it can be. That means we have no judgment when it comes to any one of the things that make you who you are - your gender, race, sexuality, religion, or a secret aversion to coriander. All you need is a passion for (most) food and a desire to be part of one of the fastest-growing start-ups around.

**Diversity, Equity and Inclusion**  
  
At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

jobs.title: VCA Consulting Director, Acquiring Advisory
jobs.description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Role Summary:

The Visa Consulting Director will be responsible for the growth of the Acquiring Advisory practice across CEMEA. This includes the overall strategy and successful delivery of offerings within this practice under the EMF umbrella, ensuring that it continues to grow across the region. This will require a depth of expertise in the Acquiring business, a solid understanding of the implications of the changing environment for payment service providers and the ability to design modules and set plays that will increase Visa's reputation as the leading advisor in this field. The Director will work in close cooperation with Visa's global consulting practices and with Value-Added Services, notably Visa Acceptance Solutions, and will lead a growing portfolio of Acquiring trainings, bringing a strong management consulting background and setting the standard for AI-enabled advisory delivery across the practice. Success will be measured on Visa's ability to provide proof points of growth in clients' businesses and being able to evidence the fact that we have supported our clients to define and implement strategies that will prepare them for future success.

Principal Responsibilities/Key Result Areas:

* Own and drive the Acquiring Advisory practice forward as its senior subject matter expert.
* Use this in-depth expertise to review, expand and grow the areas where Visa can support acquirers, processors and PayFacs to optimize and expand their business in a balanced manner that delivers clear results.
* Use Visa and external data to analyze client needs across the region's markets to identify opportunities for Acquiring Advisory consulting assignments with Visa's clients.
* In coordination with regional VCA teams, Country Managers, Products and Account Executives, ensure we operate as One Visa.
* Work in close partnership with Value-Added Services (VAS), and in particular Visa Acceptance Solutions, to shape joint propositions, embed acceptance solutions in consulting recommendations and generate pipeline for VAS products.
* Support the development of Acquiring Advisory project pitches and secure new consulting assignments with clients, as well as relevant re-engagement opportunities via a consultative sales approach in assigned markets under the guidance of the Hub lead and regional consulting leads.
* Deliver consulting projects. Resolve complex strategic problems. Synthesize and manage complex project structures when required. Manage, facilitate and implement consulting services and meet the client's business targets (assignment objectives, project scope, budget, paperwork, external consultants' supervision and project delivery). Ensure a seamless consulting experience for the client including all required areas/departments.
* Work on client site and/or virtually to design and project manage the implementation of recommendations as required.
* Ability and desire to mentor colleagues at all levels of the organization who are working to develop Acquiring expertise.
* Design, update and deliver the portfolio of Acquiring trainings for clients and internal Visa audiences, from executive briefings to in-depth technical and commercial programs, as an increasingly important part of the practice.
* Champion the use of AI across the Acquiring Advisory practice: embed AI tools into research, analysis, benchmarking and deliverable production, and ensure the team's AI fluency keeps pace with the fastest-moving tools available to consultants.
* Work closely with the global Acquiring practice and other global practices: share experience and project learnings in both directions, contribute to the set-up of standardized offerings, and leverage new global consulting solutions that will grow the practice.
* Take ownership of codifying best practices into reusable assets and of the ongoing build and maintenance of leading practices, new trends, business models and case studies to ensure that relevant information is always accessible and up to date.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**

Basic Qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent. Master's degree preferred.
* At least 10 years of overall experience, of which more than 5 years as a consultant in a top-tier management consulting firm with strong expertise in Banking and specifically in Acquiring — this consulting background is a core requirement of the role.
* Deep, first-hand expertise across all aspects of a payments acquiring business, including merchant solutions, processing, value proposition design, product development and launch.
* Experience gained within payment acquirers, processors, payment facilitators or card schemes is a strong plus. A combination of regional and global experience strongly desired.
* Strong facilitation and training delivery skills.
* Advanced consulting, client engagement, client contact and presentation skills. Credibility with clients and working teams and diplomatic skills to extract desired outcomes. Comfortable interacting with and presenting to senior management of clients and Visa.
* Full AI fluency and a genuine passion for AI: deep knowledge of GenAI and agentic AI concepts, capabilities and limitations, daily hands-on use of the leading AI tools, and the credibility to set and raise the AI standard for the team's research, analysis and deliverable production.
* Highly analytical with advanced PowerPoint and Excel skills.
* Superior project management skills. Fluent communicator.
* Must have financial acumen and commercial awareness skills.
* Results-driven, flexible and both internally and externally customer focused.
* Able to travel frequently and work on client site and in a multicultural environment across CEMEA.
* Self-motivated and able to use own initiative with limited direction.
* Strong teamwork and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively with interdisciplinary groups.
* Russian language is plus.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.
